verses.en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.fr: Au commencement était la Parole, et la Parole était avec Dieu, et la Parole était Dieu.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያው ቃል ነበረ፥ ቃልም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነበረ፥ ቃልም እግዚአብሔር ነበረ።

verses.en: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.fr: Elle était au commencement avec Dieu.
verses.am: ይህ በመጀመሪያው በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
verses.fr: Toutes choses ont été faites par elle, et rien de ce qui a été fait n''a été fait sans elle.
verses.am: ሁሉ በእርሱ ሆነ፥ ከሆነውም አንዳች ስንኳ ያለ እርሱ አልሆነም።

verses.en: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
verses.fr: En elle était la vie, et la vie était la lumière des hommes.
verses.am: በእርሱ ሕይወት ነበረች፥ ሕይወትም የሰው ብርሃን ነበረች።

verses.en: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
verses.fr: La lumière luit dans les ténèbres, et les ténèbres ne l''ont point reçue.
verses.am: ብርሃንም በጨለማ ይበራል፥ ጨለማም አላሸነፈውም።

verses.en: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.fr: Il y eut un homme envoyé de Dieu: son nom était Jean.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር የተላከ ስሙ ዮሐንስ የሚባል አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.en: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
verses.fr: Il vint pour servir de témoin, pour rendre témoignage à la lumière, afin que tous crussent par lui.
verses.am: ሁሉ በእርሱ በኩል እንዲያምኑ ይህ ስለ ብርሃን ይመሰክር ዘንድ ለምስክር መጣ።

verses.en: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
verses.fr: Il n''était pas la lumière, mais il parut pour rendre témoignage à la lumière.
verses.am: ስለ ብርሃን ሊመሰክር መጣ እንጂ፥ እርሱ ብርሃን አልነበረም።

verses.en: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
verses.fr: Cette lumière était la véritable lumière, qui, en venant dans le monde, éclaire tout homme.
verses.am: ለሰው ሁሉ የሚያበራው እውነተኛው ብርሃን ወደ ዓለም ይመጣ ነበር።

verses.en: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
verses.fr: Elle était dans le monde, et le monde a été fait par elle, et le monde ne l''a point connue.
verses.am: በዓለም ነበረ፥ ዓለሙም በእርሱ ሆነ፥ ዓለሙም አላወቀውም።

verses.en: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
verses.fr: Elle est venue chez les siens, et les siens ne l''ont point reçue.
verses.am: የእርሱ ወደ ሆነው መጣ፥ የገዛ ወገኖቹም አልተቀበሉትም።

verses.en: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
verses.fr: Mais à tous ceux qui l''ont reçue, à ceux qui croient en son nom, elle a donné le pouvoir de devenir enfants de Dieu,
verses.am: ለተቀበሉት ሁሉ ግን፥ በስሙ ለሚያምኑት ለእነርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሥልጣንን ሰጣቸው፤

verses.en: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.fr: lesquels sont nés, non du sang, ni de la volonté de la chair, ni de la volonté de l''homme, mais de Dieu.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከእግዚአብሔር ተወለዱ እንጂ ከደም ወይም ከሥጋ ፈቃድ ወይም ከወንድ ፈቃድ አልተወለዱም።

verses.en: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verses.fr: Et la parole a été faite chair, et elle a habité parmi nous, pleine de grâce et de vérité; et nous avons contemplé sa gloire, une gloire comme la gloire du Fils unique venu du Père.
verses.am: ቃልም ሥጋ ሆነ፤ ጸጋንና እውነትንም ተመልቶ በእኛ አደረ፥ አንድ ልጅም ከአባቱ ዘንድ እንዳለው ክብር የሆነው ክብሩን አየን።

verses.en: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.fr: Jean lui a rendu témoignage, et s''est écrié: C''est celui dont j''ai dit: Celui qui vient après moi m''a précédé, car il était avant moi.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ ስለ እርሱ መሰከረ እንዲህም ብሎ ጮኸ። ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው እርሱ ከእኔ በፊት ነበረና ከእኔ ይልቅ የከበረ ሆኖአል፤ ስለ እርሱ ያልሁት ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
verses.fr: Et nous avons tous reçu de sa plénitude, et grâce pour grâce;
verses.am: እኛ ሁላችን ከሙላቱ ተቀብለን በጸጋ ላይ ጸጋ ተሰጥቶናልና ሕግ በሙሴ ተሰጥቶ ነበርና፤

verses.en: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: car la loi a été donnée par Moïse, la grâce et la vérité sont venues par Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: ጸጋና እውነት ግን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሆነ።

verses.en: No man hath seen God at any time, the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
verses.fr: Personne n''a jamais vu Dieu; le Fils unique, qui est dans le sein du Père, est celui qui l''a fait connaître.
verses.am: መቼም ቢሆን እግዚአብሔርን ያየው አንድ ስንኳ የለም፤ በአባቱ እቅፍ ያለ አንድ ልጁ እርሱ ተረከው።

verses.en: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
verses.fr: Voici le témoignage de Jean, lorsque les Juifs envoyèrent de Jérusalem des sacrificateurs et des Lévites, pour lui demander: Toi, qui es-tu?
verses.am: አይሁድም። አንተ ማን ነህ? ብለው ይጠይቁት ዘንድ ከኢየሩሳሌም ካህናትንና ሌዋውያንን በላኩበት ጊዜ፥ የዮሐንስ ምስክርነት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
verses.fr: Il déclara, et ne le nia point, il déclara qu''il n''était pas le Christ.
verses.am: መሰከረም አልካደምም፤ እኔ ክርስቶስ አይደለሁም ብሎ መሰከረ።

verses.en: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
verses.fr: Et ils lui demandèrent: Quoi donc? es-tu Elie? Et il dit: Je ne le suis point. Es-tu le prophète? Et il répondit: Non.
verses.am: እንኪያስ ማን ነህ? ኤልያስ ነህን? ብለው ጠየቁት። አይደለሁም አለ። ነቢዩ ነህን? አይደለሁም ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent alors: Qui es-tu? afin que nous donnions une réponse à ceux qui nous ont envoyés. Que dis-tu de toi-même?
verses.am: እንኪያስ። ማን ነህ? ለላኩን መልስ እንድንሰጥ፤ ስለራስህ ምን ትላለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
verses.fr: Moi, dit-il, je suis la voix de celui qui crie dans le désert: Aplanissez le chemin du Seigneur, comme a dit Esaïe, le prophète.
verses.am: እርሱም። ነቢዩ ኢሳይያስ እንዳለ። የጌታን መንገድ አቅኑ ብሎ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ ሰው ድምፅ እኔ ነኝ አለ።

verses.en: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
verses.fr: Ceux qui avaient été envoyés étaient des pharisiens.

verses.en: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
verses.fr: Ils lui firent encore cette question: Pourquoi donc baptises-tu, si tu n''es pas le Christ, ni Elie, ni le prophète?
verses.am: የተላኩትም ከፈሪሳውያን ነበሩና። እንኪያስ አንተ ክርስቶስ ወይም ኤልያስ ወይም ነቢዩ ካይደለህ፥ ስለ ምን ታጠምቃለህ? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
verses.fr: Jean leur répondit: Moi, je baptise d''eau, mais au milieu de vous il y a quelqu''un que vous ne connaissez pas,
verses.am: ዮሐንስ መልሶ። እኔ በውኃ አጠምቃለሁ፤ ዳሩ ግን እናንተ የማታውቁት በመካከላችሁ ቆሞአል፤

verses.en: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
verses.fr: qui vient après moi; je ne suis pas digne de délier la courroie de ses souliers.
verses.am: እኔ የጫማውን ጠፍር ልፈታ የማይገባኝ፥ ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው ከእኔ ይልቅ የሚከብር ይህ ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.fr: Ces choses se passèrent à Béthanie, au delà du Jourdain, où Jean baptisait.
verses.am: ይህ ነገር ዮሐንስ ያጠምቅበት በነበረው በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በቢታንያ በቤተ ራባ ሆነ።

verses.en: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, il vit Jésus venant à lui, et il dit: Voici l''Agneau de Dieu, qui ôte le péché du monde.
verses.am: በነገው ዮሐንስ ኢየሱስን ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አይቶ እንዲህ አለ። እነሆ የዓለምን ኃጢአት የሚያስወግድ የእግዚአብሔር በግ።

verses.en: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.fr: C''est celui dont j''ai dit: Après moi vient un homme qui m''a précédé, car il était avant moi.
verses.am: አንድ ሰው ከእኔ በኋላ ይመጣል፥ ከእኔም በፊት ነበርና ከእኔ ይልቅ የከበረ ሆኖአል ብዬ ስለ እርሱ ያልሁት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
verses.fr: Je ne le connaissais pas, mais c''est afin qu''il fût manifesté à Israël que je suis venu baptiser d''eau.
verses.am: እኔም አላውቀውም ነበር፥ ዳሩ ግን ለእስራኤል ይገለጥ ዘንድ ስለዚህ በውኃ እያጠመቅሁ እኔ መጣሁ።

verses.en: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
verses.fr: Jean rendit ce témoignage: J''ai vu l''Esprit descendre du ciel comme une colombe et s''arrêter sur lui.
verses.am: ዮሐንስም እንዲህ ብሎ መሰከረ። መንፈስ ከሰማይ እንደ ርግብ ሆኖ ሲወርድ አየሁ፤ በእርሱ ላይም ኖረ።

verses.en: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: Je ne le connaissais pas, mais celui qui m''a envoyé baptiser d''eau, celui-là m''a dit: Celui sur qui tu verras l''Esprit descendre et s''arrêter, c''est celui qui baptise du Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: እኔም አላውቀውም ነበር፥ ዳሩ ግን በውኃ አጠምቅ ዘንድ የላከኝ እርሱ። መንፈስ ሲወርድበትና ሲኖርበት የምታየው፥ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ የሚያጠምቅ እርሱ ነው አለኝ።

verses.en: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
verses.fr: Et j''ai vu, et j''ai rendu témoignage qu''il est le Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: እኔም አይቻለሁ እርሱም የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆነ መስክሬአለሁ።

verses.en: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
verses.fr: Le lendemain, Jean était encore là, avec deux de ses disciples;
verses.am: በነገው ደግሞ ዮሐንስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሁለት ቆመው ነበር፥

verses.en: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
verses.fr: et, ayant regardé Jésus qui passait, il dit: Voilà l''Agneau de Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሲሄድ ተመልክቶ። እነሆ የእግዚአብሔር በግ አለ።

verses.en: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.fr: Les deux disciples l''entendirent prononcer ces paroles, et ils suivirent Jésus.
verses.am: ሁለቱም ደቀ መዛሙርት ሲናገር ሰምተው ኢየሱስን ተከተሉት።

verses.en: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
verses.fr: Jésus se retourna, et voyant qu''ils le suivaient, il leur dit: Que cherchez-vous? Ils lui répondirent: Rabbi ce qui signifie Maître, où demeures-tu?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ዘወር ብሎ ሲከተሉትም አይቶ። ምን ትፈልጋላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
verses.fr: Venez, leur dit-il, et voyez. Ils allèrent, et ils virent où il demeurait; et ils restèrent auprès de lui ce jour-là. C''était environ la dixième heure.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ረቢ፥ ወዴት ትኖራለህ? አሉት፤ ትርጓሜው መምህር ሆይ ማለት ነው።

verses.en: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
verses.fr: André, frère de Simon Pierre, était l''un des deux qui avaient entendu les paroles de Jean, et qui avaient suivi Jésus.
verses.am: መጥታችሁ እዩ አላቸው። መጥተው የሚኖርበትን አዩ፥ በዚያም ቀን በእርሱ ዘንድ ዋሉ፤ አሥር ሰዓት ያህል ነበረ።

verses.en: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
verses.fr: Ce fut lui qui rencontra le premier son frère Simon, et il lui dit: Nous avons trouvé le Messie ce qui signifie Christ.
verses.am: ከዮሐንስ ዘንድ ሰምተው ከተከተሉት ከሁለቱ አንዱ የስምዖን ጴጥሮስ ወንድም እንድርያስ ነበረ።

verses.en: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
verses.fr: Et il le conduisit vers Jésus. Jésus, l''ayant regardé, dit: Tu es Simon, fils de Jonas; tu seras appelé Céphas ce qui signifie Pierre.
verses.am: እርሱ አስቀድሞ የራሱን ወንድም ስምዖንን አገኘውና። መሢሕን አግኝተናል አለው፤ ትርጓሜውም ክርስቶስ ማለት ነው።

verses.en: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, Jésus voulut se rendre en Galilée, et il rencontra Philippe. Il lui dit: Suis-moi.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሱስም አመጣው። ኢየሱስም ተመልክቶ። አንተ የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ነህ፤ አንተ ኬፋ ትባላለህ አለው፤ ትርጓሜው ጴጥሮስ ማለት ነው።

verses.en: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.fr: Philippe était de Bethsaïda, de la ville d''André et de Pierre.
verses.am: በነገው ኢየሱስ ወደ ገሊላ ሊወጣ ወደደ፥ ፊልጶስንም አገኘና። ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.en: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
verses.fr: Philippe rencontra Nathanaël, et lui dit: Nous avons trouvé celui de qui Moïse a écrit dans la loi et dont les prophètes ont parlé, Jésus de Nazareth, fils de Joseph.
verses.am: ፊልጶስም ከእንድርያስና ከጴጥሮስ ከተማ ከቤተ ሳይዳ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
verses.fr: Nathanaël lui dit: Peut-il venir de Nazareth quelque chose de bon? Philippe lui répondit: Viens, et vois.
verses.am: ፊልጶስ ናትናኤልን አግኝቶ። ሙሴ በሕግ ነቢያትም ስለ እርሱ የጻፉትን የዮሴፍን ልጅ የናዝሬቱን ኢየሱስን አግኝተነዋል አለው።

verses.en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
verses.fr: Jésus, voyant venir à lui Nathanaël, dit de lui: Voici vraiment un Israélite, dans lequel il n''y a point de fraude.
verses.am: ናትናኤልም። ከናዝሬት መልካም ነገር ሊወጣ ይችላልን? አለው። ፊልጶስ። መጥተህ እይ አለው።

verses.en: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
verses.fr: D''où me connais-tu? lui dit Nathanaël. Jésus lui répondit: Avant que Philippe t''appelât, quand tu étais sous le figuier, je t''ai vu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ናትናኤልን ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አይቶ ስለ እርሱ። ተንኰል የሌለበት በእውነት የእስራኤል ሰው እነሆ አለ።

verses.en: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
verses.fr: Nathanaël répondit et lui dit: Rabbi, tu es le Fils de Dieu, tu es le roi d''Israël.
verses.am: ናትናኤልም። ከወዴት ታውቀኛለህ? አለው። ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ፊልጶስ ሳይጠራህ፥ ከበለስ በታች ሳለህ፥ አየሁህ አለው።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Parce que je t''ai dit que je t''ai vu sous le figuier, tu crois; tu verras de plus grandes choses que celles-ci.
verses.am: ናትናኤልም መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ፤ አንተ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ነህ አለው።

verses.en: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
verses.fr: Et il lui dit: En vérité, en vérité, vous verrez désormais le ciel ouvert et les anges de Dieu monter et descendre sur le Fils de l''homme.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ከበለስ በታች አየሁህ ስላልሁህ አመንህን? ከዚህ የሚበልጥ ነገር ታያለህ አለው።

verses.en: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
verses.fr: Trois jours après, il y eut des noces à Cana en Galilée. La mère de Jésus était là,
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን በገሊላ ቃና ሰርግ ነበረ፥ የኢየሱስም እናት በዚያ ነበረች፤

verses.en: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
verses.fr: et Jésus fut aussi invité aux noces avec ses disciples.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ ሰርጉ ታደሙ።

verses.en: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
verses.fr: Le vin ayant manqué, la mère de Jésus lui dit: Ils n''ont plus de vin.
verses.am: የወይን ጠጅም ባለቀ ጊዜ የኢየሱስ እናት። የወይን ጠጅ እኮ የላቸውም አለችው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Femme, qu''y a-t-il entre moi et toi? Mon heure n''est pas encore venue.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። አንቺ ሴት፥ ከአንቺ ጋር ምን አለኝ? ጊዜዬ ገና አልደረሰም አላት።

verses.en: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
verses.fr: Sa mère dit aux serviteurs: Faites ce qu''il vous dira.
verses.am: እናቱም ለአገልጋዮቹ። የሚላችሁን ሁሉ አድርጉ አለቻቸው።

verses.en: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
verses.fr: Or, il y avait là six vases de pierre, destinés aux purifications des Juifs, et contenant chacun deux ou trois mesures.
verses.am: አይሁድም እንደሚያደርጉት የማንጻት ልማድ ስድስት የድንጋይ ጋኖች በዚያ ተቀምጠው ነበር፥ እያንዳንዳቸውም ሁለት ወይም ሦስት እንስራ ይይዙ ነበር።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Remplissez d''eau ces vases. Et ils les remplirent jusqu''au bord.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ጋኖቹን ውኃ ሙሉአቸው አላቸው። እስከ አፋቸውም ሙሉአቸው አላቸው። እስከ አፋቸውም ሞሉአቸው።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
verses.fr: Puisez maintenant, leur dit-il, et portez-en à l''ordonnateur du repas. Et ils en portèrent.
verses.am: አሁን ቀድታችሁ ለአሳዳሪው ስጡት አላቸው፤ ሰጡትም።

verses.en: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
verses.fr: Quand l''ordonnateur du repas eut goûté l''eau changée en vin,-ne sachant d''où venait ce vin, tandis que les serviteurs, qui avaient puisé l''eau, le savaient bien, -il appela l''époux,
verses.am: አሳዳሪውም የወይን ጠጅ የሆነውን ውሃ በቀመሰ ጊዜ ከወዴት እንደ መጣ አላወቀም፤ ውኃውን የቀዱት አገልጋዮች ግን ያውቁ ነበር፤ አሳዳሪው ሙሽራውን ጠርቶ።

verses.en: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
verses.fr: et lui dit: Tout homme sert d''abord le bon vin, puis le moins bon après qu''on s''est enivré; toi, tu as gardé le bon vin jusqu''à présent.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ አስቀድሞ መልካሙን የወይን ጠጅ ያቀርባል፥ ከሰከሩም በኋላ መናኛውን፤ አንተስ መልካሙን የወይን ጠጅ እስከ አሁን አቆይተሃል አለው።

verses.en: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
verses.fr: Tel fut, à Cana en Galilée, le premier des miracles que fit Jésus. Il manifesta sa gloire, et ses disciples crurent en lui.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ይህን የምልክቶች መጀመሪያ በገሊላ ቃና አደረገ፤ ክብሩንም ገለጠ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም በእርሱ አመኑ።

verses.en: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
verses.fr: Après cela, il descendit à Capernaüm, avec sa mère, ses frères et ses disciples, et ils n''y demeurèrent que peu de jours.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ከእናቱና ከወንድሞቹ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ጋር ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ወረደ፥ በዚያም ጥቂት ቀን ኖሩ።

verses.en: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: La Pâque des Juifs était proche, et Jésus monta à Jérusalem.
verses.am: የአይሁድ ፋሲካም ቀርቦ ነበር፥ ኢየሱስም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣ።

verses.en: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
verses.fr: Il trouva dans le temple les vendeurs de boeufs, de brebis et de pigeons, et les changeurs assis.
verses.am: በመቅደስም በሬዎችንና በጎችን ርግቦችንም የሚሸጡትን ገንዘብ ለዋጮችንም ተቀምጠው አገኘ፤

verses.en: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;
verses.fr: Ayant fait un fouet avec des cordes, il les chassa tous du temple, ainsi que les brebis et les boeufs; il dispersa la monnaie des changeurs, et renversa les tables;
verses.am: የገመድም ጅራፍ አበጅቶ ሁሉን በጎችንም በሬዎችንም ከመቅደስ አወጣቸው፥ የለዋጮችንም ገንዘብ አፈሰሰ ገበታዎቻቸውንም ገለበጠ፥

verses.en: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
verses.fr: et il dit aux vendeurs de pigeons: Otez cela d''ici, ne faites pas de la maison de mon Père une maison de trafic.
verses.am: ርግብ ሻጪዎችንም። ይህን ከዚህ ውሰዱ፤ የአባቴን ቤት የንግድ ቤት አታድርጉት አላቸው።

verses.en: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
verses.fr: Ses disciples se souvinrent qu''il est écrit: Le zèle de ta maison me dévore.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። የቤትህ ቅናት ይበላኛል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ አሰቡ።

verses.en: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
verses.fr: Les Juifs, prenant la parole, lui dirent: Quel miracle nous montres-tu, pour agir de la sorte?
verses.am: ስለዚህ አይሁድ መልሰው። ይህን ስለምታደርግ ምን ምልክት ታሳየናለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Détruisez ce temple, et en trois jours je le relèverai.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ይህን ቤተ መቅደስ አፍርሱት፥ በሦስት ቀንም አነሣዋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
verses.fr: Les Juifs dirent: Il a fallu quarante-six ans pour bâtir ce temple, et toi, en trois jours tu le relèveras!
verses.am: ስለዚህ አይሁድ። ይህ ቤተ መቅደስ ከአርባ ስድስት ዓመት ጀምሮ ይሠራ ነበር፥ አንተስ በሦስት ቀን ታነሣዋለህን? አሉት።

verses.en: But he spake of the temple of his body.
verses.fr: Mais il parlait du temple de son corps.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ስለ ሰውነቱ ቤተ መቅደስ ይል ነበር።

verses.en: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, lorsqu''il fut ressuscité des morts, ses disciples se souvinrent qu''il avait dit cela, et ils crurent à l''Ecriture et à la parole que Jésus avait dite.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከሙታን ከተነሣ በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ይህን እንደ ተናገረ አሰቡና መጽሐፍንና ኢየሱስ የተናገረውን ቃል አመኑ።

verses.en: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
verses.fr: Pendant que Jésus était à Jérusalem, à la fête de Pâque, plusieurs crurent en son nom, voyant les miracles qu''il faisait.
verses.am: በፋሲካ በዓልም በኢየሩሳሌም ሳለ፥ ያደረገውን ምልክት ባዩ ጊዜ ብዙ ሰዎች በስሙ አመኑ፤

verses.en: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
verses.fr: Mais Jésus ne se fiait point à eux, parce qu''il les connaissait tous,

verses.en: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
verses.fr: et parce qu''il n''avait pas besoin qu''on lui rendît témoignage d''aucun homme; car il savait lui-même ce qui était dans l''homme.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ኢየሱስ ሰዎችን ሁሉ ያውቅ ነበር፤ ስለ ሰውም ማንም ሊመሰክር አያስፈልገውም ነበርና አይተማመናቸውም ነበር፤ ራሱ በሰው ያለውን ያውቅ ነበርና።

verses.en: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
verses.fr: Mais il y eut un homme d''entre les pharisiens, nommé Nicodème, un chef des Juifs,
verses.am: ከፈሪሳውያንም ወገን የአይሁድ አለቃ የሆነ ኒቆዲሞስ የሚባል አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤ እርሱም በሌሊት ወደ ኢየሱስ መጥቶ።

verses.en: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
verses.fr: qui vint, lui, auprès de Jésus, de nuit, et lui dit: Rabbi, nous savons que tu es un docteur venu de Dieu; car personne ne peut faire ces miracles que tu fais, si Dieu n''est avec lui.
verses.am: መምህር ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ከሆነ በቀር አንተ የምታደርጋቸውን እነዚህን ምልክቶች ሊያደርግ የሚችል የለምና መምህር ሆነህ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ እንደ መጣህ እናውቃለን አለው።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: En vérité, en vérité, je te le dis, si un homme ne naît de nouveau, il ne peut voir le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ሰው ዳግመኛ ካልተወለደ በቀር የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ሊያይ አይችልም አለው።

verses.en: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
verses.fr: Nicodème lui dit: Comment un homme peut-il naître quand il est vieux? Peut-il rentrer dans le sein de sa mère et naître?
verses.am: ኒቆዲሞስም። ሰው ከሸመገለ በኋላ እንዴት ሊወለድ ይችላል? ሁለተኛ ወደ እናቱ ማኅፀን ገብቶ ይወለድ ዘንድ ይችላልን? አለው።

verses.en: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: En vérité, en vérité, je te le dis, si un homme ne naît d''eau et d''Esprit, il ne peut entrer dans le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ሰው ከውኃና ከመንፈስ ካልተወለደ በቀር ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ሊገባ አይችልም።

verses.en: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.fr: Ce qui est né de la chair est chair, et ce qui est né de l''Esprit est esprit.
verses.am: ከሥጋ የተወለደ ሥጋ ነው፥ ከመንፈስም የተወለደ መንፈስ ነው።

verses.en: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
verses.fr: Ne t''étonne pas que je t''aie dit: Il faut que vous naissiez de nouveau.
verses.am: ዳግመኛ ልትወለዱ ያስፈልጋችኋል ስላልሁህ አታድንቅ።

verses.en: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
verses.fr: Le vent souffle où il veut, et tu en entends le bruit; mais tu ne sais d''où il vient, ni où il va. Il en est ainsi de tout homme qui est né de l''Esprit.
verses.am: ነፋስ ወደሚወደው ይነፍሳል፥ ድምፁንም ትሰማለህ፥ ነገር ግን ከወዴት እንደ መጣ ወዴትም እንዲሄድ አታውቅም፤ ከመንፈስ የተወለደ ሁሉ እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
verses.fr: Nicodème lui dit: Comment cela peut-il se faire?
verses.am: ኒቆዲሞስ መልሶ። ይህ እንዴት ሊሆን ይችላል? አለው።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Tu es le docteur d''Israël, et tu ne sais pas ces choses!
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው። አንተ የእስራኤል መምህር ስትሆን ይህን አታውቅምን?

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je te le dis, nous disons ce que nous savons, et nous rendons témoignage de ce que nous avons vu; et vous ne recevez pas notre témoignage.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ የምናውቀውን እንናገራለን ያየነውንም እንመሰክራለን፥ ምስክራችንንም አትቀበሉትም።

verses.en: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
verses.fr: Si vous ne croyez pas quand je vous ai parlé des choses terrestres, comment croirez-vous quand je vous parlerai des choses célestes?
verses.am: ስለ ምድራዊ ነገር በነገርኋችሁ ጊዜ ካላመናችሁ፥ ስለ ሰማያዊ ነገር ብነግራችሁ እንዴት ታምናላችሁ?

verses.en: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
verses.fr: Personne n''est monté au ciel, si ce n''est celui qui est descendu du ciel, le Fils de l''homme qui est dans le ciel.
verses.am: ከሰማይም ከወረደ በቀር ወደ ሰማይ የወጣ ማንም የለም፥ እርሱም በሰማይ የሚኖረው የሰው ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
verses.fr: Et comme Moïse éleva le serpent dans le désert, il faut de même que le Fils de l''homme soit élevé,
verses.am: በእርሱ የሚያምን ሁሉ የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዲኖረው እንጂ እንዳይጠፋ እግዚአብሔር አንድያ ልጁን እስኪሰጥ ድረስ ዓለሙን እንዲሁ ወዶአልና።

verses.en: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.fr: afin que quiconque croit en lui ait la vie éternelle.
verses.am: በእርሱ የሚያምን ሁሉ የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዲኖረው እንጂ እንዳይጠፋ እግዚአብሔር አንድያ ልጁን እስኪሰጥ ድረስ ዓለሙን እንዲሁ ወዶአልና።

verses.en: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.fr: Car Dieu a tant aimé le monde qu''il a donné son Fils unique, afin que quiconque croit en lui ne périsse point, mais qu''il ait la vie éternelle.
verses.am: ዓለም በልጁ እንዲድን ነው እንጂ፥ በዓለም እንዲፈርድ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ዓለም አልላከውምና።

verses.en: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verses.fr: Dieu, en effet, n''a pas envoyé son Fils dans le monde pour qu''il juge le monde, mais pour que le monde soit sauvé par lui.
verses.am: በእርሱ በሚያምን አይፈረድበትም፤ በማያምን ግን በአንዱ በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ስም ስላላመነ አሁን ተፈርዶበታል።

verses.en: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
verses.fr: Celui qui croit en lui n''est point jugé; mais celui qui ne croit pas est déjà jugé, parce qu''il n''a pas cru au nom du Fils unique de Dieu.
verses.am: ብርሃንም ወደ ዓለም ስለ መጣ ሰዎችም ሥራቸው ክፉ ነበርና ከብርሃን ይልቅ ጨለማን ስለ ወደዱ ፍርዱ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
verses.fr: Et ce jugement c''est que, la lumière étant venue dans le monde, les hommes ont préféré les ténèbres à la lumière, parce que leurs oeuvres étaient mauvaises.
verses.am: ክፉ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ብርሃንን ይጠላልና፥ ሥራውም እንዳይገለጥ ወደ ብርሃን አይመጣም፤

verses.en: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
verses.fr: Car quiconque fait le mal hait la lumière, et ne vient point à la lumière, de peur que ses oeuvres ne soient dévoilées;
verses.am: እውነትን የሚያደርግ ግን ሥራው በእግዚአብሔር ተደርጎ እንደ ሆነ ይገለጥ ዘንድ ወደ ብርሃን ይመጣል።

verses.en: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
verses.fr: mais celui qui agit selon la vérité vient à la lumière, afin que ses oeuvres soient manifestées, parce qu''elles sont faites en Dieu.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ይሁዳ አገር መጣ፥ በዚያም ከእነርሱ ጋር ተቀምጦ ያጠምቅ ነበር።

verses.en: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
verses.fr: Après cela, Jésus, accompagné de ses disciples, se rendit dans la terre de Judée; et là il demeurait avec eux, et il baptisait.
verses.am: ዮሐንስም ደግሞ በሳሌም አቅራቢያ በሄኖን በዚያ ብዙ ውኃ ነበርና ያጠምቅ ነበር፥

verses.en: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
verses.fr: Jean aussi baptisait à Enon, près de Salim, parce qu''il y avait là beaucoup d''eau; et on y venait pour être baptisé.
verses.am: እየመጡም ይጠመቁ ነበር ዮሐንስ ገና ወደ ወኅኒ አልተጨመረም ነበርና።

verses.en: For John was not yet cast into prison.
verses.fr: Car Jean n''avait pas encore été mis en prison.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርትና በአይሁድ መካከል ስለ ማንጻት ክርክር ሆነ።

verses.en: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.
verses.fr: Or, il s''éleva de la part des disciples de Jean une dispute avec un Juif touchant la purification.
verses.am: ወደ ዮሐንስም መጥተው። መምህር ሆይ፥ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ከአንተ ጋር የነበረው አንተም የመሰከርህለት፥ እነሆ፥ እርሱ ያጠምቃል ሁሉም ወደ እርሱ ይመጣሉ አሉት።

verses.en: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
verses.fr: Ils vinrent trouver Jean, et lui dirent: Rabbi, celui qui était avec toi au delà du Jourdain, et à qui tu as rendu témoignage, voici, il baptise, et tous vont à lui.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። ከሰማይ ካልተሰጠው ሰው እንዳች ሊቀበል አይችልም።

verses.en: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
verses.fr: Jean répondit: Un homme ne peut recevoir que ce qui lui a été donné du ciel.
verses.am: እናንተ። እኔ ክርስቶስ አይደለሁም፥ ነገር ግን። ከእርሱ በፊት ተልኬአለሁ እንዳልሁ ራሳችሁ ትመሰክሩልኛላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
verses.fr: Vous-mêmes m''êtes témoins que j''ai dit: Je ne suis pas le Christ, mais j''ai été envoyé devant lui.
verses.am: ሙሽራይቱ ያለችው እርሱ ሙሽራ ነው፤ ቆሞ የሚሰማው ሚዜው ግን በሙሽራው ድምጽ እጅግ ደስ ይለዋል። እንግዲህ ይህ ደስታዬ ተፈጸመ።

verses.en: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
verses.fr: Celui à qui appartient l''épouse, c''est l''époux; mais l''ami de l''époux, qui se tient là et qui l''entend, éprouve une grande joie à cause de la voix de l''époux: aussi cette joie, qui est la mienne, est parfaite.
verses.am: እርሱ ሊልቅ እኔ ግን ላንስ ያስፈልጋል።

verses.en: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.fr: Il faut qu''il croisse, et que je diminue.
verses.am: ከላይ የሚመጣው ከሁሉ በላይ ነው፤ ከምድር የሚሆነው የምድር ነው የምድሩንም ይናገራል። ከሰማይ የሚመጣው ከሁሉ በላይ ነው።

verses.en: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
verses.fr: Celui qui vient d''en haut est au-dessus de tous; celui qui est de la terre est de la terre, et il parle comme étant de la terre. Celui qui vient du ciel est au-dessus de tous,
verses.am: ያየውንና የሰማውንም ይህን ይመሰክራል፥ ምስክሩንም የሚቀበለው የለም።

verses.en: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
verses.fr: il rend témoignage de ce qu''il a vu et entendu, et personne ne reçoit son témoignage.
verses.am: ምስክሩን የተቀበለ እግዚአብሔር እውነተኛ እንደ ሆነ አተመ።

verses.en: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
verses.fr: Celui qui a reçu son témoignage a certifié que Dieu est vrai;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የላከው የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ይናገራልና፤ እግዚአብሔር መንፈሱን ሰፍሮ አይሰጥምና።

verses.en: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
verses.fr: car celui que Dieu a envoyé dit les paroles de Dieu, parce que Dieu ne lui donne pas l''Esprit avec mesure.
verses.am: አባት ልጁን ይወዳል ሁሉንም በእጁ ሰጥቶታል።

verses.en: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
verses.fr: Le Père aime le Fils, et il a remis toutes choses entre ses mains.
verses.am: በልጁ የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፤ በልጁ የማያምን ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በእርሱ ላይ ይኖራል እንጂ ሕይወትን አያይም።

verses.en: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
verses.fr: Celui qui croit au Fils a la vie éternelle; celui qui ne croit pas au Fils ne verra point la vie, mais la colère de Dieu demeure sur lui.
verses.am: በልጁ የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፤ በልጁ የማያምን ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በእርሱ ላይ ይኖራል እንጂ ሕይወትን አያይም።

verses.en: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
verses.fr: Le Seigneur sut que les pharisiens avaient appris qu''il faisait et baptisait plus de disciples que Jean.
verses.am: እንግዲህ። ኢየሱስ ከዮሐንስ ይልቅ ደቀ መዛሙርት ያደርጋል ያጠምቅማል ማለትን ፈሪሳውያን እንደ ሰሙ ጌታ ባወቀ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
verses.fr: Toutefois Jésus ne baptisait pas lui-même, mais c''étaient ses disciples.

verses.en: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
verses.fr: Alors il quitta la Judée, et retourna en Galilée.
verses.am: ይሁዳን ትቶ ወደ ገሊላ ደግሞ ሄደ፤ ዳሩ ግን ደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንጂ ኢየሱስ ራሱ አላጠመቀም።

verses.en: And he must needs go through Samaria.
verses.fr: Comme il fallait qu''il passât par la Samarie,
verses.am: በሰማርያም ሊያልፍ ግድ ሆነበት።

verses.en: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.fr: il arriva dans une ville de Samarie, nommée Sychar, près du champ que Jacob avait donné à Joseph, son fils.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ያዕቆብ ለልጁ ለዮሴፍ በሰጠው ስፍራ አጠገብ ወደምትሆን ሲካር ወደምትባል የሰማርያ ከተማ መጣ፤

verses.en: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
verses.fr: Là se trouvait le puits de Jacob. Jésus, fatigué du voyage, était assis au bord du puits. C''était environ la sixième heure.
verses.am: በዚያም የያዕቆብ ጕድጓድ ነበረ። ኢየሱስም መንገድ ከመሄድ ደክሞ በጕድጓድ አጠገብ እንዲህ ተቀመጠ፤ ጊዜውም ስድስት ሰዓት ያህል ነበረ።

verses.en: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
verses.fr: Une femme de Samarie vint puiser de l''eau. Jésus lui dit: Donne-moi à boire.
verses.am: ከሰማርያ አንዲት ሴት ውኃ ልትቀዳ መጣች። ኢየሱስም። ውኃ አጠጪኝ አላት፤

verses.en: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
verses.fr: Car ses disciples étaient allés à la ville pour acheter des vivres.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ምግብ ሊገዙ ወደ ከተማ ሄደው ነበርና።

verses.en: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
verses.fr: La femme samaritaine lui dit: Comment toi, qui es Juif, me demandes-tu à boire, à moi qui suis une femme samaritaine? -Les Juifs, en effet, n''ont pas de relations avec les Samaritains. -
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሳምራዊቲቱ። አንተ የይሁዳ ሰው ስትሆን ሳምራዊት ሴት ከምሆን ከእኔ መጠጥ እንዴት ትለምናለህ? አለችው፤ አይሁድ ከሳምራውያን ጋር አይተባበሩም ነበርና።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Si tu connaissais le don de Dieu et qui est celui qui te dit: Donne-moi à boire! tu lui aurais toi-même demandé à boire, et il t''aurait donné de l''eau vive.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መልሶ። የእግዚአብሔርን ስጦታና። ውኃ አጠጪኝ የሚልሽ ማን መሆኑንስ ብታውቂ፥ አንቺ ትለምኚው ነበርሽ የሕይወትም ውኃ ይሰጥሽ ነበር አላት።

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
verses.fr: Seigneur, lui dit la femme, tu n''as rien pour puiser, et le puits est profond; d''où aurais-tu donc cette eau vive?
verses.am: ሴቲቱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ መቅጃ የለህም ጕድጓዱም ጥልቅ ነው፤ እንግዲህ የሕይወት ውኃ ከወዴት ታገኛለህ?

verses.en: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
verses.fr: Es-tu plus grand que notre père Jacob, qui nous a donné ce puits, et qui en a bu lui-même, ainsi que ses fils et ses troupeaux?
verses.am: በእውኑ አንተ ይህን ጕድጓድ ከሰጠን ከአባታችን ከያዕቆብ ትበልጣለህን? ራሱም ልጆቹም ከብቶቹም ከዚህ ጠጥተዋል አለችው።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Quiconque boit de cette eau aura encore soif;
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ከዚህ ውኃ የሚጠጣ ሁሉ እንደ ገና ይጠማል፤

verses.en: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verses.fr: mais celui qui boira de l''eau que je lui donnerai n''aura jamais soif, et l''eau que je lui donnerai deviendra en lui une source d''eau qui jaillira jusque dans la vie éternelle.
verses.am: እኔ ከምሰጠው ውኃ የሚጠጣ ሁሉ ግን ለዘላለም አይጠማም፥ እኔ የምሰጠው ውኃ በእርሱ ውስጥ ለዘላለም ሕይወት የሚፈልቅ የውኃ ምንጭ ይሆናል እንጂ አላት።

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
verses.fr: La femme lui dit: Seigneur, donne-moi cette eau, afin que je n''aie plus soif, et que je ne vienne plus puiser ici.
verses.am: ሴቲቱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እንዳልጠማ ውኃም ልቀዳ ወደዚህ እንዳልመጣ ይህን ውኃ ስጠኝ አለችው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
verses.fr: Va, lui dit Jésus, appelle ton mari, et viens ici.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ሂጂና ባልሽን ጠርተሽ ወደዚህ ነዪ አላት።

verses.en: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
verses.fr: La femme répondit: Je n''ai point de mari. Jésus lui dit: Tu as eu raison de dire: Je n''ai point de mari.
verses.am: ሴቲቱ መልሳ። ባል የለኝም አለችው። ኢየሱስ። ባል የለኝም በማለትሽ መልካም ተናገርሽ፤

verses.en: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
verses.fr: Car tu as eu cinq maris, et celui que tu as maintenant n''est pas ton mari. En cela tu as dit vrai.
verses.am: አምስት ባሎች ነበሩሽና፥ አሁን ከአንቺ ጋር ያለው ባልሽ አይደለም፤ በዚህስ እውነት ተናገርሽ አላት።

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
verses.fr: Seigneur, lui dit la femme, je vois que tu es prophète.
verses.am: ሴቲቱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ነቢይ እንደ ሆንህ አያለሁ።

verses.en: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
verses.fr: Nos pères ont adoré sur cette montagne; et vous dites, vous, que le lieu où il faut adorer est à Jérusalem.
verses.am: አባቶቻችን በዚህ ተራራ ሰገዱ፤ እናንተም። ሰው ሊሰግድበት የሚገባው ስፍራ በኢየሩሳሌም ነው ትላላችሁ አለችው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
verses.fr: Femme, lui dit Jésus, crois-moi, l''heure vient où ce ne sera ni sur cette montagne ni à Jérusalem que vous adorerez le Père.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላት። አንቺ ሴት፥ እመኚኝ፥ በዚህ ተራራ ወይም በኢየሩሳሌም ለአብ የማትሰግዱበት ጊዜ ይመጣል።

verses.en: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
verses.fr: Vous adorez ce que vous ne connaissez pas; nous, nous adorons ce que nous connaissons, car le salut vient des Juifs.
verses.am: እናንተስ ለማታውቁት ትሰግዳላችሁ፤ እኛ መዳን ከአይሁድ ነውና ለምናውቀው እንሰግዳለን።

verses.en: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
verses.fr: Mais l''heure vient, et elle est déjà venue, où les vrais adorateurs adoreront le Père en esprit et en vérité; car ce sont là les adorateurs que le Père demande.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእውነት የሚሰግዱ ለአብ በመንፈስና በእውነት የሚሰግዱበት ጊዜ ይመጣል አሁንም ሆኖአል፤ አብ ሊሰግዱለት እንደ እነዚህ ያሉትን ይሻልና፤

verses.en: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
verses.fr: Dieu est Esprit, et il faut que ceux qui l''adorent l''adorent en esprit et en vérité.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ነው፥ የሚሰግዱለትም በመንፈስና በእውነት ሊሰግዱለት ያስፈልጋቸዋል።

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
verses.fr: La femme lui dit: Je sais que le Messie doit venir celui qu''on appelle Christ; quand il sera venu, il nous annoncera toutes choses.
verses.am: ሴቲቱ። ክርስቶስ የሚባል መሲሕ እንዲመጣ አውቃለሁ፤ እርሱ ሲመጣ ሁሉን ይነግረናል አለችው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Je le suis, moi qui te parle.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ። የምናገርሽ እኔ እርሱ ነኝ አላት።

verses.en: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
verses.fr: Là-dessus arrivèrent ses disciples, qui furent étonnés de ce qu''il parlait avec une femme. Toutefois aucun ne dit: Que demandes-tu? ou: De quoi parles-tu avec elle?
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጡና ከሴት ጋር በመነጋገሩ ተደነቁ፤ ነገር ግን። ምን ትፈልጊያለሽ? ወይም። ስለ ምን ትናገራታለህ? ያለ ማንም አልነበረም።

verses.en: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
verses.fr: Alors la femme, ayant laissé sa cruche, s''en alla dans la ville, et dit aux gens:
verses.am: ሴቲቱም እንስራዋን ትታ ወደ ከተማ ሄደች ለሰዎችም።

verses.en: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
verses.fr: Venez voir un homme qui m''a dit tout ce que j''ai fait; ne serait-ce point le Christ?
verses.am: ያደረግሁትን ሁሉ የነገረኝን ሰው ኑና እዩ፤ እንጃ እርሱ ክርስቶስ ይሆንን? አለች።

verses.en: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
verses.fr: Ils sortirent de la ville, et ils vinrent vers lui.
verses.am: ከከተማ ወጥተው ወደ እርሱ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
verses.fr: Pendant ce temps, les disciples le pressaient de manger, disant: Rabbi, mange.
verses.am: ይህም ሲሆን ሳለ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ብላ ብለው ለመኑት።

verses.en: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
verses.fr: Mais il leur dit: J''ai à manger une nourriture que vous ne connaissez pas.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። እናንተ የማታውቁት የምበላው መብል ለእኔ አለኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
verses.fr: Les disciples se disaient donc les uns aux autres: Quelqu''un lui aurait-il apporté à manger?
verses.am: ስለዚህ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። የሚበላው አንዳች ሰው አምጥቶለት ይሆንን? ተባባሉ።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Ma nourriture est de faire la volonté de celui qui m''a envoyé, et d''accomplir son oeuvre.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። የእኔስ መብል የላከኝን ፈቃድ አደርግ ዘንድ ሥራውንም እፈጽም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
verses.fr: Ne dites-vous pas qu''il y a encore quatre mois jusqu''à la moisson? Voici, je vous le dis, levez les yeux, et regardez les champs qui déjà blanchissent pour la moisson.
verses.am: እናንተ። ገና አራት ወር ቀርቶአል መከርም ይመጣል ትሉ የለምን? እነሆ እላችኋለሁ፥ ዓይናችሁን አንሡ አዝመራውም አሁን እንደ ነጣ እርሻውን ተመልከቱ።

verses.en: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
verses.fr: Celui qui moissonne reçoit un salaire, et amasse des fruits pour la vie éternelle, afin que celui qui sème et celui qui moissonne se réjouissent ensemble.
verses.am: የሚያጭድ ደመወዝን ይቀበላል፥ የሚዘራና የሚያጭድም አብረው ደስ እንዲላቸው ለዘላለም ሕይወት ፍሬን ይሰበስባል።

verses.en: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
verses.fr: Car en ceci ce qu''on dit est vrai: Autre est celui qui sème, et autre celui qui moissonne.
verses.am: አንዱ ይዘራል አንዱም ያጭዳል የሚለው ቃል በዚህ እውነት ሆኖአልና።

verses.en: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
verses.fr: Je vous ai envoyés moissonner ce que vous n''avez pas travaillé; d''autres ont travaillé, et vous êtes entrés dans leur travail.
verses.am: እኔም እናንተ ያልደከማችሁበትን ታጭዱ ዘንድ ሰደድኋችሁ፤ ሌሎች ደከሙ እናንተም በድካማቸው ገባችሁ።

verses.en: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
verses.fr: Plusieurs Samaritains de cette ville crurent en Jésus à cause de cette déclaration formelle de la femme: Il m''a dit tout ce que j''ai fait.
verses.am: ሴቲቱም። ያደረግሁትን ሁሉ ነገረኝ ብላ ስለ መሰከረችው ቃል ከዚያች ከተማ የሰማርያ ሰዎች ብዙ አመኑበት።

verses.en: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
verses.fr: Aussi, quand les Samaritains vinrent le trouver, ils le prièrent de rester auprès d''eux. Et il resta là deux jours.
verses.am: የሰማርያ ሰዎችም ወደ እርሱ በመጡ ጊዜ በእነርሱ ዘንድ እንዲኖር ለመኑት፤ በዚያም ሁለት ቀን ያህል ኖረ።

verses.en: And many more believed because of his own word;
verses.fr: Un beaucoup plus grand nombre crurent à cause de sa parole;
verses.am: ስለ ቃሉ ከፊተኞች ይልቅ ብዙ ሰዎች አመኑ፤

verses.en: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
verses.fr: et ils disaient à la femme: Ce n''est plus à cause de ce que tu as dit que nous croyons; car nous l''avons entendu nous-mêmes, et nous savons qu''il est vraiment le Sauveur du monde.
verses.am: ሴቲቱንም። አሁን የምናምን ስለ ቃልሽ አይደለም፥ እኛ ራሳችን ሰምተነዋልና፤ እርሱም በእውነት ክርስቶስ የዓለም መድኃኒት እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን ይሉአት ነበር።

verses.en: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
verses.fr: Après ces deux jours, Jésus partit de là, pour se rendre en Galilée;
verses.am: ከሁለቱ ቀኖችም በኋላ ከዚያ ወጥቶ ወደ ገሊላ ሄደ።

verses.en: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
verses.fr: car il avait déclaré lui-même qu''un prophète n''est pas honoré dans sa propre patrie.
verses.am: ነቢይ በገዛ አገሩ እንዳይከበር ኢየሱስ ራሱ መስክሮአልና።

verses.en: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il arriva en Galilée, il fut bien reçu des Galiléens, qui avaient vu tout ce qu''il avait fait à Jérusalem pendant la fête; car eux aussi étaient allés à la fête.
verses.am: ወደ ገሊላም በመጣ ጊዜ፥ የገሊላ ሰዎች ራሳቸው ደግሞ ለበዓል መጥተው ነበርና በበዓል በኢየሩሳሌም ያደረገውን ሁሉ ስላዩ ተቀበሉት።

verses.en: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.fr: Il retourna donc à Cana en Galilée, où il avait changé l''eau en vin. Il y avait à Capernaüm un officier du roi, dont le fils était malade.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ውኃውን የወይን ጠጅ ወዳደረገባት ወደ ገሊላ ቃና ዳግመኛ መጣ። በቅፍርናሆምም ልጁ የታመመበት ከንጉሥ ቤት አንድ ሹም ነበረ።

verses.en: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
verses.fr: Ayant appris que Jésus était venu de Judée en Galilée, il alla vers lui, et le pria de descendre et de guérir son fils, qui était près de mourir.
verses.am: እርሱም ኢየሱስ ከይሁዳ ወደ ገሊላ እንደ መጣ ሰምቶ ልጁ ሊሞት ስላለው ወደ እርሱ ሄደ ወርዶም እንዲፈውስለት ለመነው።

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Si vous ne voyez des miracles et des prodiges, vous ne croyez point.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ኢየሱስ። ምልክትና ድንቅ ነገር ካላያችሁ ከቶ አታምኑም አለው።

verses.en: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
verses.fr: L''officier du roi lui dit: Seigneur, descends avant que mon enfant meure.
verses.am: ሹሙም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ብላቴናዬ ሳይሞት ውረድ አለው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
verses.fr: Va, lui dit Jésus, ton fils vit. Et cet homme crut à la parole que Jésus lui avait dite, et il s''en alla.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ሂድ፤ ልጅህ በሕይወት አለ አለው። ሰውዬውም ኢየሱስ የነገረውን ቃል አምኖ ሄደ።

verses.en: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
verses.fr: Comme déjà il descendait, ses serviteurs venant à sa rencontre, lui apportèrent cette nouvelle: Ton enfant vit.
verses.am: እርሱም ሲወርድ ሳለ ባሮቹ ተገናኙትና። ብላቴናህ በሕይወት አለ ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
verses.fr: Il leur demanda à quelle heure il s''était trouvé mieux; et ils lui dirent: Hier, à la septième heure, la fièvre l''a quitté.
verses.am: እርሱም በጎ የሆነበትን ሰዓት ጠየቃቸው፤ እነርሱም። ትናንት በሰባት ሰዓት ንዳዱ ለቀቀው አሉት።

verses.en: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
verses.fr: Le père reconnut que c''était à cette heure-là que Jésus lui avait dit: Ton fils vit. Et il crut, lui et toute sa maison.
verses.am: አባቱም ኢየሱስ። ልጅህ በሕይወት አለ ባለው በዚያ ሰዓት እንደ ሆነ አወቀ፤ እርሱም ከቤተ ሰዎቹ ሁሉ ጋር አመነ።

verses.en: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
verses.fr: Jésus fit encore ce second miracle lorsqu''il fut venu de Judée en Galilée.
verses.am: ይህም ደግሞ ኢየሱስ ከይሁዳ ወደ ገሊላ መጥቶ ያደረገው ሁለተኛ ምልክት ነው።

verses.en: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Après cela, il y eut une fête des Juifs, et Jésus monta à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ የአይሁድ በዓል ነበረ፥ ኢየሱስም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣ።

verses.en: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
verses.fr: Or, à Jérusalem, près de la porte des brebis, il y a une piscine qui s''appelle en hébreu Béthesda, et qui a cinq portiques.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም በበጎች በር አጠገብ በዕብራይስጥ ቤተ ሳይዳ የምትባል አንዲት መጠመቂያ ነበረች፤ አምስትም መመላለሻ ነበረባት።

verses.en: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
verses.fr: Sous ces portiques étaient couchés en grand nombre des malades, des aveugles, des boiteux, des paralytiques, qui attendaient le mouvement de l''eau;
verses.am: በእነዚህ ውስጥ የውኃውን መንቀሳቀስ እየጠበቁ በሽተኞችና ዕውሮች አንካሶችም ሰውነታቸውም የሰለለ ብዙ ሕዝብ ይተኙ ነበር።

verses.en: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
verses.fr: car un ange descendait de temps en temps dans la piscine, et agitait l''eau; et celui qui y descendait le premier après que l''eau avait été agitée était guéri, quelle que fût sa maladie.
verses.am: አንዳንድ ጊዜ የጌታ መልአክ ወደ መጠመቂያይቱ ወርዶ ውኃውን ያናውጥ ነበርና፤ እንግዲህ ከውኃው መናወጥ በኋላ በመጀመሪያ የገባ ከማናቸው ካለበት ደዌ ጤናማ ይሆን ነበር።

verses.en: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
verses.fr: Là se trouvait un homme malade depuis trente-huit ans.
verses.am: በዚያም ከሠላሳ ስምንት ዓመት ጀምሮ የታመመ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.en: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
verses.fr: Jésus, l''ayant vu couché, et sachant qu''il était malade depuis longtemps, lui dit: Veux-tu être guéri?
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ይህን ሰው ተኝቶ ባየ ጊዜ፥ እስከ አሁን ብዙ ዘመን እንዲሁ እንደ ነበረ አውቆ። ልትድን ትወዳለህን? አለው።

verses.en: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
verses.fr: Le malade lui répondit: Seigneur, je n''ai personne pour me jeter dans la piscine quand l''eau est agitée, et, pendant que j''y vais, un autre descend avant moi.
verses.am: ድውዩም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ውኃው በተናወጠ ጊዜ በመጠመቂያይቱ ውስጥ የሚያኖረኝ ሰው የለኝም ነገር ግን እኔ ስመጣ ሳለሁ ሌላው ቀድሞኝ ይወርዳል ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, lui dit Jésus, prends ton lit, et marche.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ። ተነሣና አልጋህን ተሸክመህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
verses.fr: Aussitôt cet homme fut guéri; il prit son lit, et marcha. C''était un jour de sabbat.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ሰውዬው ዳነ አልጋውንም ተሸክሞ ሄደ።

verses.en: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
verses.fr: Les Juifs dirent donc à celui qui avait été guéri: C''est le sabbat; il ne t''est pas permis d''emporter ton lit.
verses.am: ያም ቀን ሰንበት ነበረ። ስለዚህ አይሁድ የተፈወሰውን ሰው። ሰንበት ነው አልጋህንም ልትሸከም አልተፈቀደልህም አሉት።

verses.en: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Celui qui m''a guéri m''a dit: Prends ton lit, et marche.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ያዳነኝ ያ ሰው። አልጋህን ተሸክመህ ሂድ አለኝ ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.en: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.fr: Ils lui demandèrent: Qui est l''homme qui t''a dit: Prends ton lit, et marche?
verses.am: እነርሱም። አልጋህን ተሸክመህ ሂድ ያለህ ሰው ማን ነው? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
verses.fr: Mais celui qui avait été guéri ne savait pas qui c''était; car Jésus avait disparu de la foule qui était en ce lieu.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን በዚያ ስፍራ ሕዝብ ሰለ ነበሩ ኢየሱስ ፈቀቅ ብሎ ነበርና የተፈወሰው ሰው ማን እንደ ሆነ አላወቀም።

verses.en: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
verses.fr: Depuis, Jésus le trouva dans le temple, et lui dit: Voici, tu as été guéri; ne pèche plus, de peur qu''il ne t''arrive quelque chose de pire.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ በመቅደስ አገኘውና። እነሆ፥ ድነሃል፤ ከዚህ የሚብስ እንዳይደርስብህ ወደ ፊት ኃጢአት አትሥራ አለው።

verses.en: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
verses.fr: Cet homme s''en alla, et annonça aux Juifs que c''était Jésus qui l''avait guéri.
verses.am: ሰውዬው ሄዶ ያዳነው ኢየሱስ እንደ ሆነ ለአይሁድ ነገረ።

verses.en: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi les Juifs poursuivaient Jésus, parce qu''il faisait ces choses le jour du sabbat.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በሰንበት ይህን ስላደረገ አይሁድ ኢየሱስን ያሳድዱት ነበር ሊገድሉትም ይፈልጉ ነበር።

verses.en: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus leur répondit: Mon Père agit jusqu''à présent; moi aussi, j''agis.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። አባቴ እስከ ዛሬ ይሠራል እኔም ደግሞ እሠራለሁ ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.en: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.fr: A cause de cela, les Juifs cherchaient encore plus à le faire mourir, non seulement parce qu''il violait le sabbat, mais parce qu''il appelait Dieu son propre Père, se faisant lui-même égal à Dieu.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሰንበትን ስለ ሻረ ብቻ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ደግሞ ራሱን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አስተካክሎ። እግዚአብሔር አባቴ ነው ስላለ፥ ስለዚህ አይሁድ ሊገድሉት አብዝተው ይፈልጉት ነበር።

verses.en: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
verses.fr: Jésus reprit donc la parole, et leur dit: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, le Fils ne peut rien faire de lui-même, il ne fait que ce qu''il voit faire au Père; et tout ce que le Père fait, le Fils aussi le fait pareillement.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ መለሰ እንዲህም አላቸው። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ አብ ሲያደርግ ያየውን ነው እንጂ ወልድ ከራሱ ሊያደርግ ምንም አይችልም፤ ያ የሚያደርገውን ሁሉ ወልድ ደግሞ ይህን እንዲሁ ያደርጋልና።

verses.en: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
verses.fr: Car le Père aime le Fils, et lui montre tout ce qu''il fait; et il lui montrera des oeuvres plus grandes que celles-ci, afin que vous soyez dans l''étonnement.
verses.am: አብ ወልድን ይወዳልና፥ የሚያደርገውንም ሁሉ ያሳየዋል፤ እናንተም ትደነቁ ዘንድ ከዚህ የሚበልጥ ሥራ ያሳየዋል።

verses.en: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
verses.fr: Car, comme le Père ressuscite les morts et donne la vie, ainsi le Fils donne la vie à qui il veut.
verses.am: አብ ሙታንን እንደሚያነሣ ሕይወትም እንደሚሰጣቸው፥ እንዲሁ ወልድ ደግሞ ለሚወዳቸው ሕይወትን ይሰጣቸዋል።

verses.en: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
verses.fr: Le Père ne juge personne, mais il a remis tout jugement au Fils,
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ቃሌን የሚሰማ የላከኝንም የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፥ ከሞትም ወደ ሕይወት ተሻገረ እንጂ ወደ ፍርድ አይመጣም።

verses.en: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
verses.fr: afin que tous honorent le Fils comme ils honorent le Père. Celui qui n''honore pas le Fils n''honore pas le Père qui l''a envoyé.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ቃሌን የሚሰማ የላከኝንም የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፥ ከሞትም ወደ ሕይወት ተሻገረ እንጂ ወደ ፍርድ አይመጣም።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, celui qui écoute ma parole, et qui croit à celui qui m''a envoyé, a la vie éternelle et ne vient point en jugement, mais il est passé de la mort à la vie.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ሙታን የእግዚአብሔርን ልጅ ድምፅ የሚሰሙበት ሰዓት ይመጣል እርሱም አሁን ነው፤ የሚሰሙትም በሕይወት ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, l''heure vient, et elle est déjà venue, où les morts entendront la voix du Fils de Dieu; et ceux qui l''auront entendue vivront.
verses.am: አብ በራሱ ሕይወት እንዳለው እንዲሁ ደግሞ ለወልድ በራሱ ሕይወት እንዲኖረው ሰጥቶታልና።

verses.en: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
verses.fr: Car, comme le Père a la vie en lui-même, ainsi il a donné au Fils d''avoir la vie en lui-même.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅም ስለ ሆነ ይፈርድ ዘንድ ሥልጣን ሰጠው።

verses.en: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
verses.fr: Et il lui a donné le pouvoir de juger, parce qu''il est Fils de l''homme.
verses.am: እኔ ከራሴ አንዳች ላደርግ አይቻለኝም፤ እንደ ሰማሁ እፈርዳለሁ ፍርዴም ቅን ነው፥ የላከኝን ፈቃድ እንጂ ፈቃዴን አልሻምና።

verses.en: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
verses.fr: Ne vous étonnez pas de cela; car l''heure vient où tous ceux qui sont dans les sépulcres entendront sa voix,
verses.am: እኔ ከራሴ አንዳች ላደርግ አይቻለኝም፤ እንደ ሰማሁ እፈርዳለሁ ፍርዴም ቅን ነው፥ የላከኝን ፈቃድ እንጂ ፈቃዴን አልሻምና።

verses.en: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
verses.fr: et en sortiront. Ceux qui auront fait le bien ressusciteront pour la vie, mais ceux qui auront fait le mal ressusciteront pour le jugement.
verses.am: እኔ ስለ እኔ ስለ ራሴ ብመሰክር ምስክሬ እውነት አይደለም፤

verses.en: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
verses.fr: Je ne puis rien faire de moi-même: selon que j''entends, je juge; et mon jugement est juste, parce que je ne cherche pas ma volonté, mais la volonté de celui qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: ስለ እኔ የሚመሰክር ሌላ ነው፥ እርሱም ስለ እኔ የሚመሰክረው ምስክር እውነት እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
verses.fr: Si c''est moi qui rends témoignage de moi-même, mon témoignage n''est pas vrai.
verses.am: እናንተ ወደ ዮሐንስ ልካችኋል እርሱም ለእውነት መስክሮአል።

verses.en: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
verses.fr: Il y en a un autre qui rend témoignage de moi, et je sais que le témoignage qu''il rend de moi est vrai.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ከሰው ምስክር አልቀበልም፥ እናንተ እንድትድኑ ይህን እላለሁ እንጂ።

verses.en: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
verses.fr: Vous avez envoyé vers Jean, et il a rendu témoignage à la vérité.
verses.am: እርሱ የሚነድና የሚያበራ መብራት ነበረ፥ እናንተም ጥቂት ዘመን በብርሃኑ ደስ ሊላችሁ ወደዳችሁ።

verses.en: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
verses.fr: Pour moi ce n''est pas d''un homme que je reçois le témoignage; mais je dis ceci, afin que vous soyez sauvés.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ከዮሐንስ ምስክር የሚበልጥ ምስክር አለኝ፤ አብ ልፈጽመው የሰጠኝ ሥራ፥ ይህ የማደርገው ሥራ፥ አብ እንደ ላከኝ ስለ እኔ ይመሰክራልና።

verses.en: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
verses.fr: Jean était la lampe qui brûle et qui luit, et vous avez voulu vous réjouir une heure à sa lumière.
verses.am: የላከኝ አብም እርሱ ስለ እኔ መስክሮአል። ድምፁን ከቶ አልሰማችሁም፥ መልኩንም አላያችሁም፤

verses.en: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
verses.fr: Moi, j''ai un témoignage plus grand que celui de Jean; car les oeuvres que le Père m''a donné d''accomplir, ces oeuvres mêmes que je fais, témoignent de moi que c''est le Père qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: እርሱም የላከውን እናንተ አታምኑምና በእናንተ ዘንድ የሚኖር ቃሉ የላችሁም።

verses.en: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
verses.fr: Et le Père qui m''a envoyé a rendu lui-même témoignage de moi. Vous n''avez jamais entendu sa voix, vous n''avez point vu sa face,
verses.am: እናንተ በመጻሕፍት የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዳላችሁ ይመስላችኋልና እነርሱን ትመረምራላችሁ፤ እነርሱም ስለ እኔ የሚመሰክሩ ናቸው፤

verses.en: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
verses.fr: et sa parole ne demeure point en vous, parce que vous ne croyez pas à celui qu''il a envoyé.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሕይወት እንዲሆንላችሁ ወደ እኔ ልትመጡ አትወዱም።

verses.en: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
verses.fr: Vous sondez les Ecritures, parce que vous pensez avoir en elles la vie éternelle: ce sont elles qui rendent témoignage de moi.
verses.am: እኔ በአባቴ ስም መጥቻለሁ አልተቀበላችሁኝምም፤ ሌላው በራሱ ስም ቢመጣ እርሱን ትቀበሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
verses.fr: Et vous ne voulez pas venir à moi pour avoir la vie!
verses.am: እኔ በአባቴ ስም መጥቻለሁ አልተቀበላችሁኝምም፤ ሌላው በራሱ ስም ቢመጣ እርሱን ትቀበሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: I receive not honour from men.
verses.fr: Je ne tire pas ma gloire des hommes.
verses.am: እናንተ እርስ በርሳችሁ ክብር የምትቀባበሉ ከአንዱም ከእግዚአብሔር ያለውን ክብር የማትፈልጉ፥ እንዴት ልታምኑ ትችላላችሁ?

verses.en: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
verses.fr: Mais je sais que vous n''avez point en vous l''amour de Dieu.
verses.am: እኔ በአብ ዘንድ የምከሳችሁ አይምሰላችሁ፤ የሚከሳችሁ አለ፤ እርሱም ተስፋ የምታደርጉት ሙሴ ነው።

verses.en: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
verses.fr: Je suis venu au nom de mon Père, et vous ne me recevez pas; si un autre vient en son propre nom, vous le recevrez.
verses.am: ሙሴንስ ብታምኑት እኔን ባመናችሁ ነበር፤ እርሱ ስለ እኔ ጽፎአልና።

verses.en: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
verses.fr: Comment pouvez-vous croire, vous qui tirez votre gloire les uns des autres, et qui ne cherchez point la gloire qui vient de Dieu seul?
verses.am: መጻሕፍትን ካላመናችሁ ግን ቃሌን እንዴት ታምናላችሁ?

verses.en: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
verses.fr: Ne pensez pas que moi je vous accuserai devant le Père; celui qui vous accuse, c''est Moïse, en qui vous avez mis votre espérance.
verses.am: እኔ በአብ ዘንድ የምከሳችሁ አይምሰላችሁ፤ የሚከሳችሁ አለ፤ እርሱም ተስፋ የምታደርጉት ሙሴ ነው።

verses.en: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me; for he wrote of me.
verses.fr: Car si vous croyiez Moïse, vous me croiriez aussi, parce qu''il a écrit de moi.
verses.am: ሙሴንስ ብታምኑት እኔን ባመናችሁ ነበር፤ እርሱ ስለ እኔ ጽፎአልና።

verses.en: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
verses.fr: Mais si vous ne croyez pas à ses écrits, comment croirez-vous à mes paroles?
verses.am: መጻሕፍትን ካላመናችሁ ግን ቃሌን እንዴት ታምናላችሁ?

verses.en: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
verses.fr: Après cela, Jésus s''en alla de l''autre côté de la mer de Galilée, de Tibériade.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ወደ ገሊላ ባሕር ማዶ ተሻገረ፤ እርሱም የጥብርያዶስ ባሕር ነው።

verses.en: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
verses.fr: Une grande foule le suivait, parce qu''elle voyait les miracles qu''il opérait sur les malades.
verses.am: በበሽተኞችም ያደረገውን ምልክቶች ስላዩ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
verses.fr: Jésus monta sur la montagne, et là il s''assit avec ses disciples.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ ተራራ ወጣና በዚያ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
verses.fr: Or, la Pâque était proche, la fête des Juifs.
verses.am: የአይሁድ በዓልም ፋሲካ ቀርቦ ነበር።

verses.en: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
verses.fr: Ayant levé les yeux, et voyant qu''une grande foule venait à lui, Jésus dit à Philippe: Où achèterons-nous des pains, pour que ces gens aient à manger?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ዓይኖቹን አንሥቶ ብዙ ሕዝብ ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አየና ፊልጶስን። እነዚህ እንዲበሉ እንጀራ ከወዴት እንገዛለን? አለው።

verses.en: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.fr: Il disait cela pour l''éprouver, car il savait ce qu''il allait faire.
verses.am: ራሱ ሊያደርግ ያለውን ያውቅ ነበርና ሊፈትነው ይህን ተናገረ።

verses.en: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
verses.fr: Philippe lui répondit: Les pains qu''on aurait pour deux cents deniers ne suffiraient pas pour que chacun en reçût un peu.
verses.am: ፊልጶስ። እያንዳንዳቸው ትንሽ ትንሽ እንኳ እንዲቀበሉ የሁለት መቶ ዲናር እንጀራ አይበቃቸውም ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
verses.fr: Un de ses disciples, André, frère de Simon Pierre, lui dit:
verses.am: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንዱ የስምዖን ጴጥሮስ ወንድም እንድርያስ።

verses.en: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
verses.fr: Il y a ici un jeune garçon qui a cinq pains d''orge et deux poissons; mais qu''est-ce que cela pour tant de gens?
verses.am: አምስት የገብስ እንጀራና ሁለት ዓሣ የያዘ ብላቴና በዚህ አለ፤ ነገር ግን እነዚህን ለሚያህሉ ሰዎች ይህ ምን ይሆናል? አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.fr: Jésus dit: Faites-les asseoir. Il y avait dans ce lieu beaucoup d''herbe. Ils s''assirent donc, au nombre d''environ cinq mille hommes.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ሰዎቹን እንዲቀመጡ አድርጉ አለ። በዚያም ስፍራ ብዙ ሣር ነበረበት። ወንዶችም ተቀመጡ ቍጥራቸውም አምስት ሺህ የሚያህል ነበር።

verses.en: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
verses.fr: Jésus prit les pains, rendit grâces, et les distribua à ceux qui étaient assis; il leur donna de même des poissons, autant qu''ils en voulurent.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንጀራውን ያዘ፥ አመስግኖም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለተቀመጡት ሰዎች ሰጡአቸው እንዲሁም ከዓሣው በፈለጉት መጠን።

verses.en: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent rassasiés, il dit à ses disciples: Ramassez les morceaux qui restent, afin que rien ne se perde.
verses.am: ከጠገቡም በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። አንድ ስንኳ እንዳይጠፋ የተረፈውን ቍርስራሽ አከማቹ አላቸው።

verses.en: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
verses.fr: Ils les ramassèrent donc, et ils remplirent douze paniers avec les morceaux qui restèrent des cinq pains d''orge, après que tous eurent mangé.
verses.am: ሰለዚህ አከማቹ፥ ከበሉትም ከአምስቱ የገብስ እንጀራ የተረፈውን ቍርስራሽ አሥራ ሁለት መሶብ ሞሉ።

verses.en: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
verses.fr: Ces gens, ayant vu le miracle que Jésus avait fait, disaient: Celui-ci est vraiment le prophète qui doit venir dans le monde.
verses.am: ከዚህ የተነሣ ሰዎቹ ኢየሱስ ያደረገውን ምልክት ባዩ ጊዜ። ይህ በእውነት ወደ ዓለም የሚመጣው ነቢይ ነው አሉ።

verses.en: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
verses.fr: Et Jésus, sachant qu''ils allaient venir l''enlever pour le faire roi, se retira de nouveau sur la montagne, lui seul.
verses.am: በዚህም ምክንያት ኢየሱስ ያነግሡት ዘንድ ሊመጡና ሊነጥቁት እንዳላቸው አውቆ ደግሞ ወደ ተራራ ብቻውን ፈቀቅ አለ።

verses.en: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
verses.fr: Quand le soir fut venu, ses disciples descendirent au bord de la mer.
verses.am: በመሸም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ ባሕር ወረዱ፥

verses.en: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
verses.fr: Etant montés dans une barque, ils traversaient la mer pour se rendre à Capernaüm. Il faisait déjà nuit, et Jésus ne les avait pas encore rejoints.
verses.am: በታንኳም ገብተው በባሕር ማዶ ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ይመጡ ነበር። አሁንም ጨልሞ ነበር፤ ኢየሱስም ገና ወደ እነርሱ አልመጣም ነበር፤

verses.en: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
verses.fr: Il soufflait un grand vent, et la mer était agitée.
verses.am: ብርቱ ነፋስም ስለ ነፈሰ ባሕሩ ተናወጠ።

verses.en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
verses.fr: Après avoir ramé environ vingt-cinq ou trente stades, ils virent Jésus marchant sur la mer et s''approchant de la barque. Et ils eurent peur.
verses.am: ሀያ አምስት ወይም ሠላሳ ምዕራፍ ከቀዘፉ በኋላም፥ ኢየሱስ በባሕር ላይ እየሄደ ወደ ታንኳይቱ ሲቀርብ አይተው ፈሩ።

verses.en: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus leur dit: C''est moi; n''ayez pas peur!
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። እኔ ነኝ፤ አትፍሩ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
verses.fr: Ils voulaient donc le prendre dans la barque, et aussitôt la barque aborda au lieu où ils allaient.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በታንኳይቱ ሊቀበሉት ወደዱ፤ ወዲያውም ታንኳይቱ ወደሚሄዱበት ምድር ደረሰች።

verses.en: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
verses.fr: La foule qui était restée de l''autre côté de la mer avait remarqué qu''il ne se trouvait là qu''une seule barque, et que Jésus n''était pas monté dans cette barque avec ses disciples, mais qu''ils étaient partis seuls.
verses.am: በነገው በባሕር ማዶ ቆመው የነበሩ ሕዝቡ ከአንዲት ጀልባ በቀር በዚያ ሌላ ጀልባ እንዳልነበረች፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለብቻቸው እንደ ሄዱ እንጂ ኢየሱስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ታንኳይቱ እንዳልገባ አዩ፤

verses.en: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
verses.fr: Le lendemain, comme d''autres barques étaient arrivées de Tibériade près du lieu où ils avaient mangé le pain après que le Seigneur eut rendu grâces,
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ሌሎች ጀልባዎች ጌታ የባረከውን እንጀራ ወደ በሉበት ስፍራ አጠገብ ከጥብርያዶስ መጡ።

verses.en: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
verses.fr: les gens de la foule, ayant vu que ni Jésus ni ses disciples n''étaient là, montèrent eux-mêmes dans ces barques et allèrent à Capernaüm à la recherche de Jésus.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ኢየሱስ ወይም ደቀ መዛሙርቱ በዚያ እንዳልነበሩ ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ራሳቸው በጀልባዎቹ ገብተው ኢየሱስን እየፈለጉ ወደ ቅፍርናሆም መጡ።

verses.en: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
verses.fr: Et l''ayant trouvé au delà de la mer, ils lui dirent: Rabbi, quand es-tu venu ici?
verses.am: በባሕር ማዶም ሲያገኙት። መምህር ሆይ፥ ወደዚህ መቼ መጣህ? አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, vous me cherchez, non parce que vous avez vu des miracles, mais parce que vous avez mangé des pains et que vous avez été rassasiés.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የምትፈልጉኝ እንጀራን ስለ በላችሁና ስለ ጠገባችሁ ነው እንጂ ምልክቶችን ስላያችሁ አይደለም።

verses.en: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
verses.fr: Travaillez, non pour la nourriture qui périt, mais pour celle qui subsiste pour la vie éternelle, et que le Fils de l''homme vous donnera; car c''est lui que le Père, que Dieu a marqué de son sceau.
verses.am: ለሚጠፋ መብል አትሥሩ፤ ነገር ግን ለዘላለም ሕይወት ለሚኖር መብል የሰው ልጅ ለሚሰጣችሁ ሥሩ፤ እርሱን እግዚአብሔር አብ አትሞታልና።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Que devons-nous faire, pour faire les oeuvres de Dieu?
verses.am: እንግዲህ። የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ እንድንሠራ ምን እናድርግ? አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: L''oeuvre de Dieu, c''est que vous croyiez en celui qu''il a envoyé.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መልሶ። ይህ የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ እርሱ በላከው እንድታምኑ ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
verses.fr: Quel miracle fais-tu donc, lui dirent-ils, afin que nous le voyions, et que nous croyions en toi? Que fais-tu?
verses.am: እንግዲህ። እንኪያ አይተን እንድናምንህ አንተ ምን ምልክት ታደርጋለህ? ምንስ ትሠራለህ?

verses.en: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
verses.fr: Nos pères ont mangé la manne dans le désert, selon ce qui est écrit: Il leur donna le pain du ciel à manger.
verses.am: ይበሉ ዘንድ ከሰማይ እንጀራ ሰጣቸው ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ አባቶቻችን በምድረ በዳ መና በሉ አሉት።

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, Moïse ne vous a pas donné le pain du ciel, mais mon Père vous donne le vrai pain du ciel;
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እውነተኛ እንጀራ ከሰማይ የሚሰጣችሁ አባቴ ነው እንጂ ከሰማይ እንጀራ የሰጣችሁ ሙሴ አይደለም፤

verses.en: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
verses.fr: car le pain de Dieu, c''est celui qui descend du ciel et qui donne la vie au monde.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር እንጀራ ከሰማይ የሚወርድ ለዓለምም ሕይወትን የሚሰጥ ነውና አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Seigneur, donne-nous toujours ce pain.
verses.am: ስለዚህ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ይህን እንጀራ ዘወትር ስጠን አሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Je suis le pain de vie. Celui qui vient à moi n''aura jamais faim, et celui qui croit en moi n''aura jamais soif.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። የሕይወት እንጀራ እኔ ነኝ፤ ወደ እኔ የሚመጣ ከቶ አይራብም በእኔ የሚያምንም ሁልጊዜ ከቶ አይጠማም።

verses.en: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
verses.fr: Mais, je vous l''ai dit, vous m''avez vu, et vous ne croyez point.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አይታችሁኝ እንዳላመናችሁ አልኋችሁ።

verses.en: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
verses.fr: Tous ceux que le Père me donne viendront à moi, et je ne mettrai pas dehors celui qui vient à moi;
verses.am: አብ የሚሰጠኝ ሁሉ ወደ እኔ ይመጣል፥ ወደ እኔም የሚመጣውን ከቶ ወደ ውጭ አላወጣውም፤

verses.en: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
verses.fr: car je suis descendu du ciel pour faire, non ma volonté, mais la volonté de celui qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: ፈቃዴን ለማድረግ አይደለም እንጂ የላከኝን ፈቃድ ለማድረግ ከሰማይ ወርጃለሁና።

verses.en: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
verses.fr: Or, la volonté de celui qui m''a envoyé, c''est que je ne perde rien de tout ce qu''il m''a donné, mais que je le ressuscite au dernier jour.
verses.am: ከሰጠኝም ሁሉ አንድን ስንኳ እንዳላጠፋ በመጨረሻው ቀን እንዳስነሣው እንጂ የላከኝ የአብ ፈቃድ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.fr: La volonté de mon Père, c''est que quiconque voit le Fils et croit en lui ait la vie éternelle; et je le ressusciterai au dernier jour.
verses.am: ልጅንም አይቶ በእርሱ የሚያምን ሁሉ የዘላለም ሕይወትን እንዲያገኝ የአባቴ ፈቃድ ይህ ነው፥ እኔም በመጨረሻው ቀን አስነሣዋለሁ።

verses.en: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
verses.fr: Les Juifs murmuraient à son sujet, parce qu''il avait dit: Je suis le pain qui est descendu du ciel.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አይሁድ። ከሰማይ የወረደ እንጀራ እኔ ነኝ ስላለ ስለ እርሱ አንጐራጐሩና።

verses.en: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
verses.fr: Et ils disaient: N''est-ce pas là Jésus, le fils de Joseph, celui dont nous connaissons le père et la mère? Comment donc dit-il: Je suis descendu du ciel?
verses.am: አባቱንና እናቱን የምናውቃቸው ይህ የዮሴፍ ልጅ ኢየሱስ አይደለምን? እንግዲህ። ከሰማይ ወርጃለሁ እንዴት ይላል? አሉ።

verses.en: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Ne murmurez pas entre vous.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መለሰ አላቸውም። እርስ በርሳችሁ አታንጐራጕሩ።

verses.en: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.fr: Nul ne peut venir à moi, si le Père qui m''a envoyé ne l''attire; et je le ressusciterai au dernier jour.
verses.am: የላከኝ አብ ከሳበው በቀር ወደ እኔ ሊመጣ የሚችል የለም፥ እኔም በመጨረሻው ቀን አስነሣዋለሁ።
