verses.en: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
verses.fr: Il est écrit dans les prophètes: Ils seront tous enseignés de Dieu. Ainsi quiconque a entendu le Père et a reçu son enseignement vient à moi.
verses.am: ሁሉም ከእግዚአብሔር የተማሩ ይሆናሉ ተብሎ በነቢያት ተጽፎአል፤ እንግዲህ ከአብ የሰማ የተማረም ሁሉ ወደ እኔ ይመጣል።

verses.en: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
verses.fr: C''est que nul n''a vu le Père, sinon celui qui vient de Dieu; celui-là a vu le Père.
verses.am: አብን ያየ ማንም የለም፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከሆነ በቀር፥ እርሱ አብን አይቶአል።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, celui qui croit en moi a la vie éternelle.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ በእኔ የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው።

verses.en: I am that bread of life.
verses.fr: Je suis le pain de vie.
verses.am: የሕይወት እንጀራ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
verses.fr: Vos pères ont mangé la manne dans le désert, et ils sont morts.
verses.am: አባቶቻችሁ በምድረ በዳ መና በሉ ሞቱም፤

verses.en: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
verses.fr: C''est ici le pain qui descend du ciel, afin que celui qui en mange ne meure point.
verses.am: ሰው ከእርሱ በልቶ እንዳይሞት ከሰማይ አሁን የወረደ እንጀራ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
verses.fr: Je suis le pain vivant qui est descendu du ciel. Si quelqu''un mange de ce pain, il vivra éternellement; et le pain que je donnerai, c''est ma chair, que je donnerai pour la vie du monde.
verses.am: ከሰማይ የወረደ ሕያው እንጀራ እኔ ነኝ፤ ሰው ከዚህ እንጀራ ቢበላ ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ እኔም ስለ ዓለም ሕይወት የምሰጠው እንጀራ ሥጋዬ ነው።

verses.en: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
verses.fr: Là-dessus, les Juifs disputaient entre eux, disant: Comment peut-il nous donner sa chair à manger?
verses.am: እንግዲህ አይሁድ። ይህ ሰው ሥጋውን ልንበላ ይሰጠን ዘንድ እንዴት ይችላል? ብለው እርስ በርሳቸው ተከራከሩ።

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, si vous ne mangez la chair du Fils de l''homme, et si vous ne buvez son sang, vous n''avez point la vie en vous-mêmes.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አላቸው። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የሰውን ልጅ ሥጋ ካልበላችሁ ደሙንም ካልጠጣችሁ በራሳችሁ ሕይወት የላችሁም።

verses.en: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.fr: Celui qui mange ma chair et qui boit mon sang a la vie éternelle; et je le ressusciterai au dernier jour.
verses.am: ሥጋዬን የሚበላ ደሜንም የሚጠጣ የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፥ እኔም በመጨረሻው ቀን አስነሣዋለሁ።

verses.en: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.fr: Car ma chair est vraiment une nourriture, et mon sang est vraiment un breuvage.
verses.am: ሥጋዬ እውነተኛ መብል ደሜም እውነተኛ መጠጥ ነውና።

verses.en: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
verses.fr: Celui qui mange ma chair et qui boit mon sang demeure en moi, et je demeure en lui.
verses.am: ሥጋዬን የሚበላ ደሜንም የሚጠጣ በእኔ ይኖራል እኔም በእርሱ እኖራለሁ።

verses.en: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
verses.fr: Comme le Père qui est vivant m''a envoyé, et que je vis par le Père, ainsi celui qui me mange vivra par moi.
verses.am: ሕያው አብ እንደ ላከኝ እኔም ከአብ የተነሣ ሕያው እንደምሆን፥ እንዲሁ የሚበላኝ ደግሞ ከእኔ የተነሣ ሕያው ይሆናል።

verses.en: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
verses.fr: C''est ici le pain qui est descendu du ciel. Il n''en est pas comme de vos pères qui ont mangé la manne et qui sont morts: celui qui mange ce pain vivra éternellement.
verses.am: ከሰማይ የወረደ እንጀራ ይህ ነው፤ አባቶቻችሁ መና በልተው እንደ ሞቱ አይደለም፤ ይህን እንጀራ የሚበላ ለዘላለም ይኖራል

verses.en: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.fr: Jésus dit ces choses dans la synagogue, enseignant à Capernaüm.
verses.am: በቅፍርናሆም ሲያስተምር ይህን በምኵራብ አለ።

verses.en: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
verses.fr: Plusieurs de ses disciples, après l''avoir entendu, dirent: Cette parole est dure; qui peut l''écouter?
verses.am: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ብዙዎች በሰሙ ጊዜ። ይህ የሚያስጨንቅ ንግግር ነው፤ ማን ሊሰማው ይችላል? አሉ።

verses.en: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
verses.fr: Jésus, sachant en lui-même que ses disciples murmuraient à ce sujet, leur dit: Cela vous scandalise-t-il?
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ስለዚህ እንዳንጐራጐሩ በልቡ አውቆ አላቸው። ይህ ያሰናክላችኋልን?

verses.en: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
verses.fr: Et si vous voyez le Fils de l''homme monter où il était auparavant?...
verses.am: እንግዲህ የሰው ልጅ አስቀድሞ ወደ ነበረበት ሲወጣ ብታዩ እንዴት ይሆናል?

verses.en: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
verses.fr: C''est l''esprit qui vivifie; la chair ne sert de rien. Les paroles que je vous ai dites sont esprit et vie.
verses.am: ሕይወትን የሚሰጥ መንፈስ ነው፤ ሥጋ ምንም አይጠቅምም፤ እኔ የነገርኋችሁ ቃል መንፈስ ነው ሕይወትም ነው።

verses.en: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
verses.fr: Mais il en est parmi vous quelques-uns qui ne croient point. Car Jésus savait dès le commencement qui étaient ceux qui ne croyaient point, et qui était celui qui le livrerait.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከእናንተ የማያምኑ አሉ። ኢየሱስ የማያምኑት እነማን እንደ ሆኑ አሳልፎ የሚሰጠውም ማን እንደ ሆነ ከመጀመሪያ ያውቅ ነበርና።

verses.en: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
verses.fr: Et il ajouta: C''est pourquoi je vous ai dit que nul ne peut venir à moi, si cela ne lui a été donné par le Père.
verses.am: ደግሞ። ስለዚህ አልኋችሁ፥ ከአብ የተሰጠው ካልሆነ ወደ እኔ ሊመጣ የሚችል የለም አለ።

verses.en: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.fr: Dès ce moment, plusieurs de ses disciples se retirèrent, et ils n''allaient plus avec lui.
verses.am: ከዚህም የተነሣ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ብዙዎች ወደ ኋላ ተመለሱ፤ ወደ ፊትም ከእርሱ ጋር አልሄዱም።

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
verses.fr: Jésus donc dit aux douze: Et vous, ne voulez-vous pas aussi vous en aller?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ። እናንተ ደግሞ ልትሄዱ ትወዳላችሁን? አለ።

verses.en: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
verses.fr: Simon Pierre lui répondit: Seigneur, à qui irions-nous? Tu as les paroles de la vie éternelle.
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወደ ማን እንሄዳለን? አንተ የዘላለም ሕይወት ቃል አለህ፤

verses.en: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.fr: Et nous avons cru et nous avons connu que tu es le Christ, le Saint de Dieu.
verses.am: እኛስ አንተ ክርስቶስ የሕያው የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆንህ አምነናል አውቀናልም ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: N''est-ce pas moi qui vous ai choisis, vous les douze? Et l''un de vous est un démon!
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እኔ እናንተን አሥራ ሁለታችሁን የመረጥኋችሁ አይደለምን? ከእናንተም አንዱ ዲያብሎስ ነው ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.en: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.fr: Il parlait de Judas Iscariot, fils de Simon; car c''était lui qui devait le livrer, lui, l''un des douze.
verses.am: ስለ ስምዖንም ልጅ ስለ አስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ ተናገረ፤ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ የሆነ እርሱ አሳልፎ ይሰጠው ዘንድ አለውና።

verses.en: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
verses.fr: Après cela, Jésus parcourait la Galilée, car il ne voulait pas séjourner en Judée, parce que les Juifs cherchaient à le faire mourir.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ኢየሱስ አይሁድ ሊገድሉት ይፈልጉ ስለ ነበር በይሁዳ ሊመላለስ አይወድም ነበርና በገሊላ ይመላለስ ነበር።

verses.en: Now the Jew's feast of tabernacles was at hand.
verses.fr: Or, la fête des Juifs, la fête des Tabernacles, était proche.
verses.am: የአይሁድም የዳስ በዓል ቀርቦ ነበር።

verses.en: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
verses.fr: Et ses frères lui dirent: Pars d''ici, et va en Judée, afin que tes disciples voient aussi les oeuvres que tu fais.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ወንድሞቹ። ደቀ መዛሙርትህ ደግሞ የምታደርገውን ሥራ እንዲያዩ ከዚህ ተነሣና ወደ ይሁዳ ሂድ፤

verses.en: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
verses.fr: Personne n''agit en secret, lorsqu''il désire paraître: si tu fais ces choses, montre-toi toi-même au monde.
verses.am: ራሱ ሊገለጥ እየፈለገ በስውር የሚሠራ የለምና። እነዚህን ብታደርግ ራስህን ለዓለም ግለጥ አሉት።

verses.en: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
verses.fr: Car ses frères non plus ne croyaient pas en lui.
verses.am: ወንድሞቹ ስንኳ አላመኑበትም ነበርና።

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Mon temps n''est pas encore venu, mais votre temps est toujours prêt.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። ጊዜዬ ገና አልደረሰም፥ ጊዜያችሁ ግን ዘወትር የተመቸ ነው።

verses.en: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
verses.fr: Le monde ne peut vous haïr; moi, il me hait, parce que je rends de lui le témoignage que ses oeuvres sont mauvaises.
verses.am: ዓለም እናንተን ሊጠላ አይቻለውም፤ እኔ ግን ሥራው ክፉ መሆኑን እመሰክርበታለሁና እኔን ይጠላኛል።

verses.en: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast: for my time is not yet full come.
verses.fr: Montez, vous, à cette fête; pour moi, je n''y monte point, parce que mon temps n''est pas encore accompli.
verses.am: እናንተ ወደዚህ በዓል ውጡ፤ እኔስ ጊዜዬ ገና ስላልተፈጸመ ወደዚህ በዓል ገና አልወጣም።

verses.en: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
verses.fr: Après leur avoir dit cela, il resta en Galilée.
verses.am: ይህንም አላቸውና በገሊላ ቀረ።

verses.en: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
verses.fr: Lorsque ses frères furent montés à la fête, il y monta aussi lui-même, non publiquement, mais comme en secret.
verses.am: ወንድሞቹ ግን ወደ በዓሉ ከወጡ በኋላ በዚያን ጊዜ እርሱ ደግሞ በግልጥ ሳይሆን ተሰውሮ ወጣ።

verses.en: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
verses.fr: Les Juifs le cherchaient pendant la fête, et disaient: Où est-il?
verses.am: አይሁድም። እርሱ ወዴት ነው? እያሉ በበዓሉ ይፈልጉት ነበር።

verses.en: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
verses.fr: Il y avait dans la foule grande rumeur à son sujet. Les uns disaient: C''est un homme de bien. D''autres disaient: Non, il égare la multitude.
verses.am: በሕዝብም መካከል ስለ እርሱ ብዙ ማንጐራጐር ነበረ፤ አንዳንዱም። ደግ ሰው ነው፤ ሌሎች ግን። አይደለም፥ ሕዝቡን ግን ያስታል ይሉ ነበር።

verses.en: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
verses.fr: Personne, toutefois, ne parlait librement de lui, par crainte des Juifs.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን አይሁድን ስለ ፈሩ ማንም ስለ እርሱ በግልጥ አይናገርም ነበር።

verses.en: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
verses.fr: Vers le milieu de la fête, Jésus monta au temple. Et il enseignait.
verses.am: አሁንም በበዓሉ እኩሌታ ኢየሱስ ወደ መቅደስ ወጥቶ ያስተምር ነበር።

verses.en: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
verses.fr: Les Juifs s''étonnaient, disant: Comment connaît-il les Ecritures, lui qui n''a point étudié?
verses.am: አይሁድም። ይህ ሰው ሳይማር መጻሕፍትን እንዴት ያውቃል? ብለው ይደነቁ ነበር።

verses.en: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Ma doctrine n''est pas de moi, mais de celui qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ መለሰ እንዲህም አላቸው። ትምህርቴስ ከላከኝ ነው እንጂ ከእኔ አይደለም፤

verses.en: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un veut faire sa volonté, il connaîtra si ma doctrine est de Dieu, ou si je parle de mon chef.
verses.am: ፈቃዱን ሊያደርግ የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ እርሱ ይህ ትምህርት ከእግዚአብሔር ቢሆን ወይም እኔ ከራሴ የምናገር ብሆን ያውቃል።

verses.en: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verses.fr: Celui qui parle de son chef cherche sa propre gloire; mais celui qui cherche la gloire de celui qui l''a envoyé, celui-là est vrai, et il n''y a point d''injustice en lui.
verses.am: ከራሱ የሚናገር የራሱን ክብር ይፈልጋል፤ የላከውን ክብር የሚፈልግ ግን እርሱ እውነተኛ ነው በእርሱም ዓመፃ የለበትም።

verses.en: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
verses.fr: Moïse ne vous a-t-il pas donné la loi? Et nul de vous n''observe la loi. Pourquoi cherchez-vous à me faire mourir?
verses.am: ሙሴ ሕግን አልሰጣችሁምን? ከእናንተ ግን ሕግን የሚያደርግ አንድ ስንኳ የለም። ልትገድሉኝ ስለ ምን ትፈልጋላችሁ?

verses.en: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
verses.fr: La foule répondit: Tu as un démon. Qui est-ce qui cherche à te faire mourir?
verses.am: ሕዝቡ መለሱና። ጋኔን አለብህ፤ ማን ሊገድልህ ይፈልጋል? አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: J''ai fait une oeuvre, et vous en êtes tous étonnés.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መለሰ አላቸውም። አንድ ሥራ አደረግሁ ሁላችሁም ታደንቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
verses.fr: Moïse vous a donné la circoncision, -non qu''elle vienne de Moïse, car elle vient des patriarches, -et vous circoncisez un homme le jour du sabbat.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሙሴ መገረዝን ሰጣችሁ፤ ከአባቶችም ነው እንጂ ከሙሴ አይደለም፤ በሰንበትም ሰውን ትገርዛላችሁ።

verses.en: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
verses.fr: Si un homme reçoit la circoncision le jour du sabbat, afin que la loi de Moïse ne soit pas violée, pourquoi vous irritez-vous contre moi de ce que j''ai guéri un homme tout entier le jour du sabbat?
verses.am: የሙሴ ሕግ እንዳይሻር ሰው በሰንበት መገረዝን የሚቀበል ከሆነስ ሰውን ሁለንተናውን በሰንበት ጤናማ ስላደረግሁ ትቈጡኛላችሁን?

verses.en: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
verses.fr: Ne jugez pas selon l''apparence, mais jugez selon la justice.
verses.am: ቅን ፍርድ ፍረዱ እንጂ በመልክ አትፍረዱ።

verses.en: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
verses.fr: Quelques habitants de Jérusalem disaient: N''est-ce pas là celui qu''ils cherchent à faire mourir?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች አንዳንዶቹ እንዲህ አሉ። ሊገድሉት የሚፈልጉት ይህ አይደለምን?

verses.en: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
verses.fr: Et voici, il parle librement, et ils ne lui disent rien! Est-ce que vraiment les chefs auraient reconnu qu''il est le Christ?
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በግልጥ ይናገራል አንዳችም አይሉትም። አለቆቹ ይህ ሰው በእውነት ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ በእውነት አወቁን?

verses.en: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
verses.fr: Cependant celui-ci, nous savons d''où il est; mais le Christ, quand il viendra, personne ne saura d''où il est.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይህን ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ አውቀናል፤ ክርስቶስ ሲመጣ ግን ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ ማንም አያውቅም።

verses.en: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
verses.fr: Et Jésus, enseignant dans le temple, s''écria: Vous me connaissez, et vous savez d''où je suis! Je ne suis pas venu de moi-même: mais celui qui m''a envoyé est vrai, et vous ne le connaissez pas.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ኢየሱስ በመቅደስ ሲያስተምር። እኔንም ታውቁኛላችሁ ከወዴትም እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ፤ እኔም በራሴ አልመጣሁም ነገር ግን እናንተ የማታውቁት የላከኝ እውነተኛ ነው፤

verses.en: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
verses.fr: Moi, je le connais; car je viens de lui, et c''est lui qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ከእርሱ ዘንድ ነኝ እርሱም ልኮኛልና አውቀዋለሁ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
verses.fr: Ils cherchaient donc à se saisir de lui, et personne ne mit la main sur lui, parce que son heure n''était pas encore venue.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሊይዙት ይፈልጉ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ጊዜው ገና ስላልደረሰ ማንም እጁን አልጫነበትም።

verses.en: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
verses.fr: Plusieurs parmi la foule crurent en lui, et ils disaient: Le Christ, quand il viendra, fera-t-il plus de miracles que n''en a fait celui-ci?
verses.am: ከሕዝቡ ግን ብዙዎች አመኑበትና። ክርስቶስ በመጣ ጊዜ ይህ ካደረጋቸው ምልክቶች ይልቅ ያደርጋልን? አሉ።

verses.en: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens entendirent la foule murmurant de lui ces choses. Alors les principaux sacrificateurs et les pharisiens envoyèrent des huissiers pour le saisir.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም ሕዝቡ ሰለ እርሱ እንደዚህ ሲያንጐራጕሩ ሰሙ፤ የካህናት አለቆችም ፈሪሳውያም ሊይዙት ሎሌዎችን ላኩ።

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
verses.fr: Jésus dit: Je suis encore avec vous pour un peu de temps, puis je m''en vais vers celui qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ገና ጥቂት ጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር እቆያለሁ ወደ ላከኝም እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
verses.fr: Vous me chercherez et vous ne me trouverez pas, et vous ne pouvez venir où je serai.
verses.am: ትፈልጉኛላችሁ አታገኙኝምም፤ እኔም ወዳለሁበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አትችሉም አለ።

verses.en: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
verses.fr: Sur quoi les Juifs dirent entre eux: Où ira-t-il, que nous ne le trouvions pas? Ira-t-il parmi ceux qui sont dispersés chez les Grecs, et enseignera-t-il les Grecs?
verses.am: እንግዲህ አይሁድ። እኛ እንዳናገኘው ይህ ወዴት ይሄድ ዘንድ አለው? በግሪክ ሰዎች መካከል ተበትነው ወደሚኖሩት ሊሄድና የግሪክን ሰዎች ሊያስተምር አለውን?

verses.en: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
verses.fr: Que signifie cette parole qu''il a dite: Vous me chercherez et vous ne me trouverez pas, et vous ne pouvez venir où je serai?
verses.am: እርሱ። ትፈልጉኛላችሁ አታገኙኝምም እኔም ወዳለሁበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አትችሉም የሚለው ይህ ቃል ምንድር ነው? ብለው እርስ በርሳቸው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.en: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
verses.fr: Le dernier jour, le grand jour de la fête, Jésus, se tenant debout, s''écria: Si quelqu''un a soif, qu''il vienne à moi, et qu''il boive.
verses.am: ከበዓሉም በታላቁ በኋለኛው ቀን ኢየሱስ ቆሞ። ማንም የተጠማ ቢኖር ወደ እኔ ይምጣና ይጠጣ።

verses.en: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
verses.fr: Celui qui croit en moi, des fleuves d''eau vive couleront de son sein, comme dit l''Ecriture.
verses.am: በእኔ የሚያምን መጽሐፍ እንዳለ፥ የሕይወት ውኃ ወንዝ ከሆዱ ይፈልቃል ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
verses.fr: Il dit cela de l''Esprit que devaient recevoir ceux qui croiraient en lui; car l''Esprit n''était pas encore, parce que Jésus n''avait pas encore été glorifié.
verses.am: ይህን ግን በእርሱ የሚያምኑ ሊቀበሉት ስላላቸው ስለ መንፈስ ተናገረ፤ ኢየሱስ ገና ስላልከበረ መንፈስ ገና አልወረደም ነበርና።

verses.en: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
verses.fr: Des gens de la foule, ayant entendu ces paroles, disaient: Celui-ci est vraiment le prophète.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከሕዝቡ አያሌ ሰዎች ይህን ቃል ሲሰሙ። ይህ በእውነት ነቢዩ ነው አሉ፤

verses.en: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
verses.fr: D''autres disaient: C''est le Christ. Et d''autres disaient: Est-ce bien de la Galilée que doit venir le Christ?
verses.am: ሌሎች። ይህ ክርስቶስ ነው አሉ፤ ሌሎች ግን። ክርስቶስ በእውኑ ከገሊላ ይመጣልን?

verses.en: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
verses.fr: L''Ecriture ne dit-elle pas que c''est de la postérité de David, et du village de Bethléhem, où était David, que le Christ doit venir?
verses.am: ክርስቶስ ከዳዊት ዘር ዳዊትም ከነበረባት መንደር ከቤተ ልሔም እንዲመጣ መጽሐፍ አላለምን? አሉ።

verses.en: So there was a division among the people because of him.
verses.fr: Il y eut donc, à cause de lui, division parmi la foule.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከእርሱ የተነሣ በሕዝቡ መካከል መለያየት ሆነ፤

verses.en: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
verses.fr: Quelques-uns d''entre eux voulaient le saisir, mais personne ne mit la main sur lui.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ ሊይዙት ወደዱ ነገር ግን እጁን ማንም አልጫነበትም።

verses.en: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
verses.fr: Ainsi les huissiers retournèrent vers les principaux sacrificateurs et les pharisiens. Et ceux-ci leur dirent: Pourquoi ne l''avez-vous pas amené?
verses.am: ሎሌዎቹም ወደ ካህናት አለቆችና ወደ ፈሪሳውያን መጡ፤ እነዚያም። ያላመጣችሁት ስለ ምን ነው? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
verses.fr: Les huissiers répondirent: Jamais homme n''a parlé comme cet homme.
verses.am: ሎሌዎቹ። እንደዚህ ሰው ማንም እንዲሁ ከቶ አልተናገረም ብለው መለሱ።

verses.en: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
verses.fr: Les pharisiens leur répliquèrent: Est-ce que vous aussi, vous avez été séduits?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ፈሪሳውያን። እናንተ ደግሞ ሳታችሁን?

verses.en: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
verses.fr: Y a-t-il quelqu''un des chefs ou des pharisiens qui ait cru en lui?
verses.am: ከአለቆች ወይስ ከፈሪሳውያን በእርሱ ያመነ አለን?

verses.en: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
verses.fr: Mais cette foule qui ne connaît pas la loi, ce sont des maudits!
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሕግን የማያውቀው ይህ ሕዝብ ርጉም ነው ብለው መለሱላቸው።

verses.en: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
verses.fr: Nicodème, qui était venu de nuit vers Jésus, et qui était l''un d''entre eux, leur dit:
verses.am: ከእነርሱ አንዱ በሌሊት ቀድሞ ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ የነበረ ኒቆዲሞስ።

verses.en: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
verses.fr: Notre loi condamne-t-elle un homme avant qu''on l''entende et qu''on sache ce qu''il a fait?
verses.am: ሕጋችን አስቀድሞ ከእርሱ ሳይሰማ ምንስ እንዳደረገ ሳያውቅ በሰው ይፈርዳልን? አላቸው።

verses.en: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Es-tu aussi Galiléen? Examine, et tu verras que de la Galilée il ne sort point de prophète.
verses.am: እነርሱም መለሱና። አንተም ደግሞ ከገሊላ ነህን? ነቢይ ከገሊላ እንዳይነሣ መርምርና እይ አሉት።

verses.en: And every man went unto his own house.
verses.fr: Et chacun s''en retourna dans sa maison.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱም ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.en: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
verses.fr: Jésus se rendit à la montagne des oliviers.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ሄደ።

verses.en: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
verses.fr: Mais, dès le matin, il alla de nouveau dans le temple, et tout le peuple vint à lui. S''étant assis, il les enseignait.
verses.am: ማለዳም ደግሞ ወደ መቅደስ ደረሰ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ መጡ። ተቀምጦም ያስተምራቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
verses.fr: Alors les scribes et les pharisiens amenèrent une femme surprise en adultère; et, la plaçant au milieu du peuple,
verses.am: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያንም በምንዝር የተያዘችን ሴት ወደ እርሱ አመጡ በመካከልም እርሱዋን አቁመው።

verses.en: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
verses.fr: ils dirent à Jésus: Maître, cette femme a été surprise en flagrant délit d''adultère.
verses.am: መምህር ሆይ፥ ይህች ሴት ስታመነዝር ተገኝታ ተያዘች።

verses.en: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
verses.fr: Moïse, dans la loi, nous a ordonné de lapider de telles femmes: toi donc, que dis-tu?
verses.am: ሙሴም እንደነዚህ ያሉት እንዲወገሩ በሕግ አዘዘን፤ አንተስ ስለ እርስዋ ምን ትላለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
verses.fr: Ils disaient cela pour l''éprouver, afin de pouvoir l''accuser. Mais Jésus, s''étant baissé, écrivait avec le doigt sur la terre.
verses.am: የሚከሱበትንም እንዲያገኙ ሊፈትኑት ይህን አሉ። ኢየሱስ ግን ጐንበስ ብሎ በጣቱ በምድር ላይ ጻፈ፤

verses.en: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
verses.fr: Comme ils continuaient à l''interroger, il se releva et leur dit: Que celui de vous qui est sans péché jette le premier la pierre contre elle.
verses.am: መላልሰው በጠየቁት ጊዜ ግን ቀና ብሎ። ከእናንተ ኃጢአት የሌለበት አስቀድሞ በድንጋይ ይውገራት አላቸው።

verses.en: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
verses.fr: Et s''étant de nouveau baissé, il écrivait sur la terre.
verses.am: ደግሞም ጐንበስ ብሎ በጣቱ በምድር ላይ ጻፈ።

verses.en: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
verses.fr: Quand ils entendirent cela, accusés par leur conscience, ils se retirèrent un à un, depuis les plus âgés jusqu''aux derniers; et Jésus resta seul avec la femme qui était là au milieu.
verses.am: እነርሱም ይህን ሲሰሙ ሕሊናቸው ወቀሳቸውና ከሽማግሌዎች ጀምረው እስከ ኋለኞች አንድ አንድ እያሉ ወጡ፤ ኢየሱስም ብቻውን ቀረ ሴቲቱም በመካከል ቆማ ነበረች።

verses.en: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
verses.fr: Alors s''étant relevé, et ne voyant plus que la femme, Jésus lui dit: Femme, où sont ceux qui t''accusaient? Personne ne t''a-t-il condamnée?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ቀና ብሎ ከሴቲቱ በቀር ማንንም ባላየ ጊዜ። አንቺ ሴት፥ እነዚያ ከሳሾችሽ ወዴት አሉ? የፈረደብሽ የለምን? አላት።

verses.en: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
verses.fr: Elle répondit: Non, Seigneur. Et Jésus lui dit: Je ne te condamne pas non plus: va, et ne pèche plus.
verses.am: እርስዋም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንድ ስንኳ አለች። ኢየሱስም። እኔም አልፈርድብሽም፤ ሂጂ ከአሁንም ጀምሮ ደግመሽ ኃጢአት አትሥሪ አላት።

verses.en: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.fr: Jésus leur parla de nouveau, et dit: Je suis la lumière du monde; celui qui me suit ne marchera pas dans les ténèbres, mais il aura la lumière de la vie.
verses.am: ደግሞም ኢየሱስ። እኔ የዓለም ብርሃን ነኝ፤ የሚከተለኝ የሕይወት ብርሃን ይሆንለታል እንጂ በጨለማ አይመላለስም ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
verses.fr: Là-dessus, les pharisiens lui dirent: Tu rends témoignage de toi-même; ton témoignage n''est pas vrai.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም። አንተ ስለ ራስህ ትመሰክራለህ፤ ምስክርነትህ እውነት አይደለም አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Quoique je rende témoignage de moi-même, mon témoignage est vrai, car je sais d''où je suis venu et où je vais; mais vous, vous ne savez d''où je viens ni où je vais.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መለሰ አላቸውም። እኔ ስለ ራሴ ምንም እንኳ ብመሰክር ከወዴት እንደመጣሁ ወዴትም እንድሄድ አውቃለሁና ምስክርነቴ እውነት ነው፤ እናንተ ግን ከወዴት እንደ መጣሁ ወዴትም እንድሄድ አታውቁም።

verses.en: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
verses.fr: Vous jugez selon la chair; moi, je ne juge personne.
verses.am: እናንተ ሥጋዊ ፍርድን ትፈርዳላችሁ፤ እኔ በአንድ ሰው ስንኳ አልፈርድም።

verses.en: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
verses.fr: Et si je juge, mon jugement est vrai, car je ne suis pas seul; mais le Père qui m''a envoyé est avec moi.
verses.am: የላከኝ አብ ከእኔ ጋር ነው እንጂ ብቻዬን አይደለሁምና እኔ ብፈርድ ፍርዴ እውነት ነው።

verses.en: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.fr: Il est écrit dans votre loi que le témoignage de deux hommes est vrai;
verses.am: የሁለት ሰዎችም ምስክርነት እውነት እንደ ሆነ በሕጋችሁ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
verses.fr: je rends témoignage de moi-même, et le Père qui m''a envoyé rend témoignage de moi.
verses.am: ስለ ራሴ የምመሰክር እኔ ነኝ፥ የላከኝም አብ ስለ እኔ ይመሰክራል።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent donc: Où est ton Père? Jésus répondit: Vous ne connaissez ni moi, ni mon Père. Si vous me connaissiez, vous connaîtriez aussi mon Père.
verses.am: እንግዲህ። አባትህ ወዴት ነው? አሉት። ኢየሱስ መልሶ። እኔንም ወይም አባቴንም አታውቁም፤ እኔንስ ብታውቁኝ አባቴን ደግሞ ባወቃችሁ ነበር አላቸው።

verses.en: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
verses.fr: Jésus dit ces paroles, enseignant dans le temple, au lieu où était le trésor; et personne ne le saisit, parce que son heure n''était pas encore venue.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ በመቅደስ ሲያስተምር በግምጃ ቤት አጠገብ ይህን ነገር ተናገረ፤ ጊዜው ገና አልደረሰምና ማንም አልያዘውም።

verses.en: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit encore: Je m''en vais, et vous me chercherez, et vous mourrez dans votre péché; vous ne pouvez venir où je vais.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ። እኔ እሄዳለሁ ትፈልጉኛላችሁም በኃጢአታችሁም ትሞታላችሁ እኔ ወደምሄድበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አትችሉም አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.fr: Sur quoi les Juifs dirent: Se tuera-t-il lui-même, puisqu''il dit: Vous ne pouvez venir où je vais?
verses.am: አይሁድም። እኔ ወደ ምሄድበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አትችሉም ማለቱ ራሱን ይገድላልን? እንጃ አሉ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.fr: Et il leur dit: Vous êtes d''en bas; moi, je suis d''en haut. Vous êtes de ce monde; moi, je ne suis pas de ce monde.
verses.am: እናንተ ከታች ናችሁ፥ እኔ ከላይ ነኝ፤ እናንተ ከዚህ ዓለም ናችሁ፥ እኔ ከዚህ ዓለም አይደለሁም።

verses.en: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je vous ai dit que vous mourrez dans vos péchés; car si vous ne croyez pas ce que je suis, vous mourrez dans vos péchés.
verses.am: እንግዲህ። በኃጢአታችሁ ትሞታላችሁ አልኋችሁ፤ እኔ እንደሆንሁ ባታምኑ በኃጢአታችሁ ትሞታላችሁና አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
verses.fr: Qui es-tu? lui dirent-ils. Jésus leur répondit: Ce que je vous dis dès le commencement.
verses.am: እንግዲህ። አንተ ማን ነህ? አሉት። ኢየሱስም። ከመጀመሪያ ለእናንተ የተናገርሁት ነኝ።

verses.en: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
verses.fr: J''ai beaucoup de choses à dire de vous et à juger en vous; mais celui qui m''a envoyé est vrai, et ce que j''ai entendu de lui, je le dis au monde.
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ የምናገረው የምፈርደውም ብዙ ነገር አለኝ፤ ዳሩ ግን የላከኝ እውነተኛ ነው እኔም ከእርሱ የሰማሁትን ይህን ለዓለም እናገራለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
verses.fr: Ils ne comprirent point qu''il leur parlait du Père.
verses.am: ስለ አብ እንደ ነገራቸው አላስተዋሉም።

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
verses.fr: Jésus donc leur dit: Quand vous aurez élevé le Fils de l''homme, alors vous connaîtrez ce que je suis, et que je ne fais rien de moi-même, mais que je parle selon ce que le Père m''a enseigné.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ኢየሱስ። የሰውን ልጅ ከፍ ከፍ ባደረጋችሁት ጊዜ እኔ እሆን ዘንድ አባቴም እንዳስተማረኝ እነዚህን እናገር ዘንድ እንጂ ከራሴ አንዳች እንዳላደርግ በዚያን ጊዜ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
verses.fr: Celui qui m''a envoyé est avec moi; il ne m''a pas laissé seul, parce que je fais toujours ce qui lui est agréable.
verses.am: የላከኝም ከእኔ ጋር ነው፤ እኔ ደስ የሚያሰኘውን ዘወትር አደርጋለሁና አብ ብቻዬን አይተወኝም አላቸው።

verses.en: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
verses.fr: Comme Jésus parlait ainsi, plusieurs crurent en lui.
verses.am: ይህን ሲናገር ብዙዎች በእርሱ አመኑ።

verses.en: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
verses.fr: Et il dit aux Juifs qui avaient cru en lui: Si vous demeurez dans ma parole, vous êtes vraiment mes disciples;
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ያመኑትን አይሁድ። እናንተ በቃሌ ብትኖሩ በእውነት ደቀ መዛሙርቴ ናችሁ፤

verses.en: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.fr: vous connaîtrez la vérité, et la vérité vous affranchira.
verses.am: እውነትንም ታውቃላችሁ እውነትም አርነት ያወጣችኋል አላቸው።

verses.en: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Nous sommes la postérité d''Abraham, et nous ne fûmes jamais esclaves de personne; comment dis-tu: Vous deviendrez libres?
verses.am: እነርሱም መልሰው። የአብርሃም ዘር ነን ለአንድም ስንኳ ከቶ ባሪያዎች አልሆንም፤ አንተ። አርነት ትወጣላችሁ እንዴት ትላለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, leur répliqua Jésus, quiconque se livre au péché est esclave du péché.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ኃጢአት የሚያደርግ ሁሉ የኃጢአት ባርያ ነው።

verses.en: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
verses.fr: Or, l''esclave ne demeure pas toujours dans la maison; le fils y demeure toujours.
verses.am: ባርያም ለዘላለም በቤት አይኖርም፤ ልጁ ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
verses.fr: Si donc le Fils vous affranchit, vous serez réellement libres.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ልጁ አርነት ቢያወጣችሁ በእውነት አርነት ትወጣላችሁ።

verses.en: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
verses.fr: Je sais que vous êtes la postérité d''Abraham; mais vous cherchez à me faire mourir, parce que ma parole ne pénètre pas en vous.
verses.am: የአብርሃም ዘር መሆናችሁንስ አውቃለሁ ነገር ግን ቃሌ በእናንተ አይኖርምና ልትገድሉኝ ትፈልጋላችሁ።

verses.en: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
verses.fr: Je dis ce que j''ai vu chez mon Père; et vous, vous faites ce que vous avez entendu de la part de votre père.
verses.am: እኔ በአባቴ ዘንድ ያየሁትን እናገራለሁ፤ እናንተም ደግሞ በአባታችሁ ዘንድ ያያችሁትን ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.en: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Notre père, c''est Abraham. Jésus leur dit: Si vous étiez enfants d''Abraham, vous feriez les oeuvres d''Abraham.
verses.am: መልሰውም። አባታችንስ አብርሃም ነው አሉት። ኢየሱስም። የአብሃም ልጆች ብትሆኑ የአብርሃምን ሥራ ባደረጋችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
verses.fr: Mais maintenant vous cherchez à me faire mourir, moi qui vous ai dit la vérité que j''ai entendue de Dieu. Cela, Abraham ne l''a point fait.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አሁን ከእግዚእብሔር የሰማሁትን እውነት የነገርኋችሁን ሰው ልትገድሉኝ ትፈልጋላችሁ፤ አብርሃም እንዲህ አላደረገም።

verses.en: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
verses.fr: Vous faites les oeuvres de votre père. Ils lui dirent: Nous ne sommes pas des enfants illégitimes; nous avons un seul Père, Dieu.
verses.am: እናንተ የአባታችሁን ሥራ ታደርጋላችሁ አላቸው። እኛስ ከዝሙት አልተወለድንም አንድ አባት አለን እርሱም እግዚአብሔር ነው አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Si Dieu était votre Père, vous m''aimeriez, car c''est de Dieu que je suis sorti et que je viens; je ne suis pas venu de moi-même, mais c''est lui qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አላቸው። እግዚአብሔርስ አባታችሁ ከሆነ በወደዳችሁኝ ነበር፤ እኔ ከእግዚአብሔር ወጥቼ መጥቻለሁና፤ እርሱ ላከኝ እንጂ ከራሴ አልመጣሁምና።

verses.en: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
verses.fr: Pourquoi ne comprenez-vous pas mon langage? Parce que vous ne pouvez écouter ma parole.
verses.am: ንግግሬን የማታስተውሉ ስለ ምንድር ነው? ቃሌን ልትሰሙ ስለማትችሉ ነው።

verses.en: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
verses.fr: Vous avez pour père le diable, et vous voulez accomplir les désirs de votre père. Il a été meurtrier dès le commencement, et il ne se tient pas dans la vérité, parce qu''il n''y a pas de vérité en lui. Lorsqu''il profère le mensonge, il parle de son propre fonds; car il est menteur et le père du mensonge.
verses.am: እናንተ ከአባታችሁ ከዲያብሎስ ናችሁ የአባታችሁንም ምኞት ልታደርጉ ትወዳላችሁ። እርሱ ከመጀመሪያ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነበረ፤ እውነትም በእርሱ ስለ ሌለ በእውነት አልቆመም። ሐሰትን ሲናገር ከራሱ ይናገራል፥ ሐሰተኛ የሐሰትም አባት ነውና።

verses.en: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
verses.fr: Et moi, parce que je dis la vérité, vous ne me croyez pas.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እውነትን የምናገር ስለ ሆንሁ አታምኑኝም።

verses.en: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
verses.fr: Qui de vous me convaincra de péché? Si je dis la vérité, pourquoi ne me croyez-vous pas?
verses.am: ከእናንተ ስለ ኃጢአት የሚወቅሰኝ ማን ነው? እውነት የምናገር ከሆንሁ እናንተ ስለ ምን አታምኑኝም?

verses.en: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
verses.fr: Celui qui est de Dieu, écoute les paroles de Dieu; vous n''écoutez pas, parce que vous n''êtes pas de Dieu.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር የሆነ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ይሰማል፤ እናንተ ከእግዚአብሔር አይደላችሁምና ስለዚህ አትሰሙም።

verses.en: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
verses.fr: Les Juifs lui répondirent: N''avons-nous pas raison de dire que tu es un Samaritain, et que tu as un démon?
verses.am: አይሁድ መልሰው። ሳምራዊ እንደ ሆንህ ጋኔንም እንዳለብህ በማለታችን እኛ መልካም እንል የለምን? አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
verses.fr: Jésus répliqua: Je n''ai point de démon; mais j''honore mon Père, et vous m''outragez.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እኔስ ጋኔን የለብኝም ነገር ግን አባቴን አከብራለሁ እናንተም ታዋርዱኛላችሁ።

verses.en: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
verses.fr: Je ne cherche point ma gloire; il en est un qui la cherche et qui juge.
verses.am: እኔ ግን የራሴን ክብር አልፈልግም፤ የሚፈልግ የሚፈርድም አለ።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, si quelqu''un garde ma parole, il ne verra jamais la mort.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ቃሌን የሚጠብቅ ቢኖር ለዘላለም ሞትን አያይም።

verses.en: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
verses.fr: Maintenant, lui dirent les Juifs, nous connaissons que tu as un démon. Abraham est mort, les prophètes aussi, et tu dis: Si quelqu''un garde ma parole, il ne verra jamais la mort.
verses.am: አይሁድ። ጋኔን እንዳለብህ አሁን አወቅን። አብርሃም ስንኳ ሞተ ነቢያትም፤ አንተም። ቃሌን የሚጠብቅ ቢኖር ለዘላለም ሞትን አይቀምስም ትላለህ።

verses.en: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
verses.fr: Es-tu plus grand que notre père Abraham, qui est mort? Les prophètes aussi sont morts. Qui prétends-tu être?
verses.am: በእውኑ አንተ ከሞተው ከአባታችን ከአብርሃም ትበልጣለህን? ነቢያትም ሞቱ፤ ራስህን ማንን ታደርጋለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Si je me glorifie moi-même, ma gloire n''est rien. C''est mon Père qui me glorifie, lui que vous dites être votre Dieu,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መለሰ አለም። እኔ ራሴን ባከብር ክብሬ ከንቱ ነው፤ የሚያከብረኝ እናንተ አምላካችን የምትሉት አባቴ ነው፤

verses.en: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
verses.fr: et que vous ne connaissez pas. Pour moi, je le connais; et, si je disais que je ne le connais pas, je serais semblable à vous, un menteur. Mais je le connais, et je garde sa parole.
verses.am: አላወቃችሁትምም፥ እኔ ግን አውቀዋለሁ። አላውቀውም ብል እንደ እናንተ ሐሰተኛ በሆንሁ፤ ዳሩ ግን አውቀዋለሁ ቃሉንም እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.en: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
verses.fr: Abraham, votre père, a tressailli de joie de ce qu''il verrait mon jour: il l''a vu, et il s''est réjoui.
verses.am: አባታችሁ አብርሃም ቀኔን ያይ ዘንድ ሐሤት አደረገ፥ አየም ደስም አለው።

verses.en: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
verses.fr: Les Juifs lui dirent: Tu n''as pas encore cinquante ans, et tu as vu Abraham!
verses.am: አይሁድም። ገና አምሳ ዓመት ያልሆነህ አብርሃምን አይተሃልን? አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, avant qu''Abraham fût, je suis.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ አብርሃም ሳይወለድ እኔ አለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
verses.fr: Là-dessus, ils prirent des pierres pour les jeter contre lui; mais Jésus se cacha, et il sortit du temple.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሊወግሩት ድንጋይ አነሡ፤ ኢየሱስ ግን ተሰወራቸው ከመቅደስም ወጥቶ በመካከላቸው አልፎ ሄደ።

verses.en: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
verses.fr: Jésus vit, en passant, un homme aveugle de naissance.
verses.am: ሲያልፍም ከመወለዱ ጀምሮ ዕውር የሆነውን ሰው አየ።

verses.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
verses.fr: Ses disciples lui firent cette question: Rabbi, qui a péché, cet homme ou ses parents, pour qu''il soit né aveugle?
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ ይህ ሰው ዕውር ሆኖ እንዲወለድ ኃጢአት የሠራ ማን ነው? እርሱ ወይስ ወላጆቹ? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Ce n''est pas que lui ou ses parents aient péché; mais c''est afin que les oeuvres de Dieu soient manifestées en lui.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ። የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ በእርሱ እንዲገለጥ ነው እንጂ እርሱ ወይም ወላጆቹ ኃጢአት አልሠሩም።

verses.en: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
verses.fr: Il faut que je fasse, tandis qu''il est jour, les oeuvres de celui qui m''a envoyé; la nuit vient, où personne ne peut travailler.
verses.am: ቀን ሳለ የላከኝን ሥራ ላደርግ ይገባኛል፤ ማንም ሊሠራ የማይችልባት ሌሊት ትመጣለች።

verses.en: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
verses.fr: Pendant que je suis dans le monde, je suis la lumière du monde.
verses.am: በዓለም ሳለሁ የዓለም ብርሃን ነኝ።

verses.en: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
verses.fr: Après avoir dit cela, il cracha à terre, et fit de la boue avec sa salive. Puis il appliqua cette boue sur les yeux de l''aveugle,
verses.am: ይህን ብሎ ወደ መሬት እንትፍ አለ በምራቁም ጭቃ አድርጎ በጭቃው የዕውሩን ዓይኖች ቀባና።

verses.en: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
verses.fr: et lui dit: Va, et lave-toi au réservoir de Siloé nom qui signifie envoyé). Il y alla, se lava, et s''en retourna voyant clair.
verses.am: ሂድና በሰሊሆም መጠመቂያ ታጠብ አለው፤ ትርጓሜው የተላከ ነው። ስለዚህ ሄዶ ታጠበ እያየም መጣ።

verses.en: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
verses.fr: Ses voisins et ceux qui auparavant l''avaient connu comme un mendiant disaient: N''est-ce pas là celui qui se tenait assis et qui mendiait?
verses.am: ጐረቤቶቹም ቀድሞም ሲለምን አይተውት የነበሩ። ይህ ተቀምጦ ይለምን የነበረ አይደለምን? አሉ።

verses.en: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
verses.fr: Les uns disaient: C''est lui. D''autres disaient: Non, mais il lui ressemble. Et lui-même disait: C''est moi.
verses.am: ሌሎች። እርሱ ነው አሉ፤ ሌሎች። አይደለም እርሱን ይመስላል እንጂ አሉ፤ እርሱ። እኔ ነኝ አለ።

verses.en: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent donc: Comment tes yeux ont-ils été ouverts?
verses.am: ታድያ። ዓይኖችህ እንዴት ተከፈቱ? አሉት።

verses.en: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
verses.fr: Il répondit: L''homme qu''on appelle Jésus a fait de la boue, a oint mes yeux, et m''a dit: Va au réservoir de Siloé, et lave-toi. J''y suis allé, je me suis lavé, et j''ai recouvré la vue.
verses.am: እርሱ መልሶ። ኢየሱስ የሚባለው ሰው ጭቃ አድርጎ አይኖቼን ቀባና። ወደ ሰሊሆም መጠመቂያ ሄደህ ታጠብ አለኝ፤ ሄጄ ታጥቤም አየሁ አለ።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Où est cet homme? Il répondit: Je ne sais.
verses.am: ያ ሰው ወዴት ነው? አሉት። አላውቅም አለ።

verses.en: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
verses.fr: Ils menèrent vers les pharisiens celui qui avait été aveugle.
verses.am: በፊት ዕውር የነበረውን ሰው ወደ ፈሪሳውያን ወሰዱት።

verses.en: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
verses.fr: Or, c''était un jour de sabbat que Jésus avait fait de la boue, et lui avait ouvert les yeux.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ጭቃ አድርጎ ዓይኖቹን የከፈተበት ቀን ሰንበት ነበረ።

verses.en: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
verses.fr: De nouveau, les pharisiens aussi lui demandèrent comment il avait recouvré la vue. Et il leur dit: Il a appliqué de la boue sur mes yeux, je me suis lavé, et je vois.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ፈሪሳውያን ደግሞ እንዴት እንዳየ እንደ ገና ጠየቁት። እርሱም። ጭቃ በዓይኖቼ አኖረ ታጠብሁም አያለሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
verses.fr: Sur quoi quelques-uns des pharisiens dirent: Cet homme ne vient pas de Dieu, car il n''observe pas le sabbat. D''autres dirent: Comment un homme pécheur peut-il faire de tels miracles? Et il y eut division parmi eux.
verses.am: ከፈሪሳውያንም አንዳንዶቹ። ይህ ሰው ሰንበትን አያከብርምና ከእግዚአብሔር አይደለም አሉ። ሌሎች ግን። ኃጢአትኛ ሰው እንደነዚህ ያሉ ምልክቶች ሊያደርግ እንዴት ይችላል? አሉ።

verses.en: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
verses.fr: Ils dirent encore à l''aveugle: Toi, que dis-tu de lui, sur ce qu''il t''a ouvert les yeux? Il répondit: C''est un prophète.
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም መለያየት ሆነ። ከዚህም የተነሣ ዕውሩን። አንተ ዓይኖችህን ስለ ከፈተ ስለ እርሱ ምን ትላለህ? ደግሞ አሉት። እርሱም። ነቢይ ነው አለ።

verses.en: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
verses.fr: Les Juifs ne crurent point qu''il eût été aveugle et qu''il eût recouvré la vue jusqu''à ce qu''ils eussent fait venir ses parents.
verses.am: አይሁድ የዚያን ያየውን ወላጆች እስኪጠሩ ድረስ ዕውር እንደ ነበረ እንዳየም ስለ እርሱ አላመኑም፥

verses.en: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
verses.fr: Et ils les interrogèrent, disant: Est-ce là votre fils, que vous dites être né aveugle? Comment donc voit-il maintenant?
verses.am: እነርሱንም። እናንተ ዕውር ሆኖ ተወለደ የምትሉት ልጃችሁ ይህ ነውን? ታድያ አሁን እንዴት ያያል? ብለው ጠየቁአቸው።

verses.en: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
verses.fr: Ses parents répondirent: Nous savons que c''est notre fils, et qu''il est né aveugle;
verses.am: ወላጆቹም መልሰው። ይህ ልጃችን እንደ ሆነ ዕውርም ሆኖ እንደ ተወለደ አናውቃለን፤

verses.en: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
verses.fr: mais comment il voit maintenant, ou qui lui a ouvert les yeux, c''est ce que nous ne savons. Interrogez-le lui-même, il a de l''âge, il parlera de ce qui le concerne.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን አሁን እንዴት እንዳየ አናውቅም፥ ወይም ዓይኖቹን ማን እንደ ከፈተ እኛ አናውቅም፤ ጠይቁት እርሱ ሙሉ ሰው ነው፤ እርሱ ስለ ራሱ ይናገራል አሉ።

verses.en: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
verses.fr: Ses parents dirent cela parce qu''ils craignaient les Juifs; car les Juifs étaient déjà convenus que, si quelqu''un reconnaissait Jésus pour le Christ, il serait exclu de la synagogue.
verses.am: ወላጆቹ አይሁድን ስለ ፈሩ ይህን አሉ፤ እርሱ ክርስቶስ ነው ብሎ የሚመሰክር ቢኖር ከምኵራብ እንዲያወጡት አይሁድ ከዚህ በፊት ተስማምተው ነበርና።

verses.en: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ses parents dirent: Il a de l''âge, interrogez-le lui-même.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወላጆቹ። ሙሉ ሰው ነው፥ ጠይቁት አሉ።

verses.en: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens appelèrent une seconde fois l''homme qui avait été aveugle, et ils lui dirent: Donne gloire à Dieu; nous savons que cet homme est un pécheur.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ዕውር የነበረውን ሰው ሁለተኛ ጠርተው። እግዚአብሔርን አክብር፤ ይህ ሰው ኃጢአተኛ መሆኑን እኛ እናውቃለን አሉት።

verses.en: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
verses.fr: Il répondit: S''il est un pécheur, je ne sais; je sais une chose, c''est que j''étais aveugle et que maintenant je vois.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። ኃጢአተኛ መሆኑን አላውቅም፤ ዕውር እንደ ነበርሁ አሁንም እንዳይ ይህን አንድ ነገር አውቃለሁ አለ።

verses.en: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Que t''a-t-il fait? Comment t''a-t-il ouvert les yeux?
verses.am: ደግመውም። ምን አደረገልህ? እንዴትስ ዓይኖችህን ከፈተ? አሉት።

verses.en: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Je vous l''ai déjà dit, et vous n''avez pas écouté; pourquoi voulez-vous l''entendre encore? Voulez-vous aussi devenir ses disciples?
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። አስቀድሜ ነገርኋችሁ አልሰማችሁምም፤ ስለ ምን ዳግመኛ ልትሰሙ ትወዳላችሁ? እናንተ ደግሞ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ልትሆኑ ትወዳላችሁን? አላቸው።

verses.en: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.
verses.fr: Ils l''injurièrent et dirent: C''est toi qui es son disciple; nous, nous sommes disciples de Moïse.
verses.am: ተሳድበውም። አንተ የእርሱ ደቀ መዝሙር ነህ፥ እኛ ግን የሙሴ ደቀ መዛሙርት ነን፤

verses.en: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
verses.fr: Nous savons que Dieu a parlé à Moïse; mais celui-ci, nous ne savons d''où il est.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንደ ተናገረው እኛ እናውቃለን፥ ይህ ሰው ግን ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ አናውቅም አሉት።

verses.en: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
verses.fr: Cet homme leur répondit: Il est étonnant que vous ne sachiez d''où il est; et cependant il m''a ouvert les yeux.
verses.am: ሰውዬው መለሰ እንዲህም አላቸው። ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ እናንተ አለማወቃችሁ ይህ ድንቅ ነገር ነው፥ ዳሩ ግን ዓይኖቼን ከፈተ።

verses.en: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
verses.fr: Nous savons que Dieu n''exauce point les pécheurs; mais, si quelqu''un l''honore et fait sa volonté, c''est celui là qu''il exauce.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ፈቃዱንም የሚያደርግ ቢኖር ያንን እግዚአብሔር ይሰማዋል እንጂ ኃጢአተኞችን እንዳይሰማ እናውቃለን።

verses.en: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
verses.fr: Jamais on n''a entendu dire que quelqu''un ait ouvert les yeux d''un aveugle-né.
verses.am: ዕውር ሆኖ የተወለደውን ዓይኖች ማንም እንደ ከፈተ ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ አልተሰማም፤

verses.en: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
verses.fr: Si cet homme ne venait pas de Dieu, il ne pourrait rien faire.
verses.am: ይህ ሰው ከእግዚአብሔር ባይሆን ምንም ሊያደርግ ባልቻለም ነበር።

verses.en: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Tu es né tout entier dans le péché, et tu nous enseignes! Et ils le chassèrent.
verses.am: መልሰው። አንተ ሁለንተናህ በኃጢአት ተወለድህ፥ አንተም እኛን ታስተምረናለህን? አሉት። ወደ ውጭም አወጡት።

verses.en: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
verses.fr: Jésus apprit qu''ils l''avaient chassé; et, l''ayant rencontré, il lui dit: Crois-tu au Fils de Dieu?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ ውጭ እንዳወጡት ሰማ ሲያገኘውም። አንተ በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ታምናለህን? አለው።

verses.en: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
verses.fr: Il répondit: Et qui est-il, Seigneur, afin que je croie en lui?
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በእርሱ አምን ዘንድ ማን ነው? አለ።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
verses.fr: Tu l''as vu, lui dit Jésus, et celui qui te parle, c''est lui.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። አይተኸዋልም ከአንተ ጋርም የሚናገረው እርሱ ነው አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Je crois, Seigneur. Et il se prosterna devant lui.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አምናለሁ አለ፤ ሰገደለትም።

verses.en: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
verses.fr: Puis Jésus dit: Je suis venu dans ce monde pour un jugement, pour que ceux qui ne voient point voient, et que ceux qui voient deviennent aveugles.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። የማያዩ እንዲያዩ የሚያዩም እንዲታወሩ እኔ ወደዚህ ዓለም ለፍርድ መጣሁ አለ።

verses.en: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
verses.fr: Quelques pharisiens qui étaient avec lui, ayant entendu ces paroles, lui dirent: Nous aussi, sommes-nous aveugles?
verses.am: ከፈሪሳውያንም ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት ይህን ሰምተው። እኛ ደግሞ ዕውሮች ነንን? አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Si vous étiez aveugles, vous n''auriez pas de péché. Mais maintenant vous dites: Nous voyons. C''est pour cela que votre péché subsiste.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አላቸው። ዕውሮችስ ብትሆኑ ኃጢአት ባልሆነባችሁም ነበር፤ አሁን ግን። እናያለን ትላላችሁ፤ ኃጢአታችሁ ይኖራል።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, celui qui n''entre pas par la porte dans la bergerie, mais qui y monte par ailleurs, est un voleur et un brigand.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ወደ በጎች በረት በበሩ የማይገባ በሌላ መንገድ ግን የሚወጣ እርሱ ሌባ ወንበዴም ነው፤

verses.en: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.fr: Mais celui qui entre par la porte est le berger des brebis.
verses.am: በበሩ የሚገባ ግን የበጎች እረኛ ነው።

verses.en: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
verses.fr: Le portier lui ouvre, et les brebis entendent sa voix; il appelle par leur nom les brebis qui lui appartiennent, et il les conduit dehors.
verses.am: ለእርሱ በረኛው ይከፍትለታል፤ በጎቹም ድምፁን ይሰሙታል፥ የራሱንም በጎች በየስማቸው ጠርቶ ይወስዳቸዋል።

verses.en: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il a fait sortir toutes ses propres brebis, il marche devant elles; et les brebis le suivent, parce qu''elles connaissent sa voix.
verses.am: የራሱንም ሁሉ ካወጣቸው በኋላ በፊታቸው ይሄዳል፥ በጎቹም ድምፁን ያውቃሉና ይከተሉታል፤

verses.en: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
verses.fr: Elles ne suivront point un étranger; mais elles fuiront loin de lui, parce qu''elles ne connaissent pas la voix des étrangers.
verses.am: ከሌላው ግን ይሸሻሉ እንጂ አይከተሉትም፥ የሌሎችን ድምፅ አያውቁምና።

verses.en: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit cette parabole, mais ils ne comprirent pas de quoi il leur parlait.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ይህን ምሳሌ ነገራቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን የነገራቸው ምን እንደ ሆነ አላስተዋሉም።

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit encore: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, je suis la porte des brebis.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ አላቸው። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እኔ የበጎች በር ነኝ።

verses.en: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui sont venus avant moi sont des voleurs et des brigands; mais les brebis ne les ont point écoutés.
verses.am: ከእኔ በፊት የመጡ ሁሉ ሌቦችና ወንበዴዎች ናቸው፤ ዳሩ ግን በጎቹ አልሰሙአቸውም።

verses.en: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
verses.fr: Je suis la porte. Si quelqu''un entre par moi, il sera sauvé; il entrera et il sortira, et il trouvera des pâturages.
verses.am: በሩ እኔ ነኝ፤ በእኔ የሚገባ ቢኖር ይድናል፥ ይገባልም ይወጣልም መሰማሪያም ያገኛል።

verses.en: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
verses.fr: Le voleur ne vient que pour dérober, égorger et détruire; moi, je suis venu afin que les brebis aient la vie, et qu''elles soient dans l''abondance.
verses.am: ሌባው ሊሰርቅና ሊያርድ ሊያጠፋም እንጂ ስለ ሌላ አይመጣም፤ እኔ ሕይወት እንዲሆንላቸው እንዲበዛላቸውም መጣሁ።

verses.en: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
verses.fr: Je suis le bon berger. Le bon berger donne sa vie pour ses brebis.
verses.am: መልካም እረኛ እኔ ነኝ። መልካም እረኛ ነፍሱን ስለ በጎቹ ያኖራል።

verses.en: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
verses.fr: Mais le mercenaire, qui n''est pas le berger, et à qui n''appartiennent pas les brebis, voit venir le loup, abandonne les brebis, et prend la fuite; et le loup les ravit et les disperse.
verses.am: እረኛ ያልሆነው በጎቹም የእርሱ ያልሆኑ ሞያተኛ ግን ተኵላ ሲመጣ ባየ ጊዜ በጎቹን ትቶ ይሸሻል፤ ተኵላም ይነጥቃቸዋል በጎቹንም ይበትናቸዋል።

verses.en: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
verses.fr: Le mercenaire s''enfuit, parce qu''il est mercenaire, et qu''il ne se met point en peine des brebis.
verses.am: ሞያተኛ ስለ ሆነ ለበጎቹም ስለማይገደው ሞያተኛው ይሸሻል።

verses.en: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
verses.fr: Je suis le bon berger. Je connais mes brebis, et elles me connaissent,
verses.am: ከዚህም በረት ያልሆኑ ሌሎች በጎች አሉኝ፤ እነርሱን ደግሞ ላመጣ ይገባኛል ድምፄንም ይሰማሉ፥ አንድም መንጋ ይሆናሉ እረኛውም አንድ።

verses.en: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.fr: comme le Père me connaît et comme je connais le Père; et je donne ma vie pour mes brebis.
verses.am: ከዚህም በረት ያልሆኑ ሌሎች በጎች አሉኝ፤ እነርሱን ደግሞ ላመጣ ይገባኛል ድምፄንም ይሰማሉ፥ አንድም መንጋ ይሆናሉ እረኛውም አንድ።

verses.en: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
verses.fr: J''ai encore d''autres brebis, qui ne sont pas de cette bergerie; celles-là, il faut que je les amène; elles entendront ma voix, et il y aura un seul troupeau, un seul berger.
verses.am: ነፍሴን ደግሞ አነሣት ዘንድ አኖራለሁና ስለዚህ አብ ይወደኛል።

verses.en: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
verses.fr: Le Père m''aime, parce que je donne ma vie, afin de la reprendre.
verses.am: እኔ በፈቃዴ አኖራታለሁ እንጂ ከእኔ ማንም አይወስዳትም። ላኖራት ሥልጣን አለኝ ደግሞም ላነሣት ሥልጣን አለኝ ይህችን ትእዛዝ ከአባቴ ተቀበልሁ።

verses.en: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
verses.fr: Personne ne me l''ôte, mais je la donne de moi-même; j''ai le pouvoir de la donner, et j''ai le pouvoir de la reprendre: tel est l''ordre que j''ai reçu de mon Père.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከዚህ ቃል የተነሣ በአይሁድ መካከል እንደ ገና መለያየት ሆነ።

verses.en: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
verses.fr: Il y eut de nouveau, à cause de ces paroles, division parmi les Juifs.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ብዙዎች። ጋኔን አለበት አብዶአልም፤ ስለ ምንስ ትሰሙታላችሁ? አሉ።

verses.en: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
verses.fr: Plusieurs d''entre eux disaient: Il a un démon, il est fou; pourquoi l''écoutez-vous?
verses.am: ሌሎችም። ይህ ጋኔን ያለበት ሰው ቃል አይደለም፤ ጋኔን የዕውሮችን ዓይኖች ሊከፍት ይችላልን? አሉ።

verses.en: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
verses.fr: D''autres disaient: Ce ne sont pas les paroles d''un démoniaque; un démon peut-il ouvrir les yeux des aveugles?
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም የመቅደስ መታደስ በዓል ሆነ፤

verses.en: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
verses.fr: On célébrait à Jérusalem la fête de la Dédicace. C''était l''hiver.
verses.am: ክረምትም ነበረ። ኢየሱስም በመቅደስ በሰሎሞን ደጅ መመላለሻ ይመላለስ ነበር።

verses.en: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.
verses.fr: Et Jésus se promenait dans le temple, sous le portique de Salomon.
verses.am: አይሁድም እርሱን ከበው። እስከ መቼ ድረስ በጥርጣሪ ታቆየናለህ? አንተ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆንህ ገልጠህ ንገረን አሉት።

verses.en: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
verses.fr: Les Juifs l''entourèrent, et lui dirent: Jusques à quand tiendras-tu notre esprit en suspens? Si tu es le Christ, dis-le nous franchement.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መለሰላቸው፥ እንዲህ ሲል። ነገርኋችሁ አታምኑምም እኔ በአባቴ ስም የማደርገው ሥራ ይህ ስለ እኔ ይመሰክራል፤

verses.en: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Je vous l''ai dit, et vous ne croyez pas. Les oeuvres que je fais au nom de mon Père rendent témoignage de moi.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን እንደ ነገርኋችሁ ከበጎቼ ስላልሆናችሁ አታምኑም።

verses.en: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
verses.fr: Mais vous ne croyez pas, parce que vous n''êtes pas de mes brebis.
verses.am: በጎቼ ድምፄን ይሰማሉ እኔም አውቃቸዋለሁ ይከተሉኝማል፤

verses.en: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
verses.fr: Mes brebis entendent ma voix; je les connais, et elles me suivent.
verses.am: እኔም የዘላለም ሕይወትን እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ ለዘላለምም አይጠፉም፥ ከእጄም ማንም አይነጥቃቸውም።

verses.en: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
verses.fr: Je leur donne la vie éternelle; et elles ne périront jamais, et personne ne les ravira de ma main.
verses.am: የሰጠኝ አባቴ ከሁሉ ይበልጣል፥ ከአባቴም እጅ ሊነጥቃቸው ማንም አይችልም።

verses.en: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.
verses.fr: Mon Père, qui me les a données, est plus grand que tous; et personne ne peut les ravir de la main de mon Père.
verses.am: እኔና አብ አንድ ነን።

verses.en: I and my Father are one.
verses.fr: Moi et le Père nous sommes un.
verses.am: አይሁድ ሊወግሩት ደግመው ድንጋይ አነሡ።

verses.en: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.fr: Alors les Juifs prirent de nouveau des pierres pour le lapider.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ። ከአባቴ ብዙ መልካም ሥራ አሳየኋችሁ፤ ከእነርሱ ስለ ማናቸው ሥራ ትወግሩኛላችሁ? ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.en: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Je vous ai fait voir plusieurs bonnes oeuvres venant de mon Père: pour laquelle me lapidez-vous?
verses.am: አይሁድም። ስለ መልካም ሥራ አንወግርህም፤ ስለ ስድብ፤ አንተም ሰው ስትሆን ራስህን አምላክ ስለ ማድረግህ ነው እንጂ ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.en: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
verses.fr: Les Juifs lui répondirent: Ce n''est point pour une bonne oeuvre que nous te lapidons, mais pour un blasphème, et parce que toi, qui es un homme, tu te fais Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰላቸው። እኔ። አማልክት ናችሁ አልሁ ተብሎ በሕጋችሁ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: N''est-il pas écrit dans votre loi: J''ai dit: Vous êtes des dieux?
verses.am: መጽሐፉ ሊሻር አይቻልምና እነዚያን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል የመጣላቸውን አማልክት ካላቸው፥

verses.en: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
verses.fr: Si elle a appelé dieux ceux à qui la parole de Dieu a été adressée, et si l''Ecriture ne peut être anéantie,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነኝ ስላልሁ እናንተ አብ የቀደሰውን ወደ ዓለምም የላከውን። ትሳደባለህ ትሉታላችሁን?

verses.en: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
verses.fr: celui que le Père a sanctifié et envoyé dans le monde, vous lui dites: Tu blasphèmes! Et cela parce que j''ai dit: Je suis le Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: እኔ የአባቴን ሥራ ባላደርግ አትመኑኝ፤

verses.en: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
verses.fr: Si je ne fais pas les oeuvres de mon Père, ne me croyez pas.
verses.am: ባደርገው ግን፥ እኔን ስንኳ ባታምኑ አብ በእኔ እንደ ሆነ እኔም በአብ እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቁና ታስተውሉ ዘንድ ሥራውን እመኑ።

verses.en: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
verses.fr: Mais si je les fais, quand même vous ne me croyez point, croyez à ces oeuvres, afin que vous sachiez et reconnaissiez que le Père est en moi et que je suis dans le Père.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ደግመው ሊይዙት ፈለጉ፤ ከእጃቸውም ወጣ።

verses.en: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
verses.fr: Là-dessus, ils cherchèrent encore à le saisir, mais il s''échappa de leurs mains.
verses.am: ዮሐንስም በመጀመሪያ ያጠምቅበት ወደ ነበረው ስፍራ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ማዶ እንደ ገና ሄደ በዚያም ኖረ።

verses.en: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
verses.fr: Jésus s''en alla de nouveau au delà du Jourdain, dans le lieu où Jean avait d''abord baptisé. Et il y demeura.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎችም ወደ እርሱ መጥተው። ዮሐንስ አንድ ምልክት ስንኳ አላደረገም፥ ነገር ግን ዮሐንስ ስለዚህ ሰው የተናገረው ሁሉ እውነት ነበረ አሉ።

verses.en: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
verses.fr: Beaucoup de gens vinrent à lui, et ils disaient: Jean n''a fait aucun miracle; mais tout ce que Jean a dit de cet homme était vrai.
verses.am: በዚያም ብዙዎች በእርሱ አመኑ።

verses.en: And many believed on him there.
verses.fr: Et, dans ce lieu-là, plusieurs crurent en lui.
verses.am: በዚያም ብዙዎች በእርሱ አመኑ።

verses.en: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.fr: Il y avait un homme malade, Lazare, de Béthanie, village de Marie et de Marthe, sa soeur.
verses.am: ከማርያምና ከእኅትዋ ከማርታ መንደር ከቢታንያ የሆነ አልዓዛር የሚባል አንድ ሰው ታሞ ነበር።

verses.en: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
verses.fr: C''était cette Marie qui oignit de parfum le Seigneur et qui lui essuya les pieds avec ses cheveux, et c''était son frère Lazare qui était malade.
verses.am: ማርያምም ጌታን ሽቱ የቀባችው እግሩንም በጠጕርዋ ያበሰችው ነበረች፤ ወንድምዋም አልዓዛር ታሞ ነበር።

verses.en: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
verses.fr: Les soeurs envoyèrent dire à Jésus: Seigneur, voici, celui que tu aimes est malade.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እኅቶቹ ጌታ ሆይ፥ እነሆ የምትወደው ታሞአል ብለው ወደ እርሱ ላኩ።

verses.en: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
verses.fr: Après avoir entendu cela, Jésus dit: Cette maladie n''est point à la mort; mais elle est pour la gloire de Dieu, afin que le Fils de Dieu soit glorifié par elle.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሰምቶ። ይህ ህመም የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ በእርሱ ይከብር ዘንድ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ክብር ነው እንጂ ለሞት አይደለም አለ።

verses.en: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.fr: Or, Jésus aimait Marthe, et sa soeur, et Lazare.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ማርታንና እኅትዋን አልዓዛርንም ይወድ ነበር።

verses.en: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
verses.fr: Lors donc qu''il eut appris que Lazare était malade, il resta deux jours encore dans le lieu où il était,
verses.am: እንደ ታመመም በሰማ ጊዜ ያን ጊዜ በነበረበት ስፍራ ሁለት ቀን ዋለ፤

verses.en: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
verses.fr: et il dit ensuite aux disciples: Retournons en Judée.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። ወደ ይሁዳ ደግሞ እንሂድ አላቸው።

verses.en: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
verses.fr: Les disciples lui dirent: Rabbi, les Juifs tout récemment cherchaient à te lapider, et tu retournes en Judée!
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። መምህር ሆይ፥ አይሁድ ከጥቂት ጊዜ በፊት ሊወግሩህ ይፈልጉ ነበር፥ ደግሞም ወደዚያ ትሄዳለህን? አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: N''y a-t-il pas douze heures au jour? Si quelqu''un marche pendant le jour, il ne bronche point, parce qu''il voit la lumière de ce monde;
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ቀኑ አሥራ ሁለት ሰዓት አይደለምን? በቀን የሚመላለስ ቢኖር የዚህን ዓለም ብርሃን ያያልና አይሰናከልም፤

verses.en: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
verses.fr: mais, si quelqu''un marche pendant la nuit, il bronche, parce que la lumière n''est pas en lui.
verses.am: በሌሊት የሚመላለስ ቢኖር ግን ብርሃን በእርሱ ስለ ሌለ ይሰናከላል አላቸው።

verses.en: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
verses.fr: Après ces paroles, il leur dit: Lazare, notre ami, dort; mais je vais le réveiller.
verses.am: ይህን ተናገረ፤ ከዚህም በኋላ። ወዳጃችን አልዓዛር ተኝቶአል፤ ነገር ግን ከእንቅልፉ ላስነሣው እሄዳለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
verses.fr: Les disciples lui dirent: Seigneur, s''il dort, il sera guéri.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ተኝቶስ እንደ ሆነ ይድናል አሉት።

verses.en: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
verses.fr: Jésus avait parlé de sa mort, mais ils crurent qu''il parlait de l''assoupissement du sommeil.
verses.am: ኢየሱስስ ስለ ሞቱ ተናግሮ ነበር፤ እነርሱ ግን ስለ እንቅልፍ መተኛት እንደ ተናገረ መሰላቸው።

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
verses.fr: Alors Jésus leur dit ouvertement: Lazare est mort.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በግልጥ። አልዓዛር ሞተ፤

verses.en: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
verses.fr: Et, à cause de vous, afin que vous croyiez, je me réjouis de ce que je n''étais pas là. Mais allons vers lui.
verses.am: እንድታምኑም በዚያ ባለመኖሬ ስለ እናንተ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ነገር ግን ወደ እርሱ እንሂድ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
verses.fr: Sur quoi Thomas, appelé Didyme, dit aux autres disciples: Allons aussi, afin de mourir avec lui.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ዲዲሞስ የሚሉት ቶማስ ለባልንጀሮቹ ለደቀ መዛሙርት። ከእርሱ ጋር እንሞት ዘንድ እኛ ደግሞ እንሂድ አለ።

verses.en: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
verses.fr: Jésus, étant arrivé, trouva que Lazare était déjà depuis quatre jours dans le sépulcre.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በመጣ ጊዜ በመቃብር እስከ አሁን አራት ቀን ሆኖት አገኘው።

verses.en: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
verses.fr: Et, comme Béthanie était près de Jérusalem, à quinze stades environ,
verses.am: ቢታንያም አሥራ አምስት ምዕራፍ ያህል ለኢየሩሳሌም ቅርብ ነበረች።

verses.en: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
verses.fr: beaucoup de Juifs étaient venus vers Marthe et Marie, pour les consoler de la mort de leur frère.
verses.am: ከአይሁድም ብዙዎች ስለ ወንድማቸው ሊያጽናኑአቸው ወደ ማርታና ወደ ማርያም መጥተው ነበር።

verses.en: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
verses.fr: Lorsque Marthe apprit que Jésus arrivait, elle alla au-devant de lui, tandis que Marie se tenait assise à la maison.
verses.am: ማርታም ኢየሱስ እንደ መጣ በሰማች ጊዜ ልትቀበለው ወጣች፤ ማርያም ግን በቤት ተቀምጣ ነበር።

verses.en: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.fr: Marthe dit à Jésus: Seigneur, si tu eusses été ici, mon frère ne serait pas mort.
verses.am: ማርታም ኢየሱስን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ በዚህ ኖረህ ብትሆን ወንድሜ ባልሞተም ነበር፤

verses.en: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
verses.fr: Mais, maintenant même, je sais que tout ce que tu demanderas à Dieu, Dieu te l''accordera.
verses.am: አሁንም ከእግዚአብሔር የምትለምነውን ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሰጥህ አውቃለሁ አለችው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Ton frère ressuscitera.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ወንድምሽ ይነሣል አላት።

verses.en: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
verses.fr: Je sais, lui répondit Marthe, qu''il ressuscitera à la résurrection, au dernier jour.
verses.am: ማርታም። በመጨረሻው ቀን በትንሣኤ እንዲነሣ አውቃለሁ አለችው።

verses.en: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Je suis la résurrection et la vie. Celui qui croit en moi vivra, quand même il serait mort;
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ትንሣኤና ሕይወት እኔ ነኝ፤ የሚያምንብኝ ቢሞት እንኳ ሕያው ይሆናል፤

verses.en: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
verses.fr: et quiconque vit et croit en moi ne mourra jamais. Crois-tu cela?
verses.am: ሕያው የሆነም የሚያምንብኝም ሁሉ ለዘላለም አይሞትም፤ ይህን ታምኚያለሽን? አላት።

verses.en: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
verses.fr: Elle lui dit: Oui, Seigneur, je crois que tu es le Christ, le Fils de Dieu, qui devait venir dans le monde.
verses.am: እርስዋም። አዎን ጌታ ሆይ፤ አንተ ወደ ዓለም የሚመጣው ክርስቶስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆንህ እኔ አምናለሁ አለችው።

verses.en: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
verses.fr: Ayant ainsi parlé, elle s''en alla. Puis elle appela secrètement Marie, sa soeur, et lui dit: Le maître est ici, et il te demande.
verses.am: ይህንም ብላ ሄደች እኅትዋንም ማርያምን በስውር ጠርታ። መምህሩ መጥቶአል ይጠራሽማል አለቻት።

verses.en: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
verses.fr: Dès que Marie eut entendu, elle se leva promptement, et alla vers lui.
verses.am: እርስዋም በሰማች ጊዜ ፈጥና ተነሣች ወደ እርሱም መጣች፤

verses.en: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
verses.fr: Car Jésus n''était pas encore entré dans le village, mais il était dans le lieu où Marthe l''avait rencontré.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ማርታ በተቀበለችበት ስፍራ ነበረ እንጂ ገና ወደ መንደሩ አልገባም ነበር።

verses.en: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
verses.fr: Les Juifs qui étaient avec Marie dans la maison et qui la consolaient, l''ayant vue se lever promptement et sortir, la suivirent, disant: Elle va au sépulcre, pour y pleurer.
verses.am: ሲያጽናኑአት ከእርስዋ ጋር በቤት የነበሩ አይሁድም ማርያም ፈጥና እንደ ተነሣችና እንደ ወጣች ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ወደ መቃብር ሄዳ በዚያ ልታለቅስ መስሎአቸው ተከተሉአት።

verses.en: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.fr: Lorsque Marie fut arrivée là où était Jésus, et qu''elle le vit, elle tomba à ses pieds, et lui dit: Seigneur, si tu eusses été ici, mon frère ne serait pas mort.
verses.am: ማርያምም ኢየሱስ ወዳለበት መጥታ ባየችው ጊዜ በእግሩ ላይ ወድቃ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ በዚህ ኖረህ ብትሆን ወንድሜ ባልሞተም ነበር አለችው።

verses.en: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled.
verses.fr: Jésus, la voyant pleurer, elle et les Juifs qui étaient venus avec elle, frémit en son esprit, et fut tout ému.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እርስዋ ስታለቅስ ከእርስዋም ጋር የመጡት አይሁድ ሲያለቅሱ አይቶ በመንፈሱ አዘነ በራሱም ታወከ፤

verses.en: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Où l''avez-vous mis? Seigneur, lui répondirent-ils, viens et vois.
verses.am: ወዴት አኖራችሁት? አለም። እነርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ መጥተህ እይ አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus wept.
verses.fr: Jésus pleura.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንባውን አፈሰሰ።

verses.en: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
verses.fr: Sur quoi les Juifs dirent: Voyez comme il l''aimait.
verses.am: ስለዚህ አይሁድ። እንዴት ይወደው እንደ ነበረ እዩ አሉ።

verses.en: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
verses.fr: Et quelques-uns d''entre eux dirent: Lui qui a ouvert les yeux de l''aveugle, ne pouvait-il pas faire aussi que cet homme ne mourût point?
verses.am: ከእነርሱ ግን አንዳንዶቹ። ይህ የዕውሩን ዓይኖች የከፈተ ይህን ደግሞ እንዳይሞት ያደርግ ዘንድ ባልቻለም ነበርን? አሉ።

verses.en: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
verses.fr: Jésus frémissant de nouveau en lui-même, se rendit au sépulcre. C''était une grotte, et une pierre était placée devant.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በራሱ አዝኖ ወደ መቃብሩ መጣ፤ እርሱም ዋሻ ነበረ፤ ድንጋይም ተገጥሞበት ነበር።

verses.en: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
verses.fr: Jésus dit: Otez la pierre. Marthe, la soeur du mort, lui dit: Seigneur, il sent déjà, car il y a quatre jours qu''il est là.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ። ድንጋዩን አንሡ አለ። የሞተውም እኅት ማርታ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ከሞተ አራት ቀን ሆኖታልና አሁን ይሸታል አለችው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Ne t''ai-je pas dit que, si tu crois, tu verras la gloire de Dieu?
verses.am: ኢየሱስ። ብታምኚስ የእግዚአብሔርን ክብር እንድታዪ አልነገርሁሽምን? አላት።

verses.en: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
verses.fr: Ils ôtèrent donc la pierre. Et Jésus leva les yeux en haut, et dit: Père, je te rends grâces de ce que tu m''as exaucé.
verses.am: ድንጋዩንም አነሡት። ኢየሱስም ዓይኖቹን ወደ ላይ አንሥቶ። አባት ሆይ፥ ስለ ሰማኸኝ አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.fr: Pour moi, je savais que tu m''exauces toujours; mais j''ai parlé à cause de la foule qui m''entoure, afin qu''ils croient que c''est toi qui m''as envoyé.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜም እንድትሰማኝ አወቅሁ፤ ነገር ግን አንተ እንደ ላክኸኝ ያምኑ ዘንድ በዚህ ዙሪያ ስለ ቆሙት ሕዝብ ተናገርሁ አለ።

verses.en: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
verses.fr: Ayant dit cela, il cria d''une voix forte: Lazare, sors!
verses.am: ይህንም ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ። አልዓዛር ሆይ፥ ወደ ውጭ ና ብሎ ጮኸ።
