verses.en: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verses.fr: Et le mort sortit, les pieds et les mains liés de bandes, et le visage enveloppé d''un linge. Jésus leur dit: Déliez-le, et laissez-le aller.
verses.am: የሞተውም እጆቹና እግሮቹ በመግነዝ እንደ ተገነዙ ወጣ፤ ፈቱም በጨርቅ እንደ ተጠመጠመ ነበር። ኢየሱስም። ፍቱትና ይሂድ ተዉት አላቸው።

verses.en: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
verses.fr: Plusieurs des Juifs qui étaient venus vers Marie, et qui virent ce que fit Jésus, crurent en lui.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወደ ማርያም ከመጡት፥ ኢየሱስም ያደረገውን ካዩት ከአይሁድ ብዙዎች በእርሱ አመኑ፤

verses.en: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
verses.fr: Mais quelques-uns d''entre eux allèrent trouver les pharisiens, et leur dirent ce que Jésus avait fait.
verses.am: ከእነርሱ አንዳንዶቹ ግን ወደ ፈሪሳውያን ሄደው ኢየሱስ ያደረገውን ነገሩአቸው።

verses.en: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
verses.fr: Alors les principaux sacrificateurs et les pharisiens assemblèrent le sanhédrin, et dirent: Que ferons-nous? Car cet homme fait beaucoup de miracles.
verses.am: እንግዲህ የካህናት አለቆችና ፈሪሳውያን ሸንጎ ሰብስበው። ምን እናድርግ? ይህ ሰው ብዙ ምልክቶች ያደርጋልና።

verses.en: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
verses.fr: Si nous le laissons faire, tous croiront en lui, et les Romains viendront détruire et notre ville et notre nation.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ብንተወው ሁሉ በእርሱ ያምናሉ፤ የሮሜም ሰዎች መጥተው አገራችንን ወገናችንንም ይወስዳሉ አሉ።

verses.en: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
verses.fr: L''un d''eux, Caïphe, qui était souverain sacrificateur cette année-là, leur dit: Vous n''y entendez rien;
verses.am: በዚያችም ዓመት ሊቀ ካህናት የነበረ ቀያፋ የሚሉት ከእነርሱ አንዱ። እናንተ ምንም አታውቁም፤

verses.en: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
verses.fr: vous ne réfléchissez pas qu''il est dans votre intérêt qu''un seul homme meure pour le peuple, et que la nation entière ne périsse pas.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ከሚጠፋ አንድ ሰው ስለ ሕዝቡ ይሞት ዘንድ እንዲሻለን አታስቡም አላቸው።

verses.en: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
verses.fr: Or, il ne dit pas cela de lui-même; mais étant souverain sacrificateur cette année-là, il prophétisa que Jésus devait mourir pour la nation.
verses.am: ይህንም የተናገረ ከራሱ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን በዚያች ዓመት ሊቀ ካህናት ነበረና ኢየሱስ ስለ ሕዝቡ ሊሞት እንዳለው ትንቢት ተናገረ፤

verses.en: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
verses.fr: Et ce n''était pas pour la nation seulement; c''était aussi afin de réunir en un seul corps les enfants de Dieu dispersés.
verses.am: ስለ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን የተበተኑትን የእግዚአብሔርን ልጆች ደግሞ በአንድነት እንዲሰበስባቸው ነው እንጂ።

verses.en: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
verses.fr: Dès ce jour, ils résolurent de le faire mourir.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከዚያ ቀን ጀምረው ሊገድሉት ተማከሩ።

verses.en: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi Jésus ne se montra plus ouvertement parmi les Juifs; mais il se retira dans la contrée voisine du désert, dans une ville appelée Ephraïm; et là il demeurait avec ses disciples.
verses.am: ከዚያ ወዲያም ኢየሱስ በአይሁድ መካከል ተገልጦ አልተመላለሰም፤ ነገር ግን ከዚያ በምድረ በዳ አጠገብ ወዳለች ምድር፥ ኤፍሬም ወደምትባል ከተማ ሄደ፤ በዚያም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
verses.fr: La Pâque des Juifs était proche. Et beaucoup de gens du pays montèrent à Jérusalem avant la Pâque, pour se purifier.
verses.am: የአይሁድም ፋሲካ ቀርቦ ነበር። ብዙ ሰዎችም ራሳቸውን ያነጹ ዘንድ ከፋሲካ በፊት ከአገሩ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጡ።

verses.en: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
verses.fr: Ils cherchaient Jésus, et ils se disaient les uns aux autres dans le temple: Que vous en semble? Ne viendra-t-il pas à la fête?
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም ይፈልጉት ነበር፤ በመቅደስም ቆመው እርስ በርሳቸው። ምን ይመስላችኋል? ወደ በዓሉ አይመጣም ይሆንን? ተባባሉ።

verses.en: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
verses.fr: Or, les principaux sacrificateurs et les pharisiens avaient donné l''ordre que, si quelqu''un savait où il était, il le déclarât, afin qu''on se saisît de lui.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችም ፈሪሳውያንም ይይዙት ዘንድ እርሱ ያለበትን ስፍራ የሚያውቀው ሰው ቢኖር እንዲያመለክታቸው አዘው ነበር።

verses.en: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.fr: Six jours avant la Pâque, Jésus arriva à Béthanie, où était Lazare, qu''il avait ressuscité des morts.
verses.am: ከፋሲካም በፊት በስድስተኛው ቀን ኢየሱስ ከሙታን ያስነሣው አልዓዛር ወደ ነበረበት ወደ ቢታንያ መጣ።

verses.en: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
verses.fr: Là, on lui fit un souper; Marthe servait, et Lazare était un de ceux qui se trouvaient à table avec lui.
verses.am: በዚያም እራት አደረጉለት፤ ማርታም ታገለግል ነበር፤ አልዓዛር ግን ከእርሱ ጋር ከተቀመጡት አንዱ ነበረ።

verses.en: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
verses.fr: Marie, ayant pris une livre d''un parfum de nard pur de grand prix, oignit les pieds de Jésus, et elle lui essuya les pieds avec ses cheveux; et la maison fut remplie de l''odeur du parfum.
verses.am: ማርያምም ዋጋው እጅግ የከበረ የጥሩ ናርዶስ ሽቱ ንጥር ወስዳ የኢየሱስን እግር ቀባች፤ በጠጕርዋም እግሩን አበሰች፤ ቤቱም ከናርዶስ ሽቱ ሞላ።

verses.en: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,
verses.fr: Un de ses disciples, Judas Iscariot, fils de Simon, celui qui devait le livrer, dit:
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንዱ አሳልፎ ሊሰጠው ያለው የስምዖን ልጅ የአስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ።

verses.en: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
verses.fr: Pourquoi n''a-t-on pas vendu ce parfum trois cents deniers, pour les donner aux pauvres?
verses.am: ይህ ሽቱ ለሦስት መቶ ዲናር ተሽጦ ለድሆች ያልተሰጠ ስለ ምን ነው? አለ።

verses.en: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
verses.fr: Il disait cela, non qu''il se mît en peine des pauvres, mais parce qu''il était voleur, et que, tenant la bourse, il prenait ce qu''on y mettait.
verses.am: ይህንም የተናገረ ሌባ ስለ ነበረ ነው እንጂ ለድሆች ተገድዶላቸው አይደለም፤ ከረጢትም ይዞ በውስጡ ከሚገባው ይወስድ ስለ ነበረ ነው።

verses.en: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus dit: Laisse-la garder ce parfum pour le jour de ma sépulture.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ለምቀበርበት ቀን እንድትጠብቀው ተውአት፤

verses.en: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.fr: Vous avez toujours les pauvres avec vous, mais vous ne m''avez pas toujours.
verses.am: ድሆችስ ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር ይኖራሉና፥ እኔ ግን ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር አልኖርም አለ።

verses.en: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.fr: Une grande multitude de Juifs apprirent que Jésus était à Béthanie; et ils y vinrent, non pas seulement à cause de lui, mais aussi pour voir Lazare, qu''il avait ressuscité des morts.
verses.am: ከአይሁድም ብዙ ሕዝብ በዚያ እንደ ነበረ አውቀው መጡ፥ ከሙታንም ያስነሣውን አልዓዛርን ደግሞ እንዲያዩ ነበረ እንጂ ስለ ኢየሱስ ብቻ አይደለም።

verses.en: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs délibérèrent de faire mourir aussi Lazare,
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችም አልዓዛርን ደግሞ ሊገድሉት ተማከሩ፥

verses.en: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
verses.fr: parce que beaucoup de Juifs se retiraient d''eux à cause de lui, et croyaient en Jésus.
verses.am: ከአይሁድ ብዙዎች ከእርሱ የተነሣ ሄደው በኢየሱስ ያምኑ ነበርና።

verses.en: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.fr: Le lendemain, une foule nombreuse de gens venus à la fête ayant entendu dire que Jésus se rendait à Jérusalem,
verses.am: በማግሥቱ ወደ በዓሉ መጥተው የነበሩ ብዙ ሕዝብ ኢየሱስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዲመጣ በሰሙ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: prirent des branches de palmiers, et allèrent au-devant de lui, en criant: Hosanna! Béni soit celui qui vient au nom du Seigneur, le roi d''Israël!
verses.am: የዘንባባ ዛፍ ዝንጣፊ ይዘው ሊቀበሉት ወጡና። ሆሣዕና፤ በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ የተባረከ ነው እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.en: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
verses.fr: Jésus trouva un ânon, et s''assit dessus, selon ce qui est écrit:
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ይህን ነገር በመጀመሪያ አላስተዋሉም፤ ነገር ግን ኢየሱስ ከከበረ በኋላ በዚያን ጊዜ ይህ ስለ እርሱ እንደ ተጻፈ ይህንም እንዳደረጉለት ትዝ አላቸው።

verses.en: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
verses.fr: Ne crains point, fille de Sion; Voici, ton roi vient, Assis sur le petit d''une ânesse.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ይህን ነገር በመጀመሪያ አላስተዋሉም፤ ነገር ግን ኢየሱስ ከከበረ በኋላ በዚያን ጊዜ ይህ ስለ እርሱ እንደ ተጻፈ ይህንም እንዳደረጉለት ትዝ አላቸው።

verses.en: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
verses.fr: Ses disciples ne comprirent pas d''abord ces choses; mais, lorsque Jésus eut été glorifié, ils se souvinrent qu''elles étaient écrites de lui, et qu''ils les avaient accomplies à son égard.
verses.am: አልዓዛርንም ከመቃብር ጠርቶ ከሙታን ሲያስነሣው ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት ሕዝብ ይመሰክሩለት ነበር።

verses.en: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui étaient avec Jésus, quand il appela Lazare du sépulcre et le ressuscita des morts, lui rendaient témoignage;
verses.am: ስለዚህ ደግሞ ሕዝቡ ይህን ምልክት እንዳደረገ ስለ ሰሙ ሊቀበሉት ወጡ።

verses.en: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
verses.fr: et la foule vint au-devant de lui, parce qu''elle avait appris qu''il avait fait ce miracle.
verses.am: ሰለዚህ ፈሪሳውያን እርስ በርሳቸው። አንድ ስንኳ ልታደርጉ እንዳይቻላችሁ ታያላችሁን? እነሆ፥ ዓለሙ በኋላው ተከትሎት ሄዶአል ተባባሉ።

verses.en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens se dirent donc les uns aux autres: Vous voyez que vous ne gagnez rien; voici, le monde est allé après lui.
verses.am: በበዓሉም ሊሰግዱ ከወጡት አንዳንዶቹ የግሪክ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
verses.fr: Quelques Grecs, du nombre de ceux qui étaient montés pour adorer pendant la fête,
verses.am: እነርሱም ከገሊላ ቤተ ሳይዳ ወደሚሆን ወደ ፊልጶስ መጥተው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ኢየሱስን ልናይ እንወዳለን ብለው ለመኑት።

verses.en: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
verses.fr: s''adressèrent à Philippe, de Bethsaïda en Galilée, et lui dirent avec instance: Seigneur, nous voudrions voir Jésus.
verses.am: ፊልጶስም መጥቶ ለእንድርያስ ነገረው፤ እንድርያስና ፊልጶስ መጥተው ለኢየሱስ ነገሩት።

verses.en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
verses.fr: Philippe alla le dire à André, puis André et Philippe le dirent à Jésus.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መለሰላቸው፥ እንዲህ ሲል። የሰው ልጅ ይከብር ዘንድ ሰዓቱ ደርሶአል።

verses.en: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: L''heure est venue où le Fils de l''homme doit être glorifié.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የስንዴ ቅንጣት በምድር ወድቃ ካልሞተች ብቻዋን ትቀራለች፤ ብትሞት ግን ብዙ ፍሬ ታፈራለች።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, si le grain de blé qui est tombé en terre ne meurt, il reste seul; mais, s''il meurt, il porte beaucoup de fruit.
verses.am: ነፍሱን የሚወድ ያጠፋታል፥ ነፍሱንም በዚህ ዓለም የሚጠላ ለዘላለም ሕይወት ይጠብቃታል።

verses.en: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
verses.fr: Celui qui aime sa vie la perdra, et celui qui hait sa vie dans ce monde la conservera pour la vie éternelle.
verses.am: የሚያገለግለኝ ቢኖር ይከተለኝ፥ እኔም ባለሁበት አገልጋዬ ደግሞ በዚያ ይሆናል፤ የሚያገለግለኝም ቢኖር አብ ያከብረዋል።

verses.en: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un me sert, qu''il me suive; et là où je suis, là aussi sera mon serviteur. Si quelqu''un me sert, le Père l''honorera.
verses.am: አሁን ነፍሴ ታውካለች ምንስ እላለሁ? አባት ሆይ፥ ከዚህ ሰዓት አድነኝ። ነገር ግን ስለዚህ ወደዚህ ሰዓት መጣሁ።

verses.en: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
verses.fr: Maintenant mon âme est troublée. Et que dirai-je?... Père, délivre-moi de cette heure?... Mais c''est pour cela que je suis venu jusqu''à cette heure.
verses.am: አባት ሆይ፥ ስምህን አክብረው። ስለዚህም። አከበርሁት ደግሞም አከብረዋለሁ የሚል ድምፅ ከሰማይ መጣ።

verses.en: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
verses.fr: Père, glorifie ton nom! Et une voix vint du ciel: Je l''ai glorifié, et je le glorifierai encore.
verses.am: በዚያ ቆመው የነበሩትም ሕዝብ በሰሙ ጊዜ። ነጐድጓድ ነው አሉ፤ ሌሎች። መልአክ ተናገረው አሉ።

verses.en: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
verses.fr: La foule qui était là, et qui avait entendu, disait que c''était un tonnerre. D''autres disaient: Un ange lui a parlé.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። ይህ ድምፅ ስለ እናንተ መጥቶአል እጂ ስለ እኔ አይደለም።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
verses.fr: Jésus dit: Ce n''est pas à cause de moi que cette voix s''est fait entendre; c''est à cause de vous.
verses.am: አሁን የዚህ ዓለም ፍርድ ደርሶአል፤ አሁን የዚህ ዓለም ገዥ ወደ ውጭ ይጣላል፤

verses.en: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
verses.fr: Maintenant a lieu le jugement de ce monde; maintenant le prince de ce monde sera jeté dehors.
verses.am: እኔም ከምድር ከፍ ከፍ ያልሁ እንደ ሆነ ሁሉን ወደ እኔ እስባለሁ።

verses.en: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
verses.fr: Et moi, quand j''aurai été élevé de la terre, j''attirerai tous les hommes à moi.
verses.am: በምን ዓይነትም ሞት ይሞት ዘንድ እንዳለው ሲያመለክታቸው ይህን ተናገረ።

verses.en: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
verses.fr: En parlant ainsi, il indiquait de quelle mort il devait mourir. -
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሕዝቡ። እኛስ ክርስቶስ ለዘላለም እንዲኖር ከሕጉ ሰምተናል፤ አንተስ የሰው ልጅ ከፍ ከፍ ይል ዘንድ እንዲያስፈልገው እንዴት ትላላህ? ይህ የሰው ልጅ ማን ነው? ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.en: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
verses.fr: La foule lui répondit: Nous avons appris par la loi que le Christ demeure éternellement; comment donc dis-tu: Il faut que le Fils de l''homme soit élevé? Qui est ce Fils de l''homme?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ገና ጥቂት ጊዜ ብርሃን ከእናንተ ጋር ነው። ጨለማ እንዳይደርስባችሁ ብርሃን ሳለላችሁ ተመላለሱ፤ በጨለማም የሚመላለስ ወዴት እንዲሄድ አያውቅም።

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: La lumière est encore pour un peu de temps au milieu de vous. Marchez, pendant que vous avez la lumière, afin que les ténèbres ne vous surprennent point: celui qui marche dans les ténèbres ne sait où il va.
verses.am: የብርሃን ልጆች እንድትሆኑ ብርሃን ሳለላችሁ በብርሃኑ እመኑ አላቸው። ኢየሱስም ይህን ተናግሮ ሄደና ተሰወረባቸው።

verses.en: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
verses.fr: Pendant que vous avez la lumière, croyez en la lumière, afin que vous soyez des enfants de lumière. Jésus dit ces choses, puis il s''en alla, et se cacha loin d''eux.
verses.am: ክብሩን ስለ አየ ኢሳይያስ ይህን አለ፥ ስለ እርሱም ተናገረ።

verses.en: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
verses.fr: Malgré tant de miracles qu''il avait faits en leur présence, ils ne croyaient pas en lui,
verses.am: ክብሩን ስለ አየ ኢሳይያስ ይህን አለ፥ ስለ እርሱም ተናገረ።

verses.en: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.fr: afin que s''accomplît la parole qu''Esaïe, le prophète, a prononcée: Seigneur, Qui a cru à notre prédication? Et à qui le bras du Seigneur a-t-il été révélé?
verses.am: ክብሩን ስለ አየ ኢሳይያስ ይህን አለ፥ ስለ እርሱም ተናገረ።

verses.en: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
verses.fr: Aussi ne pouvaient-ils croire, parce qu''Esaïe a dit encore:
verses.am: ከዚህም ጋር ከአለቆች ደግሞ ብዙዎች በእርሱ አመኑ፤ ነገር ግን ከምኵራብ እንዳያስወጡአቸው በፈሪሳውያን ምክንያት አልመሰከሩለትም፤

verses.en: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.fr: Il a aveuglé leurs yeux; et il a endurci leur coeur, De peur qu''ils ne voient des yeux, Qu''ils ne comprennent du coeur, Qu''ils ne se convertissent, et que je ne les guérisse.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ክብር ይልቅ የሰውን ክብር ወደዋልና።

verses.en: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
verses.fr: Esaïe dit ces choses, lorsqu''il vit sa gloire, et qu''il parla de lui.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ጮኸ፥ እንዲህም አለ። በእኔ የሚያምን በላከኝ ማመኑ ነው እንጂ በእኔ አይደለም፤

verses.en: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
verses.fr: Cependant, même parmi les chefs, plusieurs crurent en lui; mais, à cause des pharisiens, ils n''en faisaient pas l''aveu, dans la crainte d''être exclus de la synagogue.
verses.am: እኔንም የሚያይ የላከኝን ያያል።

verses.en: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
verses.fr: Car ils aimèrent la gloire des hommes plus que la gloire de Dieu.
verses.am: በእኔ የሚያምን ሁሉ በጨለማ እንዳይኖር እኔ ብርሃን ሆኜ ወደ ዓለም መጥቻለሁ።

verses.en: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
verses.fr: Or, Jésus s''était écrié: Celui qui croit en moi croit, non pas en moi, mais en celui qui m''a envoyé;
verses.am: ዓለምን ላድን እንጂ በዓለም ልፈርድ አልመጣሁምና ቃሌን ሰምቶ የማይጠብቀው ቢኖር የምፈርድበት እኔ አይደለሁም።

verses.en: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
verses.fr: et celui qui me voit voit celui qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: የሚጥለኝ ቃሌንም የማይቀበለው እርሱ የሚፈርድበት አለው፤ እኔ የተናገርሁት ቃል እርሱ በመጨረሻው ቀን ይፈርድበታል።

verses.en: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
verses.fr: Je suis venu comme une lumière dans le monde, afin que quiconque croit en moi ne demeure pas dans les ténèbres.
verses.am: እኔ ከራሴ አልተናገርሁምና፤ ነገር ግን የላከኝ አብ እርሱ የምለውን የምናገረውንም ትእዛዝ ሰጠኝ።

verses.en: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un entend mes paroles et ne les garde point, ce n''est pas moi qui le juge; car je suis venu non pour juger le monde, mais pour sauver le monde.
verses.am: ትእዛዙም የዘላለም ሕይወት እንደ ሆነች አውቃለሁ። ስለዚህ እኔ የምናገረውን አብ እንደ ነገረኝ እንዲሁ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
verses.fr: Celui qui me rejette et qui ne reçoit pas mes paroles a son juge; la parole que j''ai annoncée, c''est elle qui le jugera au dernier jour.
verses.am: የሚጥለኝ ቃሌንም የማይቀበለው እርሱ የሚፈርድበት አለው፤ እኔ የተናገርሁት ቃል እርሱ በመጨረሻው ቀን ይፈርድበታል።

verses.en: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
verses.fr: Car je n''ai point parlé de moi-même; mais le Père, qui m''a envoyé, m''a prescrit lui-même ce que je dois dire et annoncer.
verses.am: እኔ ከራሴ አልተናገርሁምና፤ ነገር ግን የላከኝ አብ እርሱ የምለውን የምናገረውንም ትእዛዝ ሰጠኝ።

verses.en: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
verses.fr: Et je sais que son commandement est la vie éternelle. C''est pourquoi les choses que je dis, je les dis comme le Père me les a dites.
verses.am: ትእዛዙም የዘላለም ሕይወት እንደ ሆነች አውቃለሁ። ስለዚህ እኔ የምናገረውን አብ እንደ ነገረኝ እንዲሁ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
verses.fr: Avant la fête de Pâque, Jésus, sachant que son heure était venue de passer de ce monde au Père, et ayant aimé les siens qui étaient dans le monde, mit le comble à son amour pour eux.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከፋሲካ በዓል በፊት፥ ከዚህ ዓለም ወደ አብ የሚሄድበት ሰዓት እንደ ደረሰ አውቆ፥ በዚህ ዓለም ያሉትን ወገኖቹን የወደዳቸውን እስከ መጨረሻ ወደዳቸው።

verses.en: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;
verses.fr: Pendant le souper, lorsque le diable avait déjà inspiré au coeur de Judas Iscariot, fils de Simon, le dessein de le livrer,
verses.am: እራትም ሲበሉ ዲያብሎስ በስምዖን ልጅ በአስቆሮቱ በይሁዳ ልብ አሳልፎ እንዲሰጠው አሳብ ካገባ በኋላ፥

verses.en: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
verses.fr: Jésus, qui savait que le Père avait remis toutes choses entre ses mains, qu''il était venu de Dieu, et qu''il s''en allait à Dieu,
verses.am: ኢየሱስ አብ ሁሉን በልጁ እንደ ሰጠው ከእግዚአብሔርም እንደ ወጣ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲሄድ አውቆ፥

verses.en: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
verses.fr: se leva de table, ôta ses vêtements, et prit un linge, dont il se ceignit.
verses.am: ከእራት ተነሣ ልብሱንም አኖረ፥ ማበሻም ጨርቅ ወስዶ ታጠቀ፤

verses.en: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
verses.fr: Ensuite il versa de l''eau dans un bassin, et il se mit à laver les pieds des disciples, et à les essuyer avec le linge dont il était ceint.
verses.am: በኋላም በመታጠቢያው ውኃ ጨመረ፥ የደቀ መዛሙርቱንም እግር ሊያጥብና በታጠቀበትም ማበሻ ጨርቅ ሊያብስ ጀመረ።

verses.en: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
verses.fr: Il vint donc à Simon Pierre; et Pierre lui dit: Toi, Seigneur, tu me laves les pieds!
verses.am: ወደ ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም መጣ፤ እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ የእኔን እግር ታጥባለህን? አለው።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Ce que je fais, tu ne le comprends pas maintenant, mais tu le comprendras bientôt.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እኔ የማደርገውን አንተ አሁን አታውቅም፥ በኋላ ግን ታስተውለዋለህ አለው።

verses.en: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
verses.fr: Pierre lui dit: Non, jamais tu ne me laveras les pieds. Jésus lui répondit: Si je ne te lave, tu n''auras point de part avec moi.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም። የእኔን እግር ለዘላለም አታጥብም አለው። ኢየሱስም። ካላጠብሁህ፥ ከእኔ ጋር ዕድል የለህም ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
verses.fr: Simon Pierre lui dit: Seigneur, non seulement les pieds, mais encore les mains et la tête.
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እጄንና ራሴን ደግሞ እንጂ እግሬን ብቻ አይደለም አለው።

verses.en: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Celui qui est lavé n''a besoin que de se laver les pieds pour être entièrement pur; et vous êtes purs, mais non pas tous.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። የታጠበ እግሩን ከመታጠብ በቀር ሌላ አያስፈልገውም፥ ሁለንተናው ግን ንጹሕ ነው፤ እናንተም ንጹሐን ናችሁ፥ ነገር ግን ሁላችሁ አይደላችሁም አለው።

verses.en: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
verses.fr: Car il connaissait celui qui le livrait; c''est pourquoi il dit: Vous n''êtes pas tous purs.
verses.am: አሳልፎ የሚሰጠውን ያውቅ ነበርና፤ ስለዚህ። ሁላችሁ ንጹሐን አይደላችሁም አለው።

verses.en: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
verses.fr: Après qu''il leur eut lavé les pieds, et qu''il eut pris ses vêtements, il se remit à table, et leur dit: Comprenez-vous ce que je vous ai fait?
verses.am: እግራቸውንም አጥቦ ልብሱንም አንሥቶ ዳግመኛ ተቀመጠ፥ እንዲህም አላቸው። ያደረግሁላችሁን ታስተውላላችሁን?

verses.en: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
verses.fr: Vous m''appelez Maître et Seigneur; et vous dites bien, car je le suis.
verses.am: እናንተ መምህርና ጌታ ትሉኛላችሁ፤ እንዲሁ ነኝና መልካም ትላላችሁ።

verses.en: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
verses.fr: Si donc je vous ai lavé les pieds, moi, le Seigneur et le Maître, vous devez aussi vous laver les pieds les uns aux autres;
verses.am: እንግዲህ እኔ ጌታና መምህር ስሆን እግራችሁን ካጠብሁ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ እርስ በርሳችሁ እግራችሁን ትተጣጠቡ ዘንድ ይገባችኋል።

verses.en: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
verses.fr: car je vous ai donné un exemple, afin que vous fassiez comme je vous ai fait.
verses.am: እኔ ለእናንተ እንዳደረግሁ እናንተ ደግሞ ታደርጉ ዘንድ ምሳሌ ሰጥቻችኋለሁና።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, le serviteur n''est pas plus grand que son seigneur, ni l''apôtre plus grand que celui qui l''a envoyé.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ባሪያ ከጌታው አይበልጥም። መልእክተኛም ከላከው አይበልጥም።

verses.en: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
verses.fr: Si vous savez ces choses, vous êtes heureux, pourvu que vous les pratiquiez.
verses.am: ይህን ብታውቁ፥ ብታደርጉትም ብፁዓን ናችሁ።

verses.en: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas de vous tous que je parle; je connais ceux que j''ai choisis. Mais il faut que l''Ecriture s''accomplisse: Celui qui mange avec moi le pain A levé son talon contre moi.
verses.am: ስለ ሁላችሁ አልናገርም፤ እኔ የመረጥኋቸውን አውቃለሁ፤ ነገር ግን መጽሐፍ። እንጀራዬን የሚበላ በእኔ ላይ ተረከዙን አነሣብኝ ያለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.
verses.fr: Dès à présent je vous le dis, avant que la chose arrive, afin que, lorsqu''elle arrivera, vous croyiez à ce que je suis.
verses.am: በሆነ ጊዜ እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ ታምኑ ዘንድ፥ ከአሁን ጀምሬ አስቀድሞ ሳይሆን እነግራችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, celui qui reçoit celui que j''aurai envoyé me reçoit, et celui qui me reçoit, reçoit celui qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ማናቸውን የምልከውን የሚቀበል እኔን ይቀበላል፥ እኔንም የሚቀበል የላከኝን ይቀበላል።

verses.en: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.fr: Ayant ainsi parlé, Jésus fut troublé en son esprit, et il dit expressément: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, l''un de vous me livrera.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ይህን ብሎ በመንፈሱ ታወከ መስክሮም። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከእናንተ አንዱ አሳልፎ ይሰጠኛል አለ።

verses.en: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
verses.fr: Les disciples se regardaient les uns les autres, ne sachant de qui il parlait.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ስለ ማን እንደ ተናገረ አመንትተው እርስ በርሳቸው ተያዩ።

verses.en: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
verses.fr: Un des disciples, celui que Jésus aimait, était couché sur le sein de Jésus.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ይወደው የነበረ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንዱ በኢየሱስ ደረት ላይ ተጠጋ፤

verses.en: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
verses.fr: Simon Pierre lui fit signe de demander qui était celui dont parlait Jésus.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ እርሱን ጠቅሶ። ስለማን እንደ ተናገረ ንገረን አለው።

verses.en: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
verses.fr: Et ce disciple, s''étant penché sur la poitrine de Jésus, lui dit: Seigneur, qui est-ce?
verses.am: እርሱም በኢየሱስ ደረት እንዲህ ተጠግቶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ማን ነው? አለው።

verses.en: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: C''est celui à qui je donnerai le morceau trempé. Et, ayant trempé le morceau, il le donna à Judas, fils de Simon, l''Iscariot.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እኔ ቍራሽ አጥቅሼ የምሰጠው እርሱ ነው ብሎ መለሰለት። ቍራሽም አጥቅሶ ለአስቆሮቱ ለስምዖን ልጅ ለይሁዳ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
verses.fr: Dès que le morceau fut donné, Satan entra dans Judas. Jésus lui dit: Ce que tu fais, fais-le promptement.
verses.am: ቍራሽም ከተቀበለ በኋላ ያን ጊዜ ሰይጣን ገባበት። እንግዲህ ኢየሱስ። የምታደርገውን ቶሎ ብለህ አድርግ አለው።

verses.en: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
verses.fr: Mais aucun de ceux qui étaient à table ne comprit pourquoi il lui disait cela;
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከተቀመጡት ስለ ምን ይህን እንዳለው ማንም አላወቀም፤

verses.en: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
verses.fr: car quelques-uns pensaient que, comme Judas avait la bourse, Jésus voulait lui dire: Achète ce dont nous avons besoin pour la fête, ou qu''il lui commandait de donner quelque chose aux pauvres.
verses.am: ይሁዳ ከረጢቱን የያዘ ስለ ሆነ፥ ኢየሱስ። ለበዓሉ የሚያስፈልገንን ግዛ፥ ወይም ለድሆች ምጽዋት እንዲሰጥ ያለው ለአንዳንዱ መስሎአቸው ነበርና።

verses.en: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
verses.fr: Judas, ayant pris le morceau, se hâta de sortir. Il était nuit.
verses.am: እርሱም ቍራሹን ከተቀበለ በኋላ ወዲያው ወጣ፤ ሌሊትም ነበረ።

verses.en: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
verses.fr: Lorsque Judas fut sorti, Jésus dit: Maintenant, le Fils de l''homme a été glorifié, et Dieu a été glorifié en lui.
verses.am: ከወጣም በኋላ ኢየሱስ እንዲ አለ። አሁን የሰው ልጅ ከበረ እግዚአብሔርም ሰለ እርሱ ከበረ፤

verses.en: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
verses.fr: Si Dieu a été glorifié en lui, Dieu aussi le glorifiera en lui-même, et il le glorifiera bientôt.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እርሱ የከበረ ከሆነ፥ እግዚአብሔር ደግሞ እርሱን ራሱን ያከብረዋል ወዲያውም ያከብረዋል።

verses.en: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
verses.fr: Mes petits enfants, je suis pour peu de temps encore avec vous. Vous me chercherez; et, comme j''ai dit aux Juifs: Vous ne pouvez venir où je vais, je vous le dis aussi maintenant.
verses.am: ልጆች ሆይ፥ ገና ጥቂት ጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝ፤ ትፈልጉኛላችሁ፤ ለአይሁድም። እኔ ወደምሄድበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አይቻላችሁም እንዳልኋቸው፥ አሁን ለእናንተ ደግሞ እላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
verses.fr: Je vous donne un commandement nouveau: Aimez-vous les uns les autres; comme je vous ai aimés, vous aussi, aimez-vous les uns les autres.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳችሁ ትዋደዱ ዘንድ፥ እንደ ወደድኋችሁ እናንተ ደግሞ እርስ በርሳችሁ ትዋደዱ ዘንድ አዲስ ትእዛዝ እሰጣችኋለሁ።

verses.en: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
verses.fr: A ceci tous connaîtront que vous êtes mes disciples, si vous avez de l''amour les uns pour les autres.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳችሁ ፍቅር ቢኖራችሁ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቴ እንደ ሆናችሁ ሰዎች ሁሉ በዚህ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
verses.fr: Simon Pierre lui dit: Seigneur, où vas-tu? Jésus répondit: Tu ne peux pas maintenant me suivre où je vais, mais tu me suivras plus tard.
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወዴት ትሄዳለህ? አለው። ኢየሱስም። ወደምሄድበት አሁን ልትከተለኝ አትችልም፥ ነገር ግን በኋላ ትከተለኛለህ ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
verses.fr: Seigneur, lui dit Pierre, pourquoi ne puis-je pas te suivre maintenant? Je donnerai ma vie pour toi.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አሁን ልከተልህ አለመቻሌ ስለ ምንድር ነው? ነፍሴን ስንኳ ስለ አንተ እሰጣለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Tu donneras ta vie pour moi! En vérité, en vérité, je te le dis, le coq ne chantera pas que tu ne m''aies renié trois fois.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት። ነፍስህን ስለ እኔ ትሰጣለህን? እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ሦስት ጊዜ እስክትክደኝ ድረስ ዶሮ አይጮኽም።

verses.en: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
verses.fr: Que votre coeur ne se trouble point. Croyez en Dieu, et croyez en moi.
verses.am: ልባችሁ አይታወክ፤ በእግዚአብሔር እመኑ፥ በእኔም ደግሞ እመኑ።

verses.en: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.fr: Il y a plusieurs demeures dans la maison de mon Père. Si cela n''était pas, je vous l''aurais dit. Je vais vous préparer une place.
verses.am: በአባቴ ቤት ብዙ መኖሪያ አለ፤ እንዲህስ ባይሆን ባልኋችሁ ነበር፤ ስፍራ አዘጋጅላችሁ ዘንድ እሄዳለሁና፤

verses.en: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
verses.fr: Et, lorsque je m''en serai allé, et que je vous aurai préparé une place, je reviendrai, et je vous prendrai avec moi, afin que là où je suis vous y soyez aussi.
verses.am: ሄጄም ስፍራ ባዘጋጅላችሁ፥ እኔ ባለሁበት እናንተ ደግሞ እንድትሆኑ ሁለተኛ እመጣለሁ ወደ እኔም እወስዳችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
verses.fr: Vous savez où je vais, et vous en savez le chemin.
verses.am: ወደምሄድበትም ታውቃላችሁ፥ መንገዱንም ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
verses.fr: Thomas lui dit: Seigneur, nous ne savons où tu vas; comment pouvons-nous en savoir le chemin?
verses.am: ቶማስም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወደምትሄድበት አናውቅም፤ እንዴትስ መንገዱን እናውቃለን? አለው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Je suis le chemin, la vérité, et la vie. Nul ne vient au Père que par moi.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እኔ መንገድና እውነት ሕይወትም ነኝ፤ በእኔ በቀር ወደ አብ የሚመጣ የለም።

verses.en: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
verses.fr: Si vous me connaissiez, vous connaîtriez aussi mon Père. Et dès maintenant vous le connaissez, et vous l''avez vu.
verses.am: እኔንስ ብታውቁኝ አባቴን ደግሞ ባወቃችሁ ነበር። ከአሁንም ጀምራችሁ ታውቁታላችሁ አይታችሁትማል አለው።

verses.en: Philip saith unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
verses.fr: Philippe lui dit: Seigneur, montre-nous le Père, et cela nous suffit.
verses.am: ፊልጶስ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አብን አሳየንና ይበቃናል አለው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Show us the Father?
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Il y a si longtemps que je suis avec vous, et tu ne m''as pas connu, Philippe! Celui qui m''a vu a vu le Père; comment dis-tu: Montre-nous le Père?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አለው። አንተ ፊልጶስ፥ ይህን ያህል ዘመን ከእናንተ ጋር ስኖር አታውቀኝምን? እኔን ያየ አብን አይቶአል፤ እንዴትስ አንተ። አብን አሳየን ትላለህ?

verses.en: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
verses.fr: Ne crois-tu pas que je suis dans le Père, et que le Père est en moi? Les paroles que je vous dis, je ne les dis pas de moi-même; et le Père qui demeure en moi, c''est lui qui fait les oeuvres.
verses.am: እኔ በአብ እንዳለሁ አብም በእኔ እንዳለ አታምንምን? እኔ የምነግራችሁን ቃል ከራሴ አልናገረውም፤ ነገር ግን በእኔ የሚኖረው አብ እርሱ ሥራውን ይሠራል።

verses.en: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
verses.fr: Croyez-moi, je suis dans le Père, et le Père est en moi; croyez du moins à cause de ces oeuvres.
verses.am: እኔ በአብ እንዳለሁ አብም በእኔ እንዳለ እመኑኝ፤ ባይሆንስ ስለ ራሱ ስለ ሥራው እመኑኝ።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, celui qui croit en moi fera aussi les oeuvres que je fais, et il en fera de plus grandes, parce que je m''en vais au Père;
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በእኔ የሚያምን እኔ የማደርገውን ሥራ እርሱ ደግሞ ያደርጋል፤ ከዚህም የሚበልጥ ያደርጋል፥

verses.en: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.fr: et tout ce que vous demanderez en mon nom, je le ferai, afin que le Père soit glorifié dans le Fils.
verses.am: እኔ ወደ አብ እሄዳለሁና፤ አብም ስለ ወልድ እንዲከበር በስሜ የምትለምኑትን ሁሉ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
verses.fr: Si vous demandez quelque chose en mon nom, je le ferai.
verses.am: ማናቸውንም ነገር በስሜ ብትለምኑ እኔ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
verses.fr: Si vous m''aimez, gardez mes commandements.
verses.am: እርሱም ዓለም የማያየውና የማያውቀው ስለ ሆነ ሊቀበለው የማይቻለው የእውነት መንፈስ ነው፤ ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ዘንድ ስለሚኖር በውሥጣችሁም ስለሚሆን እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
verses.fr: Et moi, je prierai le Père, et il vous donnera un autre consolateur, afin qu''il demeure éternellement avec vous,
verses.am: እርሱም ዓለም የማያየውና የማያውቀው ስለ ሆነ ሊቀበለው የማይቻለው የእውነት መንፈስ ነው፤ ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ዘንድ ስለሚኖር በውሥጣችሁም ስለሚሆን እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
verses.fr: l''Esprit de vérité, que le monde ne peut recevoir, parce qu''il ne le voit point et ne le connaît point; mais vous, vous le connaissez, car il demeure avec vous, et il sera en vous.
verses.am: ወላጆች እንደ ሌላቸው ልጆች አልተዋችሁም፤ ወደ እናንተ እመጣለሁ።

verses.en: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
verses.fr: Je ne vous laisserai pas orphelins, je viendrai à vous.
verses.am: ገና ጥቂት ዘመን አለ ከዚህም በኋላ ዓለም አያየኝም፤ እናንተ ግን ታዩኛላችሁ፤ እኔ ሕያው ነኝና እናንተ ደግሞ ሕያዋን ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.en: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
verses.fr: Encore un peu de temps, et le monde ne me verra plus; mais vous, vous me verrez, car je vis, et vous vivrez aussi.
verses.am: እኔ በአባቴ እንዳለሁ እናንተም በእኔ እንዳላችሁ እኔም በእናንተ እንዳለሁ በዚያን ቀን ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, vous connaîtrez que je suis en mon Père, que vous êtes en moi, et que je suis en vous.
verses.am: ትእዛዜ በእርሱ ዘንድ ያለችው የሚጠብቃትም የሚወደኝ እርሱ ነው፤ የሚወደኝንም አባቴ ይወደዋል እኔም እወደዋለሁ ራሴንም እገልጥለታለሁ።

verses.en: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
verses.fr: Celui qui a mes commandements et qui les garde, c''est celui qui m''aime; et celui qui m''aime sera aimé de mon Père, je l''aimerai, et je me ferai connaître à lui.
verses.am: የአስቆሮቱ ያይደለ ይሁዳ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ለዓለም ሳይሆን ራስህን ለእኛ ልትገልጥ ያለህ እንዴት ነው? አለው።

verses.en: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
verses.fr: Jude, non pas l''Iscariot, lui dit: Seigneur, d''où vient que tu te feras connaître à nous, et non au monde?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መለሰ አለውም። የሚወደኝ ቢኖር ቃሌን ይጠብቃል፤ አባቴም ይወደዋል ወደ እርሱም እንመጣለን በእርሱም ዘንድ መኖሪያ እናደርጋለን።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Si quelqu''un m''aime, il gardera ma parole, et mon Père l''aimera; nous viendrons à lui, et nous ferons notre demeure chez lui.
verses.am: የማይወደኝ ቃሌን አይጠብቅም፤ የምትሰሙትም ቃል የላከኝ የአብ ነው እንጂ የእኔ አይደለም።

verses.en: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
verses.fr: Celui qui ne m''aime pas ne garde point mes paroles. Et la parole que vous entendez n''est pas de moi, mais du Père qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: ከእናንተ ዘንድ ስኖር ይህን ነግሬአችኋለሁ፤

verses.en: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
verses.fr: Je vous ai dit ces choses pendant que je demeure avec vous.
verses.am: አብ በስሜ የሚልከው ግን መንፈስ ቅዱስ የሆነው አጽናኝ እርሱ ሁሉን ያስተምራችኋል እኔም የነገርኋችሁን ሁሉ ያሳስባችኋል።

verses.en: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
verses.fr: Mais le consolateur, l''Esprit-Saint, que le Père enverra en mon nom, vous enseignera toutes choses, et vous rappellera tout ce que je vous ai dit.
verses.am: ሰላምን እተውላችኋለሁ፥ ሰላሜን እሰጣችኋለሁ፤ እኔ የምሰጣችሁ ዓለም እንደሚሰጥ አይደለም። ልባችሁ አይታወክ አይፍራም።

verses.en: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.fr: Je vous laisse la paix, je vous donne ma paix. Je ne vous donne pas comme le monde donne. Que votre coeur ne se trouble point, et ne s''alarme point.
verses.am: እኔ እሄዳለሁ ወደ እናንተም እመጣለሁ እንዳልኋችሁ ሰማችሁ። የምትወዱኝስ ብትሆኑ ከእኔ አብ ይበልጣልና ወደ አብ በመሄዴ ደስ ባላችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
verses.fr: Vous avez entendu que je vous ai dit: Je m''en vais, et je reviens vers vous. Si vous m''aimiez, vous vous réjouiriez de ce que je vais au Père; car le Père est plus grand que moi.
verses.am: ከሆነም በኋላ ታምኑ ዘንድ አሁን አስቀድሞ ሳይሆን። ነግሬአችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
verses.fr: Et maintenant je vous ai dit ces choses avant qu''elles arrivent, afin que, lorsqu''elles arriveront, vous croyiez.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ከእናንተ ጋር ብዙ አልናገርም፥ የዚህ ዓለም ገዥ ይመጣልና፤ በእኔ ላይም አንዳች የለውም፤

verses.en: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
verses.fr: Je ne parlerai plus guère avec vous; car le prince du monde vient. Il n''a rien en moi;
verses.am: ነገር ግን አብን እንድወድ ዓለም ሊያውቅ፥ አብም እንዳዘዘኝ፥ እንዲሁ አደርጋለሁ። ተነሡ፤ ከዚህ እንሂድ።

verses.en: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
verses.fr: mais afin que le monde sache que j''aime le Père, et que j''agis selon l''ordre que le Père m''a donné, levez-vous, partons d''ici.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አብን እንድወድ ዓለም ሊያውቅ፥ አብም እንዳዘዘኝ፥ እንዲሁ አደርጋለሁ። ተነሡ፤ ከዚህ እንሂድ።

verses.en: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
verses.fr: Je suis le vrai cep, et mon Père est le vigneron.
verses.am: እውነተኛ የወይን ግንድ እኔ ነኝ፤ ገበሬውም አባቴ ነው።

verses.en: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
verses.fr: Tout sarment qui est en moi et qui ne porte pas de fruit, il le retranche; et tout sarment qui porte du fruit, il l''émonde, afin qu''il porte encore plus de fruit.
verses.am: ፍሬ የማያፈራውን በእኔ ያለውን ቅርንጫፍ ሁሉ ያስወግደዋል፤ ፍሬ የሚያፈራውንም ሁሉ አብዝቶ እንዲያፈራ ያጠራዋል።

verses.en: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
verses.fr: Déjà vous êtes purs, à cause de la parole que je vous ai annoncée.
verses.am: እናንተ ስለ ነገርኋችሁ ቃል አሁን ንጹሐን ናችሁ፤

verses.en: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
verses.fr: Demeurez en moi, et je demeurerai en vous. Comme le sarment ne peut de lui-même porter du fruit, s''il ne demeure attaché au cep, ainsi vous ne le pouvez non plus, si vous ne demeurez en moi.
verses.am: በእኔ ኑሩ እኔም በእናንተ። ቅርንጫፍ በወይኑ ግንድ ባይኖር ከራሱ ፍሬ ሊያፈራ እንዳይቻለው፥ እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ በእኔ ባትኖሩ አትችሉም።

verses.en: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verses.fr: Je suis le cep, vous êtes les sarments. Celui qui demeure en moi et en qui je demeure porte beaucoup de fruit, car sans moi vous ne pouvez rien faire.
verses.am: እኔ የወይን ግንድ ነኝ እናንተም ቅርንጫፎች ናችሁ። ያለ እኔ ምንም ልታደርጉ አትችሉምና በእኔ የሚኖር እኔም በእርሱ፥ እርሱ ብዙ ፍሬ ያፈራል።

verses.en: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un ne demeure pas en moi, il est jeté dehors, comme le sarment, et il sèche; puis on ramasse les sarments, on les jette au feu, et ils brûlent.
verses.am: በእኔ የማይኖር ቢሆን እንደ ቅርንጫፍ ወደ ውጭ ይጣላል ይደርቅማል፤ እነርሱንም ሰብስበው ወደ እሳት ይጥሉአቸዋል፥ ያቃጥሉአቸውማል።

verses.en: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
verses.fr: Si vous demeurez en moi, et que mes paroles demeurent en vous, demandez ce que vous voudrez, et cela vous sera accordé.
verses.am: በእኔ ብትኖሩ ቃሎቼም በእናንተ ቢኖሩ የምትወዱትን ሁሉ ለምኑ ይሆንላችሁማል።

verses.en: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
verses.fr: Si vous portez beaucoup de fruit, c''est ainsi que mon Père sera glorifié, et que vous serez mes disciples.
verses.am: ብዙ ፍሬ ብታፈሩና ደቀ መዛሙርቴ ብትሆኑ በዚህ አባቴ ይከበራል።

verses.en: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
verses.fr: Comme le Père m''a aimé, je vous ai aussi aimés. Demeurez dans mon amour.
verses.am: አብ እንደ ወደደኝ እኔ ደግሞ ወደድኋችሁ፤ በፍቅሬ ኑሩ።

verses.en: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.
verses.fr: Si vous gardez mes commandements, vous demeurerez dans mon amour, de même que j''ai gardé les commandements de mon Père, et que je demeure dans son amour.
verses.am: እኔ የአባቴን ትእዛዝ እንደ ጠበቅሁ በፍቅሩም እንደምኖር፥ ትእዛዜን ብትጠብቁ በፍቅሬ ትኖራላችሁ።

verses.en: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
verses.fr: Je vous ai dit ces choses, afin que ma joie soit en vous, et que votre joie soit parfaite.
verses.am: ደስታዬም በእናንተ እንዲሆን ደስታችሁም እንዲፈጸም ይህን ነግሬአችኋለሁ።

verses.en: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
verses.fr: C''est ici mon commandement: Aimez-vous les uns les autres, comme je vous ai aimés.
verses.am: እኔ እንደ ወደድኋችሁ እርስ በርሳችሁ ትዋደዱ ዘንድ ትእዛዜ ይህች ናት።

verses.en: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.fr: Il n''y a pas de plus grand amour que de donner sa vie pour ses amis.
verses.am: ነፍሱን ስለ ወዳጆቹ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ከዚህ የሚበልጥ ፍቅር ለማንም የለውም።

verses.en: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
verses.fr: Vous êtes mes amis, si vous faites ce que je vous commande.
verses.am: እኔ ያዘዝኋችሁን ሁሉ ብታደርጉ እናንተ ወዳጆቼ ናችሁ።

verses.en: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
verses.fr: Je ne vous appelle plus serviteurs, parce que le serviteur ne sait pas ce que fait son maître; mais je vous ai appelés amis, parce que je vous ai fait connaître tout ce que j''ai appris de mon Père.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ባሮች አልላችሁም፤ ባርያ ጌታው የሚያደርገውን አያውቅምና፤ ወዳጆች ግን ብያችኋለሁ፥ ከአባቴ የሰማሁትን ሁሉ ለእናንተ አስታውቄአችኋለሁና።

verses.en: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas vous qui m''avez choisi; mais moi, je vous ai choisis, et je vous ai établis, afin que vous alliez, et que vous portiez du fruit, et que votre fruit demeure, afin que ce que vous demanderez au Père en mon nom, il vous le donne.
verses.am: እኔ መረጥኋችሁ እንጂ እናንተ አልመረጣችሁኝም፤ አብም በስሜ የምትለምኑትን ሁሉ እንዲሰጣችሁ፥ ልትሄዱና ፍሬ ልታፈሩ ፍሬአችሁም ሊኖር ሾምኋችሁ።

verses.en: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
verses.fr: Ce que je vous commande, c''est de vous aimer les uns les autres.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳችሁ እንድትዋደዱ ይህን አዛችኋለሁ።

verses.en: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
verses.fr: Si le monde vous hait, sachez qu''il m''a haï avant vous.
verses.am: ዓለም ቢጠላችሁ ከእናንተ በፊት እኔን እንደ ጠላኝ እወቁ።

verses.en: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
verses.fr: Si vous étiez du monde, le monde aimerait ce qui est à lui; mais parce que vous n''êtes pas du monde, et que je vous ai choisis du milieu du monde, à cause de cela le monde vous hait.
verses.am: ከዓለምስ ብትሆኑ ዓለም የራሱ የሆነውን ይወድ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን እኔ ከዓለም መረጥኋችሁ እንጂ ከዓለም ስለ አይደላችሁ ስለዚህ ዓለም ይጠላችኋል።

verses.en: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
verses.fr: Souvenez-vous de la parole que je vous ai dite: Le serviteur n''est pas plus grand que son maître. S''ils m''ont persécuté, ils vous persécuteront aussi; s''ils ont gardé ma parole, ils garderont aussi la vôtre.
verses.am: ባርያ ከጌታው አይበልጥም ብዬ የነገርኋችሁን ቃል አስቡ። እኔን አሳደውኝ እንደ ሆኑ እናንተን ደግሞ ያሳድዱአችኋል፤ ቃሌን ጠብቀው እንደ ሆኑ ቃላችሁን ደግሞ ይጠብቃሉ።

verses.en: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
verses.fr: Mais ils vous feront toutes ces choses à cause de mon nom, parce qu''ils ne connaissent pas celui qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን የላከኝን አያውቁምና ይህን ሁሉ ሰለ ስሜ ያደርጉባችኋል።

verses.en: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloak for their sin.
verses.fr: Si je n''étais pas venu et que je ne leur eusse point parlé, ils n''auraient pas de péché; mais maintenant ils n''ont aucune excuse de leur péché.
verses.am: እኔ መጥቼ ባልነገርኋቸውስ ኃጢአት ባልሆነባቸውም ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ለኃጢአታቸው ምክንያት የላቸውም።

verses.en: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
verses.fr: Celui qui me hait, hait aussi mon Père.
verses.am: እኔን የሚጠላ አባቴን ደግሞ ይጠላል።

verses.en: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
verses.fr: Si je n''avais pas fait parmi eux des oeuvres que nul autre n''a faites, ils n''auraient pas de péché; mais maintenant ils les ont vues, et ils ont haï et moi et mon Père.
verses.am: ሌላ ሰው ያላደረገውን ሥራ በመካከላቸው ባላደረግሁ፥ ኃጢአት ባልሆነባቸውም ነበር፤ አሁን ግን እኔንም አባቴንም አይተውማል ጠልተውማል።

verses.en: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
verses.fr: Mais cela est arrivé afin que s''accomplît la parole qui est écrite dans leur loi: Ils m''ont haï sans cause.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በሕጋቸው። በከንቱ ጠሉኝ ተብሎ የተጻፈው ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
verses.fr: Quand sera venu le consolateur, que je vous enverrai de la part du Père, l''Esprit de vérité, qui vient du Père, il rendra témoignage de moi;
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን እኔ ከአብ ዘንድ የምልክላችሁ አጽናኝ እርሱም ከአብ የሚወጣ የእውነት መንፈስ በመጣ ጊዜ፥ እርሱ ስለ እኔ ይመሰክራል፤

verses.en: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
verses.fr: et vous aussi, vous rendrez témoignage, parce que vous êtes avec moi dès le commencement.
verses.am: እናንተም ደግሞ ከመጀመሪያ ከእኔ ጋር ኖራችኋልና ትመሰክራላችሁ።

verses.en: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
verses.fr: Je vous ai dit ces choses, afin qu''elles ne soient pas pour vous une occasion de chute.
verses.am: እንዳትሰናከሉ ይህን ተናግሬአችኋለሁ።

verses.en: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
verses.fr: Ils vous excluront des synagogues; et même l''heure vient où quiconque vous fera mourir croira rendre un culte à Dieu.
verses.am: ከምኵራባቸው ያወጡአችኋል፤ ከዚህ በላይ ደግሞ የሚገድላችሁ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን እንደሚያገለግል የሚመስልበት ጊዜ ይመጣል።

verses.en: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
verses.fr: Et ils agiront ainsi, parce qu''ils n''ont connu ni le Père ni moi.
verses.am: ይህንም የሚያደርጉባችሁ አብንና እኔን ስላላወቁ ነው።

verses.en: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.fr: Je vous ai dit ces choses, afin que, lorsque l''heure sera venue, vous vous souveniez que je vous les ai dites. Je ne vous en ai pas parlé dès le commencement, parce que j''étais avec vous.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጊዜው ሲደርስ እኔ እንደ ነገርኋችሁ ታስቡ ዘንድ ይህን ተናግሬአችኋለሁ። ከእንናንተም ጋር ስለ ነበርሁ በመጀመሪያ ይህን አልነገርኋችሁም።

verses.en: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
verses.fr: Maintenant je m''en vais vers celui qui m''a envoyé, et aucun de vous ne me demande: Où vas-tu?
verses.am: አሁን ግን ወደ ላከኝ እሄዳለሁ ከእናንተም። ወዴት ትሄዳለህ? ብሎ የሚጠይቀኝ የለም።

verses.en: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
verses.fr: Mais, parce que je vous ai dit ces choses, la tristesse a rempli votre coeur.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይህን ስለ ተናገርኋችሁ ኀዘን በልባችሁ ሞልቶአል።

verses.en: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
verses.fr: Cependant je vous dis la vérité: il vous est avantageux que je m''en aille, car si je ne m''en vais pas, le consolateur ne viendra pas vers vous; mais, si je m''en vais, je vous l''enverrai.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እውነት እነግራችኋለሁ፤ እኔ እንድሄድ ይሻላችኋል። እኔ ባልሄድ አጽናኙ ወደ እናንተ አይመጣምና፤ እኔ ብሄድ ግን እርሱን እልክላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
verses.fr: Et quand il sera venu, il convaincra le monde en ce qui concerne le péché, la justice, et le jugement:
verses.am: እርሱም መጥቶ ስለ ኃጢአት ስለ ጽድቅም ስለ ፍርድም ዓለምን ይወቅሳል፤

verses.en: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
verses.fr: en ce qui concerne le péché, parce qu''ils ne croient pas en moi;
verses.am: ስለ ፍርድም፥ የዚህ ዓለም ገዥ ስለ ተፈረደበት ነው።

verses.en: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
verses.fr: la justice, parce que je vais au Père, et que vous ne me verrez plus;
verses.am: ስለ ፍርድም፥ የዚህ ዓለም ገዥ ስለ ተፈረደበት ነው።

verses.en: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
verses.fr: le jugement, parce que le prince de ce monde est jugé.
verses.am: የምነግራችሁ ገና ብዙ አለኝ፥ ነገር ግን አሁን ልትሸከሙት አትችሉም።

verses.en: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
verses.fr: J''ai encore beaucoup de choses à vous dire, mais vous ne pouvez pas les porter maintenant.
verses.am: ግን እርሱ የእውነት መንፈስ በመጣ ጊዜ ወደ እውነት ሁሉ ይመራችኋል፤ የሚሰማውን ሁሉ ይናገራል እንጂ ከራሱ አይነግርምና፤ የሚመጣውንም ይነግራችኋል።

verses.en: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
verses.fr: Quand le consolateur sera venu, l''Esprit de vérité, il vous conduira dans toute la vérité; car il ne parlera pas de lui-même, mais il dira tout ce qu''il aura entendu, et il vous annoncera les choses à venir.
verses.am: እርሱ ያከብረኛል፥ ለእኔ ካለኝ ወስዶ ይነግራችኋልና።

verses.en: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
verses.fr: Il me glorifiera, parce qu''il prendra de ce qui est à moi, et vous l''annoncera.
verses.am: ለአብ ያለው ሁሉ የእኔ ነው፤ ስለዚህ። ለእኔ ካለኝ ወስዶ ይነግራችኋል አልሁ።

verses.en: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
verses.fr: Tout ce que le Père a est à moi; c''est pourquoi j''ai dit qu''il prend de ce qui est à moi, et qu''il vous l''annoncera.
verses.am: ጥቂት ጊዜ አለ፥ አታዩኝምም፤ ደግሞም ጥቂት ጊዜ አለ፥ ታዩኛላችሁም፥ እኔ ወደ አብ እሄዳለሁና።

verses.en: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
verses.fr: Encore un peu de temps, et vous ne me verrez plus; et puis encore un peu de temps, et vous me verrez, parce que je vais au Père.
verses.am: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም አንዳንዶቹ እርስ በርሳቸው። ጥቂት ጊዜ አለ፥ አታዩኝምም፤ ደግሞም ጥቂት ጊዜ አለ፥ ታዩኛላችሁም፤ ደግሞ። ወደ አብ እሄዳለሁና የሚለን ይህ ምንድር ነው? ተባባሉ።

verses.en: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
verses.fr: Là-dessus, quelques-uns de ses disciples dirent entre eux: Que signifie ce qu''il nous dit: Encore un peu de temps, et vous ne me verrez plus; et puis encore un peu de temps, et vous me verrez? et: Parce que je vais au Père?
verses.am: እንግዲህ። ጥቂት የሚለው ይህ ምንድር ነው? የሚናገረውን አናውቅም አሉ።

verses.en: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
verses.fr: Ils disaient donc: Que signifie ce qu''il dit: Encore un peu de temps? Nous ne savons de quoi il parle.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሊጠይቁት እንደ ወደዱ አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። ጥቂት ጊዜ አለ፥ አታዩኝምም፤ ደግሞም ጥቂት ጊዜ አለ፥ ታዩኛላችሁ ስላልሁ፥ ስለዚህ እርስ በርሳችሁ ትመራመራላችሁን?

verses.en: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
verses.fr: Jésus, connut qu''ils voulaient l''interroger, leur dit: Vous vous questionnez les uns les autres sur ce que j''ai dit: Encore un peu de temps, et vous ne me verrez plus; et puis encore un peu de temps, et vous me verrez.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እናንተ ታለቅሳለችሁ ሙሾም ታወጣላችሁ፥ ዓለም ግን ደስ ይለዋል፤ እናንተም ታዝናላችሁ፥ ነገር ግን ኀዘናችሁ ወደ ደስታ ይለወጣል።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, vous pleurerez et vous vous lamenterez, et le monde se réjouira: vous serez dans la tristesse, mais votre tristesse se changera en joie.
verses.am: ሴት በምትወልድበት ጊዜ ወራትዋ ስለ ደረሰ ታዝናለች፤ ነገር ግን ሕፃን ከወለደች በኋላ፥ ሰው በዓለም ተወልዶአልና ስለ ደስታዋ መከራዋን ኋላ አታስበውም።

verses.en: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
verses.fr: La femme, lorsqu''elle enfante, éprouve de la tristesse, parce que son heure est venue; mais, lorsqu''elle a donné le jour à l''enfant, elle ne se souvient plus de la souffrance, à cause de la joie qu''elle a de ce qu''un homme est né dans le monde.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እናንተ ደግሞ አሁን ታዝናላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን እንደ ገና አያችኋለሁ ልባችሁም ደስ ይለዋል፥ ደስታችሁንም የሚወስድባችሁ የለም።

verses.en: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
verses.fr: Vous donc aussi, vous êtes maintenant dans la tristesse; mais je vous reverrai, et votre coeur se réjouira, et nul ne vous ravira votre joie.
verses.am: በዚያን ቀንም ከእኔ አንዳች አትለምኑም። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ አብ በስሜ የምትለምኑትን ሁሉ ይሰጣችኋል።

verses.en: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, vous ne m''interrogerez plus sur rien. En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, ce que vous demanderez au Père, il vous le donnera en mon nom.
verses.am: እስከ አሁን በስሜ ምንም አልለመናችሁም፤ ደስታችሁ ፍጹም እንዲሆን ለምኑ ትቀበሉማላችሁ።

verses.en: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à présent vous n''avez rien demandé en mon nom. Demandez, et vous recevrez, afin que votre joie soit parfaite.
verses.am: ይህን በምሳሌ ነግሬአችኋለሁ፤ ነገር ግን ስለ አብ ለእናንተ በግልጥ የምናገርበት እንጂ ከዚያ ወዲያ በምሳሌ የማልናገርበት ሰዓት ይመጣል።

verses.en: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
verses.fr: Je vous ai dit ces choses en paraboles. L''heure vient où je ne vous parlerai plus en paraboles, mais où je vous parlerai ouvertement du Père.
verses.am: በዚያን ቀን በስሜ ትለምናላችሁ፤ እኔም ስለ እናንተ አብን እንድለምን የምላችሁ አይደለሁም፤

verses.en: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
verses.fr: En ce jour, vous demanderez en mon nom, et je ne vous dis pas que je prierai le Père pour vous;
verses.am: እናንተ ስለ ወደዳችሁኝ ከእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ እኔ እንደ ወጣሁ ስላመናችሁ አብ እርሱ ራሱ ይወዳችኋልና።

verses.en: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
verses.fr: car le Père lui-même vous aime, parce que vous m''avez aimé, et que vous avez cru que je suis sorti de Dieu.
verses.am: ከአብ ወጥቼ ወደ ዓለም መጥቻለሁ፤ ደግሞ ዓለምን እተወዋለሁ ወደ አብም እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
verses.fr: Je suis sorti du Père, et je suis venu dans le monde; maintenant je quitte le monde, et je vais au Père.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። እነሆ፥ አሁን በግልጥ ትናገራለህ በምሳሌም ምንም አትነግርም።

verses.en: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
verses.fr: Ses disciples lui dirent: Voici, maintenant tu parles ouvertement, et tu n''emploies aucune parabole.
verses.am: ሁሉን እንድታውቅ ማንምም ሊጠይቅህ እንዳትፈልግ አሁን እናውቃለን፤ ስለዚህ ከእግዚአብሔር እንደ ወጣህ እናምናለን አሉት።

verses.en: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
verses.fr: Maintenant nous savons que tu sais toutes choses, et que tu n''as pas besoin que personne t''interroge; c''est pourquoi nous croyons que tu es sorti de Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰላቸው። አሁን ታምናላችሁን?

verses.en: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Vous croyez maintenant.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁ ወደ ቤት የምትበታተኑበት እኔንም ለብቻዬ የምትተዉበት ሰዓት ይመጣል፥ አሁንም ደርሶአል፤ ነገር ግን አብ ከእኔ ጋር ስለ ሆነ ብቻዬን አይደለሁም።

verses.en: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.fr: Voici, l''heure vient, et elle est déjà venue, où vous serez dispersés chacun de son côté, et où vous me laisserez seul; mais je ne suis pas seul, car le Père est avec moi.
verses.am: በእኔ ሳላችሁ ሰላም እንዲሆንላችሁ ይህን ተናግሬአችኋለሁ። በዓለም ሳላችሁ መከራ አለባችሁ፤ ነገር ግን አይዞአችሁ፤ እኔ ዓለምን አሸንፌዋለሁ።

verses.en: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
verses.fr: Je vous ai dit ces choses, afin que vous ayez la paix en moi. Vous aurez des tribulations dans le monde; mais prenez courage, j''ai vaincu le monde.
verses.am: በእኔ ሳላችሁ ሰላም እንዲሆንላችሁ ይህን ተናግሬአችኋለሁ። በዓለም ሳላችሁ መከራ አለባችሁ፤ ነገር ግን አይዞአችሁ፤ እኔ ዓለምን አሸንፌዋለሁ።

verses.en: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
verses.fr: Après avoir ainsi parlé, Jésus leva les yeux au ciel, et dit: Père, l''heure est venue! Glorifie ton Fils, afin que ton Fils te glorifie,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ይህን ተናግሮ ወደ ሰማይ ዓይኖቹን አነሣና እንዲህ አለ። አባት ሆይ፥

verses.en: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
verses.fr: selon que tu lui as donné pouvoir sur toute chair, afin qu''il accorde la vie éternelle à tous ceux que tu lui as donnés.
verses.am: ሰዓቱ ደርሶአል፤ ልጅህ ያከብርህ ዘንድ፥ በሥጋም ሁሉ ላይ ሥልጣን እንደ ሰጠኸው፥ ለሰጠኸው ሁሉ የዘላለምን ሕይወት ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ልጅህን አክብረው።

verses.en: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
verses.fr: Or, la vie éternelle, c''est qu''ils te connaissent, toi, le seul vrai Dieu, et celui que tu as envoyé, Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: እውነተኛ አምላክ ብቻ የሆንህ አንተን የላክኸውንም ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ያውቁ ዘንድ ይህች የዘላለም ሕይወት ናት።

verses.en: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
verses.fr: Je t''ai glorifié sur la terre, j''ai achevé l''oeuvre que tu m''as donnée à faire.
verses.am: እኔ ላደርገው የሰጠኸኝን ሥራ ፈጽሜ በምድር አከበርሁህ፤

verses.en: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
verses.fr: Et maintenant toi, Père, glorifie-moi auprès de toi-même de la gloire que j''avais auprès de toi avant que le monde fût.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ አባት ሆይ፥ ዓለም ሳይፈጠር በአንተ ዘንድ በነበረኝ ክብር አንተ በራስህ ዘንድ አክብረኝ።

verses.en: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
verses.fr: J''ai fait connaître ton nom aux hommes que tu m''as donnés du milieu du monde. Ils étaient à toi, et tu me les as donnés; et ils ont gardé ta parole.
verses.am: ከዓለም ለሰጠኸኝ ሰዎች ስምህን ገለጥሁላቸው። የአንተ ነበሩ ለእኔም ሰጠሃቸው፤

verses.en: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
verses.fr: Maintenant ils ont connu que tout ce que tu m''as donné vient de toi.
verses.am: ቃልህንም ጠብቀዋል። የሰጠኸኝ ሁሉ ከአንተ እንደ ሆነ አሁን ያውቃሉ፤

verses.en: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
verses.fr: Car je leur ai donné les paroles que tu m''as données; et ils les ont reçues, et ils ont vraiment connu que je suis sorti de toi, et ils ont cru que tu m''as envoyé.
verses.am: የሰጠኸኝን ቃል ሰጥቻቸዋለሁና፤ እነርሱም ተቀበሉት፥ ከአንተም ዘንድ እንደ ወጣሁ በእውነት አወቁ፥ አንተም እንደ ላክኸኝ አመኑ።

verses.en: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
verses.fr: C''est pour eux que je prie. Je ne prie pas pour le monde, mais pour ceux que tu m''as donnés, parce qu''ils sont à toi; -
verses.am: እኔ ስለ እነዚህ እለምናለሁ፤ ስለ ዓለም አልለምንም ስለ ሰጠኸኝ እንጂ፤ የአንተ ናቸውና፤

verses.en: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
verses.fr: et tout ce qui est à moi est à toi, et ce qui est à toi est à moi; -et je suis glorifié en eux.
verses.am: የእኔም የሆነ ሁሉ የአንተ ነው የአንተውም የእኔ ነው፤ እኔም ስለ እነርሱ ከብሬአለሁ።

verses.en: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
verses.fr: Je ne suis plus dans le monde, et ils sont dans le monde, et je vais à toi. Père saint, garde en ton nom ceux que tu m''as donnés, afin qu''ils soient un comme nous.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ በዓለም አይደለሁም፥ እነርሱም በዓለም ናቸው፥ እኔም ወደ አንተ እመጣለሁ። ቅዱስ አባት ሆይ፥ እነዚህን የሰጠኸኝን እንደ እኛ አንድ እንዲሆኑ በስምህ ጠብቃቸው።

verses.en: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.fr: Lorsque j''étais avec eux dans le monde, je les gardais en ton nom. J''ai gardé ceux que tu m''as donnés, et aucun d''eux ne s''est perdu, sinon le fils de perdition, afin que l''Ecriture fût accomplie.
verses.am: ከእነርሱ ጋር በዓለም ሳለሁ የሰጠኸኝን በስምህ እኔ እጠብቃቸው ነበር፤ ጠበቅኋቸውም መጽሐፉም እንዲፈጸም ከጥፋት ልጅ በቀር ከእነርሱ ማንም አልጠፋም።

verses.en: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
verses.fr: Et maintenant je vais à toi, et je dis ces choses dans le monde, afin qu''ils aient en eux ma joie parfaite.
verses.am: አሁንም ወደ አንተ እመጣለሁ፤ በእነርሱም ዘንድ ደስታዬ የተፈጸመ እንዲሆንላቸው ይህን በዓለም እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.fr: Je leur ai donné ta parole; et le monde les a haïs, parce qu''ils ne sont pas du monde, comme moi je ne suis pas du monde.
verses.am: እኔ ቃልህን ሰጥቻቸዋለሁ፤ እኔም ከዓለም እንዳይደለሁ ከዓለም አይደሉምና ዓለም ጠላቸው።

verses.en: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
verses.fr: Je ne te prie pas de les ôter du monde, mais de les préserver du mal.
verses.am: ከክፉ እንድትጠብቃቸው እንጂ ከዓለም እንድታወጣቸው አልለምንም።

verses.en: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.fr: Ils ne sont pas du monde, comme moi je ne suis pas du monde.
verses.am: እኔ ከዓለም እንዳይደለሁ ከዓለም አይደሉም።

verses.en: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
verses.fr: Sanctifie-les par ta vérité: ta parole est la vérité.
verses.am: በእውነትህ ቀድሳቸው፤ ቃልህ እውነት ነው።

verses.en: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
verses.fr: Comme tu m''as envoyé dans le monde, je les ai aussi envoyés dans le monde.
verses.am: ወደ ዓለም እንደ ላክኸኝ እንዲሁ እኔ ወደ ዓለም ላክኋቸው፤

verses.en: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
verses.fr: Et je me sanctifie moi-même pour eux, afin qu''eux aussi soient sanctifiés par la vérité.
verses.am: እነርሱም ደግሞ በእውነት የተቀደሱ እንዲሆኑ እኔ ራሴን ስለ እነርሱ እቀድሳለሁ።

verses.en: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas pour eux seulement que je prie, mais encore pour ceux qui croiront en moi par leur parole,
verses.am: አባት ሆይ፥ ዓለም ሳይፈጠር ስለ ወደድኸኝ የሰጠኸኝን ክብሬን እንዲያዩ እኔ ባለሁበት የሰጠኸኝ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከእኔ ጋር ይሆኑ ዘንድ እወዳለሁ።

verses.en: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.fr: afin que tous soient un, comme toi, Père, tu es en moi, et comme je suis en toi, afin qu''eux aussi soient un en nous, pour que le monde croie que tu m''as envoyé.
verses.am: አባት ሆይ፥ ዓለም ሳይፈጠር ስለ ወደድኸኝ የሰጠኸኝን ክብሬን እንዲያዩ እኔ ባለሁበት የሰጠኸኝ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከእኔ ጋር ይሆኑ ዘንድ እወዳለሁ።

verses.en: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
verses.fr: Je leur ai donné la gloire que tu m''as donnée, afin qu''ils soient un comme nous sommes un, -
verses.am: አባት ሆይ፥ ዓለም ሳይፈጠር ስለ ወደድኸኝ የሰጠኸኝን ክብሬን እንዲያዩ እኔ ባለሁበት የሰጠኸኝ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከእኔ ጋር ይሆኑ ዘንድ እወዳለሁ።

verses.en: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
verses.fr: moi en eux, et toi en moi, -afin qu''ils soient parfaitement un, et que le monde connaisse que tu m''as envoyé et que tu les as aimés comme tu m''as aimé.
verses.am: ጻድቅ አባት ሆይ፥ ዓለም አላወቀህም፥ እኔ ግን አወቅሁህ እነዚህም አንተ እንደ ላክኸኝ አወቁ፤

verses.en: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
verses.fr: Père, je veux que là où je suis ceux que tu m''as donnés soient aussi avec moi, afin qu''ils voient ma gloire, la gloire que tu m''as donnée, parce que tu m''as aimé avant la fondation du monde.
verses.am: እኔንም የወደድህባት ፍቅር በእነርሱ እንድትሆን እኔም በእነርሱ፥ ስምህን አስታወቅኋቸው አስታውቃቸውማለሁ።

verses.en: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
verses.fr: Père juste, le monde ne t''a point connu; mais moi je t''ai connu, et ceux-ci ont connu que tu m''as envoyé.
verses.am: ጻድቅ አባት ሆይ፥ ዓለም አላወቀህም፥ እኔ ግን አወቅሁህ እነዚህም አንተ እንደ ላክኸኝ አወቁ፤

verses.en: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
verses.fr: Je leur ai fait connaître ton nom, et je le leur ferai connaître, afin que l''amour dont tu m''as aimé soit en eux, et que je sois en eux.
verses.am: እኔንም የወደድህባት ፍቅር በእነርሱ እንድትሆን እኔም በእነርሱ፥ ስምህን አስታወቅኋቸው አስታውቃቸውማለሁ።

verses.en: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il eut dit ces choses, Jésus alla avec ses disciples de l''autre côté du torrent du Cédron, où se trouvait un jardin, dans lequel il entra, lui et ses disciples.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ይህን ብሎ አትክልት ወዳለበት ስፍራ ወደ ቄድሮን ወንዝ ማዶ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወጣ፤ እርሱም ደቀ መዛሙርቱም በዚያ ገቡ።

verses.en: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
verses.fr: Judas, qui le livrait, connaissait ce lieu, parce que Jésus et ses disciples s''y étaient souvent réunis.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ብዙ ጊዜ ወደዚያ ስለ ተሰበሰቡ አሳልፎ የሰጠው ይሁዳ ደግሞ ስፍራውን ያውቅ ነበር።

verses.en: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
verses.fr: Judas donc, ayant pris la cohorte, et des huissiers qu''envoyèrent les principaux sacrificateurs et les pharisiens, vint là avec des lanternes, des flambeaux et des armes.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ይሁዳ ጭፍሮችንና ከካህናት አለቆች ከፈሪሳውያንም ሎሌዎችን ተቀብሎ በችቦና በፋና በጋሻ ጦርም ወደዚያ መጣ።

verses.en: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
verses.fr: Jésus, sachant tout ce qui devait lui arriver, s''avança, et leur dit: Qui cherchez-vous?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም የሚመጣበትን ሁሉ አውቆ ወጣና። ማንን ትፈልጋላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Jésus de Nazareth. Jésus leur dit: C''est moi. Et Judas, qui le livrait, était avec eux.
verses.am: የናዝሬቱን ኢየሱስን ብለው መለሱለት። ኢየሱስ። እኔ ነኝ አላቸው። አሳልፎ የሰጠውም ይሁዳ ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ጋር ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jésus leur eut dit: C''est moi, ils reculèrent et tombèrent par terre.
verses.am: እንግዲህ። እኔ ነኝ ባላቸው ጊዜ ወደ ኋላ አፈግፍገው በምድር ወደቁ።

verses.en: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.fr: Il leur demanda de nouveau: Qui cherchez-vous? Et ils dirent: Jésus de Nazareth.
verses.am: ደግሞም። ማንን ትፈልጋላችሁ? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው። እነርሱም። የናዝሬቱን ኢየሱስን አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Je vous ai dit que c''est moi. Si donc c''est moi que vous cherchez, laissez aller ceux-ci.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መልሶ። እኔ ነኝ አልኋችሁ፤ እንግዲህ እኔን ትፈልጉ እንደ ሆናችሁ እነዚህ ይሂዱ ተዉአቸው አለ፤

verses.en: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
verses.fr: Il dit cela, afin que s''accomplît la parole qu''il avait dite: Je n''ai perdu aucun de ceux que tu m''as donnés.
verses.am: ይህም። ከእነዚህ ከሰጠኸኝ አንዱን ስንኳ አላጠፋሁም ያለው ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
verses.fr: Simon Pierre, qui avait une épée, la tira, frappa le serviteur du souverain sacrificateur, et lui coupa l''oreille droite. Ce serviteur s''appelait Malchus.
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም ሰይፍ ስለ ነበረው መዘዘው፥ የሊቀ ካህናቱንም ባርያ መትቶ ቀኝ ጆሮውን ቈረጠ፤ የባርያውም ስም ማልኮስ ነበረ።

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
verses.fr: Jésus dit à Pierre: Remets ton épée dans le fourreau. Ne boirai-je pas la coupe que le Père m''a donnée à boire?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ጴጥሮስን። ሰይፍህን ወደ ሰገባው ክተተው፤ አብ የሰጠኝን ጽዋ አልጠጣትምን? አለው።

verses.en: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
verses.fr: La cohorte, le tribun, et les huissiers des Juifs, se saisirent alors de Jésus, et le lièrent.
verses.am: እንግዲህ የሻለቃውና ጭፍሮቹ የአይሁድም ሎሌዎች ኢየሱስን ይዘው አሰሩት፥

verses.en: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
verses.fr: Ils l''emmenèrent d''abord chez Anne; car il était le beau-père de Caïphe, qui était souverain sacrificateur cette année-là.
verses.am: አስቀድመውም ወደ ሐና ወሰዱት፤ በዚያች ዓመት ሊቀ ካህናት ለነበረው ለቀያፋ አማቱ ነበርና።

verses.en: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
verses.fr: Et Caïphe était celui qui avait donné ce conseil aux Juifs: Il est avantageux qu''un seul homme meure pour le peuple.
verses.am: ቀያፋም። አንድ ሰው ስለ ሕዝብ ይሞት ዘንድ ይሻላል ብሎ ለአይሁድ የመከራቸው ነበረ።

verses.en: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
verses.fr: Simon Pierre, avec un autre disciple, suivait Jésus. Ce disciple était connu du souverain sacrificateur, et il entra avec Jésus dans la cour du souverain sacrificateur;
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም ሌላውም ደቀ መዝሙር ኢየሱስን ተከተሉ። ያም ደቀ መዝሙር በሊቀ ካህናቱ ዘንድ የታወቀ ነበረ፥ ወደ ሊቀ ካህናቱም ግቢ ከኢየሱስ ጋር ገባ፤

verses.en: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.fr: mais Pierre resta dehors près de la porte. L''autre disciple, qui était connu du souverain sacrificateur, sortit, parla à la portière, et fit entrer Pierre.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን በውጭ በበሩ ቆሞ ነበር። እንግዲህ በሊቀ ካህናቱ ዘንድ የታወቀው ሌላው ደቀ መዝሙር ወጣ ለበረኛይቱም ነግሮ ጴጥሮስን አስገባው።

verses.en: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
verses.fr: Alors la servante, la portière, dit à Pierre: Toi aussi, n''es-tu pas des disciples de cet homme? Il dit: Je n''en suis point.
verses.am: በረኛ የነበረችይቱም ገረድ ጴጥሮስን። አንተ ደግሞ ከዚህ ሰው ደቀ መዛሙርት አንዱ አይደለህምን? አለችው። እርሱ። አይደለሁም አለ።

verses.en: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
verses.fr: Les serviteurs et les huissiers, qui étaient là, avaient allumé un brasier, car il faisait froid, et ils se chauffaient. Pierre se tenait avec eux, et se chauffait.
verses.am: ብርድ ነበረና ባሮችና ሎሌዎች የፍም እሳት አንድደው ቆሙ ይሞቁም ነበር፤ ጴጥሮስም ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ጋር ቆሞ ይሞቅ ነበር።

verses.en: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
verses.fr: Le souverain sacrificateur interrogea Jésus sur ses disciples et sur sa doctrine.
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናቱም ኢየሱስን ስለ ደቀ መዛሙርቱና ስለ ትምህርቱ ጠየቀው።

verses.en: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: J''ai parlé ouvertement au monde; j''ai toujours enseigné dans la synagogue et dans le temple, où tous les Juifs s''assemblent, et je n''ai rien dit en secret.
verses.am: ኢየስስም መልሶ። እኔ በግልጥ ለዓለም ተናገርሁ፤ አይሁድ ሁሉ በሚሰበሰቡበት በምኵራብና በመቅደስ እኔ ሁልጊዜ አስተማርሁ፥ በስውርም ምንም አልተናገርሁም።
