verses.en: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
verses.fr: Pourquoi m''interroges-tu? Interroge sur ce que je leur ai dit ceux qui m''ont entendu; voici, ceux-là savent ce que j''ai dit.
verses.am: ስለምን ትጠይቀኛለህ? ለእነርሱ የተናገርሁትን የሰሙትን ጠይቅ፤ እነሆ፥ እነዚህ እኔ የነገርሁትን ያውቃሉ አለው።

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
verses.fr: A ces mots, un des huissiers, qui se trouvait là, donna un soufflet à Jésus, en disant: Est-ce ainsi que tu réponds au souverain sacrificateur?
verses.am: ይህንም ሲል በዚያ ቆሞ የነበረው ከሎሌዎች አንዱ። ለሊቀ ካህናቱ እንዲህ ትመልሳለህን? ብሎ ኢየሱስን በጥፊ መታው።

verses.en: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Si j''ai mal parlé, fais voir ce que j''ai dit de mal; et si j''ai bien parlé, pourquoi me frappes-tu?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ክፉ ተናግሬ እንደ ሆንሁ ስለ ክፉ መስክር፤ መልካም ተናግሬ እንደ ሆንሁ ግን ሰለ ምን ትመታኛለህ? አለው።

verses.en: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.fr: Anne l''envoya lié à Caïphe, le souverain sacrificateur.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሐና እንደ ታሰረ ወደ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ወደ ቀያፋ ሰደደው።

verses.en: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
verses.fr: Simon Pierre était là, et se chauffait. On lui dit: Toi aussi, n''es-tu pas de ses disciples? Il le nia, et dit: Je n''en suis point.
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም ቆሞ እሳት ይሞቅ ነበር። እንግዲህ። አንተ ደግሞ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አይደለህምን? አሉት። እርሱም። አይደለሁም ብሎ ካደ።

verses.en: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
verses.fr: Un des serviteurs du souverain sacrificateur, parent de celui à qui Pierre avait coupé l''oreille, dit: Ne t''ai-je pas vu avec lui dans le jardin?
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ጆሮውን የቈረጠው ዘመድ የሆነ ከሊቀ ካህናቱ ባሮች አንዱ። በአትክልቱ ከእርሱ ጋር እኔ አይቼህ አልነበረምን? አለው።

verses.en: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
verses.fr: Pierre le nia de nouveau. Et aussitôt le coq chanta.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም እንደ ገና ካደ፥ ወዲያውም ዶሮ ጮኸ።

verses.en: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
verses.fr: Ils conduisirent Jésus de chez Caïphe au prétoire: c''était le matin. Ils n''entrèrent point eux-mêmes dans le prétoire, afin de ne pas se souiller, et de pouvoir manger la Pâque.
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም ከቀያፋ ወደ ገዡ ግቢ ወሰዱት፤ ማለዳም ነበረ፤ እነርሱም የፋሲካ በግ ይበሉ ዘንድ እንጂ እንዳይረክሱ ወደ ገዡ ግቢ አልገቡም።

verses.en: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
verses.fr: Pilate sortit donc pour aller à eux, et il dit: Quelle accusation portez-vous contre cet homme?
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጲላጦስ ወደ ውጭ ወደ እነርሱ ወጥቶ። ይህን ሰው ስለ ምን ትከሱታላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Si ce n''était pas un malfaiteur, nous ne te l''aurions pas livré.
verses.am: እነርሱም መልሰው። ይህስ ክፉ አድራጊ ባይሆን ወደ አንተ አሳልፈን ባልሰጠነውም ነበር አሉት።

verses.en: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
verses.fr: Sur quoi Pilate leur dit: Prenez-le vous-mêmes, et jugez-le selon votre loi. Les Juifs lui dirent: Il ne nous est pas permis de mettre personne à mort.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም። እናንተ ወስዳችሁ እንደ ሕጋችሁ ፍረዱበት አላቸው። አይሁድም። ለእኛስ ማንንም ልንገድል አልተፈቀደልንም አሉት፤

verses.en: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
verses.fr: C''était afin que s''accomplît la parole que Jésus avait dite, lorsqu''il indiqua de quelle mort il devait mourir.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ በምን ዓይነት ሞት ሊሞት እንዳለው ሲያመለክት የተናገረው ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
verses.fr: Pilate rentra dans le prétoire, appela Jésus, et lui dit: Es-tu le roi des Juifs?
verses.am: ጲላጦስም እንደ ገና ወደ ገዡ ግቢ ገባና ኢየሱስን ጠርቶ። የአይሁድ ንጉሥ አንተ ነህን? አለው።

verses.en: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Est-ce de toi-même que tu dis cela, ou d''autres te l''ont-ils dit de moi?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። አንተ ይህን የምትለው ከራስህ ነውን ወይስ ሌሎች ስለ እኔ ነገሩህን? አለው።

verses.en: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
verses.fr: Pilate répondit: Moi, suis-je Juif? Ta nation et les principaux sacrificateurs t''ont livré à moi: qu''as-tu fait?
verses.am: ጲላጦስ መልሶ። እኔ አይሁዳዊ ነኝን? ወገኖችህና የካህናት አለቆች ለእኔ አሳልፈው ሰጡህ፤ ምን አድርገሃል? አለው።

verses.en: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
verses.fr: Mon royaume n''est pas de ce monde, répondit Jésus. Si mon royaume était de ce monde, mes serviteurs auraient combattu pour moi afin que je ne fusse pas livré aux Juifs; mais maintenant mon royaume n''est point d''ici-bas.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። መንግሥቴ ከዚህ ዓለም አይደለችም፤ መንግሥቴስ ከዚህ ዓለም ብትሆን፥ ወደ አይሁድ እንዳልሰጥ ሎሌዎቼ ይዋጉልኝ ነበር፤ አሁን ግን መንግሥቴ ከዚህ አይደለችም አለው።

verses.en: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
verses.fr: Pilate lui dit: Tu es donc roi? Jésus répondit: Tu le dis, je suis roi. Je suis né et je suis venu dans le monde pour rendre témoignage à la vérité. Quiconque est de la vérité écoute ma voix.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም። እንግዲያ ንጉሥ ነህን? አለው። ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እኔ ንጉሥ እንደ ሆንሁ አንተ ትላለህ። እኔ ለእውነት ልመሰክር ስለዚህ ተወልጃለሁ ስለዚህም ወደ ዓለም መጥቻለሁ፤ ከእውነት የሆነ ሁሉ ድምፄን ይሰማል አለው።

verses.en: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
verses.fr: Pilate lui dit: Qu''est-ce que la vérité? Après avoir dit cela, il sortit de nouveau pour aller vers les Juifs, et il leur dit: Je ne trouve aucun crime en lui.
verses.am: ጲላጦስ። እውነት ምንድር ነው? አለው። ይህንም ብሎ ዳግመኛ ወደ አይሁድ ወጥቶ። እኔስ አንዲት በደል ስንኳ አላገኘሁበትም።

verses.en: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.fr: Mais, comme c''est parmi vous une coutume que je vous relâche quelqu''un à la fête de Pâque, voulez-vous que je vous relâche le roi des Juifs?
verses.am: ነገር ግን በፋሲካ አንድ ልፈታላችሁ ልማድ አላችሁ፤ እንግዲህ የአይሁድን ንጉሥ ልፈታላችሁ ትወዳላችሁን? አላቸው።

verses.en: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.fr: Alors de nouveau tous s''écrièrent: Non pas lui, mais Barabbas. Or, Barabbas était un brigand.
verses.am: ሁሉም ደግመው። በርባንን እንጂ ይህን አይደለም እያሉ ጮኹ። በርባን ግን ወንበዴ ነበረ።

verses.en: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
verses.fr: Alors Pilate prit Jésus, et le fit battre de verges.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ጲላጦስ ኢየሱስን ይዞ ገረፈው።

verses.en: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
verses.fr: Les soldats tressèrent une couronne d''épines qu''ils posèrent sur sa tête, et ils le revêtirent d''un manteau de pourpre; puis, s''approchant de lui,
verses.am: ወታደሮችም ከእሾህ አክሊል ጐንጕነው በራሱ ላይ አኖሩ ቀይ ልብስም አለበሱት፤

verses.en: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
verses.fr: ils disaient: Salut, roi des Juifs! Et ils lui donnaient des soufflets.
verses.am: እየቀረቡም። የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን ይሉት ነበር፤

verses.en: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
verses.fr: Pilate sortit de nouveau, et dit aux Juifs: Voici, je vous l''amène dehors, afin que vous sachiez que je ne trouve en lui aucun crime.
verses.am: በጥፊም ይመቱት ነበር። ጲላጦስም ደግሞ ወደ ውጭ ወጥቶ። እነሆ፥ አንዲት በደል ስንኳ እንዳላገኘሁበት ታውቁ ዘንድ እርሱን ወደ ውጭ አወጣላችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
verses.fr: Jésus sortit donc, portant la couronne d''épines et le manteau de pourpre. Et Pilate leur dit: Voici l''homme.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም የእሾህ አክሊል ደፍቶ ቀይ ልብስም ለብሶ ወደ ውጭ ወጣ።

verses.en: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
verses.fr: Lorsque les principaux sacrificateurs et les huissiers le virent, ils s''écrièrent: Crucifie! crucifie! Pilate leur dit: Prenez-le vous-mêmes, et crucifiez-le; car moi, je ne trouve point de crime en lui.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም። እነሆ ሰውዬው አላቸው። የካህናት አለቆችና ሎሌዎች ባዩትም ጊዜ። ስቀለው ስቀለው እያሉ ጮኹ። ጲላጦስም። እኔስ አንዲት በደል ስንኳ አላገኘሁበትምና እናንተ ወስዳችሁ ስቀሉት አላቸው።

verses.en: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
verses.fr: Les Juifs lui répondirent: Nous avons une loi; et, selon notre loi, il doit mourir, parce qu''il s''est fait Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: አይሁድም መልሰው። እኛ ሕግ አለን፥ እንደ ሕጋችንም ሊሞት ይገባዋል፥ ራሱን የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ አድርጎአልና አሉት።

verses.en: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
verses.fr: Quand Pilate entendit cette parole, sa frayeur augmenta.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጲላጦስ ይህን ነገር በሰማ ጊዜ እግጅ ፈራ፤

verses.en: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.fr: Il rentra dans le prétoire, et il dit à Jésus: D''où es-tu? Mais Jésus ne lui donna point de réponse.
verses.am: ተመልሶም ወደ ገዡ ግቢ ገባና ኢየሱስን። አንተ ከወዴት ነህ? አለው። ኢየሱስ ግን አንድ እንኳ አልመለሰለትም።

verses.en: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
verses.fr: Pilate lui dit: Est-ce à moi que tu ne parles pas? Ne sais-tu pas que j''ai le pouvoir de te crucifier, et que j''ai le pouvoir de te relâcher?
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጲላጦስ። አትነግረኝምን? ልሰቅልህ ሥልጣን እንዳለኝ ወይም ልፈታህ ሥልጣን እንዳለኝ አታውቅምን? አለው።

verses.en: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Tu n''aurais sur moi aucun pouvoir, s''il ne t''avait été donné d''en haut. C''est pourquoi celui qui me livre à toi commet un plus grand péché.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ከላይ ካልተሰጠህ በቀር በእኔ ላይ ምንም ሥልጣን ባልነበረህም፤ ስለዚህ ለአንተ አሳልፎ የሰጠኝ ኃጢአቱ የባሰ ነው አለው።

verses.en: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.
verses.fr: Dès ce moment, Pilate cherchait à le relâcher. Mais les Juifs criaient: Si tu le relâches, tu n''es pas ami de César. Quiconque se fait roi se déclare contre César.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ጲላጦስ ሊፈታው ፈለገ፤ ነገር ግን አይሁድ። ይህንስ ብትፈታው የቄሣር ወዳጅ አይደለህም፤ ራሱን ንጉሥ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ የቄሣር ተቃዋሚ ነው እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.en: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
verses.fr: Pilate, ayant entendu ces paroles, amena Jésus dehors; et il s''assit sur le tribunal, au lieu appelé le Pavé, et en hébreu Gabbatha.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም ይህን ነገር ሰምቶ ኢየሱስን ወደ ውጭ አወጣው፥ በዕብራይስጥም ገበታ በተባለው ጸፍጸፍ በሚሉት ስፍራ በፍርድ ወንበር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
verses.fr: C''était la préparation de la Pâque, et environ la sixième heure. Pilate dit aux Juifs: Voici votre roi.
verses.am: ለፋሲካም የማዘጋጀት ቀን ነበረ፤ ስድስት ሰዓትም የሚያህል ነበረ፤ አይሁድንም። እነሆ ንጉሣችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.
verses.fr: Mais ils s''écrièrent: Ote, ôte, crucifie-le! Pilate leur dit: Crucifierai-je votre roi? Les principaux sacrificateurs répondirent: Nous n''avons de roi que César.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን። አስወግደው፥ አስወግደው፥ ስቀለው እያሉ ጮኹ። ጲላጦስም። ንጉሣችሁን ልስቀለውን? አላቸው። የካህናት አለቆችም። ከቄሣር በቀር ሌላ ንጉሥ የለንም ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.en: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
verses.fr: Alors il le leur livra pour être crucifié. Ils prirent donc Jésus, et l''emmenèrent.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በዚያን ጊዜ እንዲሰቀል አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
verses.fr: Jésus, portant sa croix, arriva au lieu du crâne, qui se nomme en hébreu Golgotha.
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም ይዘው ወሰዱት፤ መስቀሉንም ተሸክሞ በዕብራይስጥ ጎልጎታ ወደ ተባለው የራስ ቅል ስፍራ ወደሚሉት ወጣ።

verses.en: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
verses.fr: C''est là qu''il fut crucifié, et deux autres avec lui, un de chaque côté, et Jésus au milieu.
verses.am: በዚያም ሰቀሉት፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሌሎች ሁለት፥ አንዱን በዚህ አንዱን በዚያ ኢየሱስንም በመካከላቸው ሰቀሉ።

verses.en: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was Jesus Of Nazareth The King Of The Jews.
verses.fr: Pilate fit une inscription, qu''il plaça sur la croix, et qui était ainsi conçue: Jésus de Nazareth, roi des Juifs.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም ደግሞ ጽሕፈት ጽፎ በመስቀሉ ላይ አኖረው፤ ጽሕፈቱም። የአይሁድ ንጉሥ የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ የሚል ነበረ።

verses.en: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
verses.fr: Beaucoup de Juifs lurent cette inscription, parce que le lieu où Jésus fut crucifié était près de la ville: elle était en hébreu, en grec et en latin.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም የተሰቀለበት ስፍራ ለከተማ ቅርብ ነበረና ከአይሁድ ብዙዎች ይህን ጽሕፈት አነበቡት፤ በዕብራይስጥና በሮማይስጥ በግሪክም ተጽፎ ነበር።

verses.en: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs des Juifs dirent à Pilate: N''écris pas: Roi des Juifs. Mais écris qu''il a dit: Je suis roi des Juifs.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የአይሁድ ካህናት አለቆች ጲላጦስን። እርሱ። የአይሁድ ንጉስ ነኝ እንዳለ እንጂ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ብለህ አትጻፍ አሉት።

verses.en: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
verses.fr: Pilate répondit: Ce que j''ai écrit, je l''ai écrit.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም። የጻፍሁትን ጽፌአለሁ ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.en: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
verses.fr: Les soldats, après avoir crucifié Jésus, prirent ses vêtements, et ils en firent quatre parts, une part pour chaque soldat. Ils prirent aussi sa tunique, qui était sans couture, d''un seul tissu depuis le haut jusqu''en bas.
verses.am: ጭፍሮችም ኢየሱስን በሰቀሉት ጊዜ ልብሶቹን ወስደው ለእያንዳንዱ ጭፍራ አንድ ክፍል ሆኖ በአራት ከፋፈሉት፤ እጀጠባቡን ደግሞ ወሰዱ። እጀ ጠባቡም ከላይ ጀምሮ ወጥ ሆኖ የተሠራ ነበረ እንጂ የተሰፋ አልነበረም።

verses.en: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
verses.fr: Et ils dirent entre eux: Ne la déchirons pas, mais tirons au sort à qui elle sera. Cela arriva afin que s''accomplît cette parole de l''Ecriture: Ils se sont partagé mes vêtements, Et ils ont tiré au sort ma tunique. Voilà ce que firent les soldats.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እርስ በርሳቸው። ለማን እንዲሆን በእርሱ ዕጣ እንጣጣልበት እንጂ አንቅደደው ተባባሉ። ይህም። ልብሴን እርስ በርሳቸው ተከፋፈሉ በእጀ ጠባቤም ዕጣ ተጣጣሉበት የሚለው የመጽሐፍ ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.fr: Près de la croix de Jésus se tenaient sa mère et la soeur de sa mère, Marie, femme de Clopas, et Marie de Magdala.
verses.am: ጭፍሮችም እንዲህ አደረጉ። ነገር ግን በኢየሱስ መስቀል አጠገብ እናቱ፥ የእናቱም እኅት፥ የቀለዮጳም ሚስት ማርያም፥ መግደላዊትም ማርያም ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
verses.fr: Jésus, voyant sa mère, et auprès d''elle le disciple qu''il aimait, dit à sa mère: Femme, voilà ton fils.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እናቱን ይወደው የነበረውንም ደቀ መዝሙር በአጠገቡ ቆሞ ባየ ጊዜ እናቱን። አንቺ ሴት፥ እነሆ ልጅሽ አላት።

verses.en: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
verses.fr: Puis il dit au disciple: Voilà ta mère. Et, dès ce moment, le disciple la prit chez lui.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ደቀ መዝሙሩን። እናትህ እነኋት አለው። ከዚህም ሰዓት ጀምሮ ደቀ መዝሙሩ ወደ ቤቱ ወሰዳት።

verses.en: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
verses.fr: Après cela, Jésus, qui savait que tout était déjà consommé, dit, afin que l''Ecriture fût accomplie: J''ai soif.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ አሁን ሁሉ እንደተፈጸመ አውቆ የመጽሐፉ ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ። ተጠማሁ አለ።

verses.en: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
verses.fr: Il y avait là un vase plein de vinaigre. Les soldats en remplirent une éponge, et, l''ayant fixée à une branche d''hysope, ils l''approchèrent de sa bouche.
verses.am: በዚያም ሆምጣጤ የሞላበት ዕቃ ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ እነርሱም ሆምጣጤውን በሰፍነግ ሞልተው በሁሶፕም አድርገው ወደ አፉ አቀረቡለት።

verses.en: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
verses.fr: Quand Jésus eut pris le vinaigre, il dit: Tout est accompli. Et, baissant la tête, il rendit l''esprit.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሆምጣጤውን ከተቀበለ በኋላ። ተፈጸመ አለ፥ ራሱንም አዘንብሎ ነፍሱን አሳልፎ ሰጠ።

verses.en: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
verses.fr: Dans la crainte que les corps ne restassent sur la croix pendant le sabbat, -car c''était la préparation, et ce jour de sabbat était un grand jour, -les Juifs demandèrent à Pilate qu''on rompît les jambes aux crucifiés, et qu''on les enlevât.
verses.am: አይሁድም የማዘጋጀት ቀን ስለ ሆነ ያ ሰንበት ትልቅ ነበረና ሥጋቸው በሰንበት በመስቀል ላይ እንዳይኖር፥ ጭናቸውን ሰብረው እንዲያወርዱአቸው ጲላጦስን ለመኑት።

verses.en: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
verses.fr: Les soldats vinrent donc, et ils rompirent les jambes au premier, puis à l''autre qui avait été crucifié avec lui.
verses.am: ጭፍሮችም መጥተው የፊተኛውን ጭን ከእርሱም ጋር የተሰቀለውን የሌላውን ጭን ሰበሩ፤

verses.en: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
verses.fr: S''étant approchés de Jésus, et le voyant déjà mort, ils ne lui rompirent pas les jambes;
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሱስ በመጡ ጊዜ ግን እርሱ ፈጽሞ እንደ ሞተ አይተው ጭኑን አልሰበሩም፤

verses.en: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
verses.fr: mais un des soldats lui perça le côté avec une lance, et aussitôt il sortit du sang et de l''eau.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከጭፍሮች አንዱ ጎኑን በጦር ወጋው፤ ወዲያውም ደምና ውኃ ወጣ።

verses.en: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
verses.fr: Celui qui l''a vu en a rendu témoignage, et son témoignage est vrai; et il sait qu''il dit vrai, afin que vous croyiez aussi.
verses.am: ያየውም መስክሮአል፤ ምስክሩም እውነት ነው፤ እናንተም ደግሞ ታምኑ ዘንድ እርሱ እውነት እንዲናገር ያውቃል።

verses.en: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
verses.fr: Ces choses sont arrivées, afin que l''Ecriture fût accomplie: Aucun de ses os ne sera brisé.
verses.am: ይህ የሆነ። ከእርሱ አጥንት አይሰበርም የሚል የመጽሐፉ ቃል እንዲፈጸም ነው።

verses.en: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
verses.fr: Et ailleurs l''Ecriture dit encore: Ils verront celui qu''ils ont percé.
verses.am: ደግሞም ሌላው መጽሐፍ። የወጉትን ያዩታል ይላል።

verses.en: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
verses.fr: Après cela, Joseph d''Arimathée, qui était disciple de Jésus, mais en secret par crainte des Juifs, demanda à Pilate la permission de prendre le corps de Jésus. Et Pilate le permit. Il vint donc, et prit le corps de Jésus.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ አይሁድን ስለ ፈራ በስውር የኢየሱስ ደቀ መዝሙር የነበረ የአርማትያስ ዮሴፍ የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ሊወስድ ጲላጦስን ለመነ፤ ጲላጦስም ፈቀደለት። ስለዚህም መጥቶ የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ወሰደ።

verses.en: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
verses.fr: Nicodème, qui auparavant était allé de nuit vers Jésus, vint aussi, apportant un mélange d''environ cent livres de myrrhe et d''aloès.
verses.am: ደግሞም አስቀድሞ በሌሊት ወደ ኢየሱስ መጥቶ የነበረ ኒቆዲሞስ መቶ ንጥር የሚያህል የከርቤና የእሬት ቅልቅል ይዞ መጣ።

verses.en: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
verses.fr: Ils prirent donc le corps de Jésus, et l''enveloppèrent de bandes, avec les aromates, comme c''est la coutume d''ensevelir chez les Juifs.
verses.am: የኢየሱስንም ሥጋ ወስደው እንደ አይሁድ አገናነዝ ልማድ ከሽቱ ጋር በተልባ እግር ልብስ ከፈኑት።

verses.en: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
verses.fr: Or, il y avait un jardin dans le lieu où Jésus avait été crucifié, et dans le jardin un sépulcre neuf, où personne encore n''avait été mis.
verses.am: በተሰቀለበትም ስፍራ አትክልት ነበረ፥ በአትክልቱም ማንም ገና ያልተቀበረበት አዲስ መቃብር ነበረ።

verses.en: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
verses.fr: Ce fut là qu''ils déposèrent Jésus, à cause de la préparation des Juifs, parce que le sépulcre était proche.
verses.am: ስለዚህ መቃብሩ ቅርብ ነበረና ስለ አይሁድ ማዘጋጀት ቀን ኢየሱስን በዚያ አኖሩት።

verses.en: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
verses.fr: Le premier jour de la semaine, Marie de Magdala se rendit au sépulcre dès le matin, comme il faisait encore obscur; et elle vit que la pierre était ôtée du sépulcre.
verses.am: ከሳምንቱም በፊተኛው ቀን መግደላዊት ማርያም ገና ጨለማ ሳለ ማለዳ ወደ መቃብር መጣች ድንጋዩም ከመቃብሩ ተፈንቅሎ አየች።

verses.en: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
verses.fr: Elle courut vers Simon Pierre et vers l''autre disciple que Jésus aimait, et leur dit: Ils ont enlevé du sépulcre le Seigneur, et nous ne savons où ils l''ont mis.
verses.am: እየሮጠችም ወደ ስምዖን ጴጥሮስና ኢየሱስ ይወደው ወደ ነበረው ወደ ሌላው ደቀ መዝሙር መጥታ። ጌታን ከመቃብር ወስደውታል ወዴትም እንዳኖሩት አናውቅም አለቻቸው።

verses.en: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
verses.fr: Pierre et l''autre disciple sortirent, et allèrent au sépulcre.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጴጥሮስና ሌላው ደቀ መዝሙር ወጥተው ወደ መቃብሩ ሄዱ።

verses.en: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
verses.fr: Ils couraient tous deux ensemble. Mais l''autre disciple courut plus vite que Pierre, et arriva le premier au sépulcre;
verses.am: ሁለቱም አብረው ሮጡ፤ ሌላው ደቀ መዝሙርም ከጴጥሮስ ይልቅ ፈጥኖ ወደ ፊት ሮጠና አስቀድሞ ከመቃብሩ ደረሰ፤

verses.en: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
verses.fr: s''étant baissé, il vit les bandes qui étaient à terre, cependant il n''entra pas.
verses.am: ዝቅም ብሎ ቢመለከት የተልባ እግሩን ልብስ ተቀምጦ አየ፥ ነገር ግን አልገባም።

verses.en: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
verses.fr: Simon Pierre, qui le suivait, arriva et entra dans le sépulcre; il vit les bandes qui étaient à terre,
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም ተከትሎት መጣ ወደ መቃብሩም ገባ፤ የተልባ እግሩን ልብስ ተቀምጦ አየ፥

verses.en: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
verses.fr: et le linge qu''on avait mis sur la tête de Jésus, non pas avec les bandes, mais plié dans un lieu à part.
verses.am: ደግሞም በራሱ የነበረውን ጨርቅ ለብቻው በአንድ ስፍራ ተጠምጥሞ እንደ ነበረ እንጂ ከተልባ እግሩ ልብስ ጋር ተቀምጦ እንዳልነበረ አየ።

verses.en: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
verses.fr: Alors l''autre disciple, qui était arrivé le premier au sépulcre, entra aussi; et il vit, et il crut.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ አስቀድሞ ወደ መቃብር የመጣውም ሌላው ደቀ መዝሙር ደግሞ ገባ፥ አየም፥ አመነም፤

verses.en: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
verses.fr: Car ils ne comprenaient pas encore que, selon l''Ecriture, Jésus devait ressusciter des morts.
verses.am: ከሙታን ይነሣ ዘንድ እንዲገባው የሚለውን የመጽሐፉን ቃል ገና አላወቁም ነበርና።

verses.en: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
verses.fr: Et les disciples s''en retournèrent chez eux.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ ቤታቸው ደግሞ ሄዱ።

verses.en: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
verses.fr: Cependant Marie se tenait dehors près du sépulcre, et pleurait. Comme elle pleurait, elle se baissa pour regarder dans le sépulcre;
verses.am: ማርያም ግን እያለቀሰች ከመቃብሩ በስተ ውጭ ቆማ ነበር። ስታለቅስም ወደ መቃብር ዝቅ ብላ ተመለከተች፤

verses.en: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.fr: et elle vit deux anges vêtus de blanc, assis à la place où avait été couché le corps de Jésus, l''un à la tête, l''autre aux pieds.
verses.am: ሁለት መላእክትም ነጭ ልብስ ለብሰው የኢየሱስ ሥጋ ተኝቶበት በነበረው አንዱ በራስጌ ሌላውም በእግርጌ ተቀምጠው አየች።

verses.en: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Femme, pourquoi pleures-tu? Elle leur répondit: Parce qu''ils ont enlevé mon Seigneur, et je ne sais où ils l''ont mis.
verses.am: እነርሱም። አንቺ ሴት፥ ስለ ምን ታለቅሻለሽ? አሉአት። እርስዋም። ጌታዬን ወስደውታል ወዴትም እንዳኖሩት አላውቅም አለቻቸው።

verses.en: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.fr: En disant cela, elle se retourna, et elle vit Jésus debout; mais elle ne savait pas que c''était Jésus.
verses.am: ይህንም ብላ ወደ ኋላ ዘወር ስትል ኢየሱስን ቆሞ አየችው፤ ኢየሱስም እንደ ሆነ አላወቀችም።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Femme, pourquoi pleures-tu? Qui cherches-tu? Elle, pensant que c''était le jardinier, lui dit: Seigneur, si c''est toi qui l''as emporté, dis-moi où tu l''as mis, et je le prendrai.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። አንቺ ሴት፥ ስለ ምን ታለቅሻለሽ? ማንንስ ትፈልጊያለሽ? አላት። እርስዋም የአትክልት ጠባቂ መስሎአት። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ወስደኸው እንደ ሆንህ ወዴት እንዳኖርኸው ንገረኝ እኔም እወስደዋለሁ አለችው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Marie! Elle se retourna, et lui dit en hébreu: Rabbouni! c''est-à-dire, Maître!
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ማርያም አላት። እርስዋ ዘወር ብላ በዕብራይስጥ። ረቡኒ አለችው፤ ትርጓሜውም። መምህር ሆይ ማለት ነው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Ne me touche pas; car je ne suis pas encore monté vers mon Père. Mais va trouver mes frères, et dis-leur que je monte vers mon Père et votre Père, vers mon Dieu et votre Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ገና ወደ አባቴ አላረግሁምና አትንኪኝ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ወንድሞቼ ሄደሽ። እኔ ወደ አባቴና ወደ አባታችሁ ወደ አምላኬና ወደ አምላካችሁ ዓርጋለሁ ብለሽ ንገሪአቸው አላት።

verses.en: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
verses.fr: Marie de Magdala alla annoncer aux disciples qu''elle avait vu le Seigneur, et qu''il lui avait dit ces choses.
verses.am: መግደላዊት ማርያም መጥታ ጌታን እንዳየች ይህንም እንዳላት ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ነገረች።

verses.en: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
verses.fr: Le soir de ce jour, qui était le premier de la semaine, les portes du lieu où se trouvaient les disciples étant fermées, à cause de la crainte qu''ils avaient des Juifs, Jésus vint, se présenta au milieu d''eux, et leur dit: La paix soit avec vous!
verses.am: ያም ቀን እርሱም ከሳምንቱ ፊተኛው በመሸ ጊዜ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ተሰብስበው በነበሩበት፥ አይሁድን ስለ ፈሩ ደጆቹ ተዘግተው ሳሉ፥ ኢየሱስ መጣ፤ በመካከላቸውም ቆሞ። ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
verses.fr: Et quand il eut dit cela, il leur montra ses mains et son côté. Les disciples furent dans la joie en voyant le Seigneur.
verses.am: ይህንም ብሎ እጆቹንም ጎኑንም አሳያቸው። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ጌታን ባዩ ጊዜ ደስ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit de nouveau: La paix soit avec vous! Comme le Père m''a envoyé, moi aussi je vous envoie.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ዳግመኛ። ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን፤ አብ እንደ ላከኝ እኔ ደግሞ እልካችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
verses.fr: Après ces paroles, il souffla sur eux, et leur dit: Recevez le Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: ይህንም ብሎ እፍ አለባቸውና። መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
verses.fr: Ceux à qui vous pardonnerez les péchés, ils leur seront pardonnés; et ceux à qui vous les retiendrez, ils leur seront retenus.
verses.am: ኃጢአታቸውን ይቅር ያላችኋቸው ሁሉ ይቀርላቸዋል፤ የያዛችሁባቸው ተይዞባቸዋል አላቸው።

verses.en: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
verses.fr: Thomas, appelé Didyme, l''un des douze, n''était pas avec eux lorsque Jésus vint.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ ዲዲሞስ የሚሉት ቶማስ ኢየሱስ በመጣ ጊዜ ከእነርሱ ጋር አልነበረም።

verses.en: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
verses.fr: Les autres disciples lui dirent donc: Nous avons vu le Seigneur. Mais il leur dit: Si je ne vois dans ses mains la marque des clous, et si je ne mets mon doigt dans la marque des clous, et si je ne mets ma main dans son côté, je ne croirai point.
verses.am: ሌሎቹም ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። ጌታን አይተነዋል አሉት። እርሱ ግን። የችንካሩን ምልክት በእጆቹ ካላየሁ ጣቴንም በችንካሩ ምልክት ካላገባሁ እጄንም በጎኑ ካላገባሁ አላምንም አላቸው።

verses.en: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
verses.fr: Huit jours après, les disciples de Jésus étaient de nouveau dans la maison, et Thomas se trouvait avec eux. Jésus vint, les portes étant fermées, se présenta au milieu d''eux, et dit: La paix soit avec vous!
verses.am: ከስምንት ቀን በኋላም ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ደግመው በውስጥ ነበሩ፥ ቶማስም ከእነርሱ ጋር ነበረ። ደጆች ተዘግተው ሳሉ ኢየሱስ መጣ፤ በመካከላቸውም ቆሞ። ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን አላቸው።

verses.en: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
verses.fr: Puis il dit à Thomas: Avance ici ton doigt, et regarde mes mains; avance aussi ta main, et mets-la dans mon côté; et ne sois pas incrédule, mais crois.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ቶማስን። ጣትህን ወደዚህ አምጣና እጆቼን እይ፤ እጅህንም አምጣና በጎኔ አግባው፤ ያመንህ እንጂ ያላመንህ አትሁን አለው።

verses.en: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
verses.fr: Thomas lui répondit: Mon Seigneur et mon Dieu!
verses.am: ቶማስም። ጌታዬ አምላኬም ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Parce que tu m''as vu, tu as cru. Heureux ceux qui n''ont pas vu, et qui ont cru!
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ስለ አየኸኝ አምነሃል፤ ሳያዩ የሚያምኑ ብፁዓን ናቸው አለው።

verses.en: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
verses.fr: Jésus a fait encore, en présence de ses disciples, beaucoup d''autres miracles, qui ne sont pas écrits dans ce livre.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በዚህ መጽሐፍ ያልተጻፈ ሌላ ብዙ ምልክት በደቀ መዛሙርቱ ፊት አደረገ፤

verses.en: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
verses.fr: Mais ces choses ont été écrites afin que vous croyiez que Jésus est le Christ, le Fils de Dieu, et qu''en croyant vous ayez la vie en son nom.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ኢየሱስ እርሱ ክርስቶስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆነ ታምኑ ዘንድ፥ አምናችሁም በስሙ ሕይወት ይሆንላችሁ ዘንድ ይህ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
verses.fr: Après cela, Jésus se montra encore aux disciples, sur les bords de la mer de Tibériade. Et voici de quelle manière il se montra.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ በጥብርያዶስ ባሕር አጠገብ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንደ ገና ተገለጠላቸው፤

verses.en: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
verses.fr: Simon Pierre, Thomas, appelé Didyme, Nathanaël, de Cana en Galilée, les fils de Zébédée, et deux autres disciples de Jésus, étaient ensemble.
verses.am: እንዲህም ተገለጠ። ስምዖን ጴጥሮስና ዲዲሞስ የሚባለው ቶማስ ከገሊላ ቃና የሆነ ናትናኤልም የዘብዴዎስም ልጆች ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሌሎች ሁለት በአንድነት ነበሩ።

verses.en: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
verses.fr: Simon Pierre leur dit: Je vais pêcher. Ils lui dirent: Nous allons aussi avec toi. Ils sortirent et montèrent dans une barque, et cette nuit-là ils ne prirent rien.
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ። ዓሣ ላጠምድ እሄዳለሁ አላቸው። እነርሱም። እኛም ከአንተ ጋር እንመጣለን አሉት። ወጥተውም ወደ ታንኳይቱ ገቡ በዚያችም ሌሊት ምንም እላጠመዱም።

verses.en: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.fr: Le matin étant venu, Jésus se trouva sur le rivage; mais les disciples ne savaient pas que c''était Jésus.
verses.am: በነጋም ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በባሕር ዳር ቆመ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ግን ኢየሱስ መሆኑን አላወቁም።

verses.en: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Enfants, n''avez-vous rien à manger? Ils lui répondirent: Non.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ልጆች ሆይ፥ አንዳች የሚበላ አላችሁን? አላቸው። የለንም ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Jetez le filet du côté droit de la barque, et vous trouverez. Ils le jetèrent donc, et ils ne pouvaient plus le retirer, à cause de la grande quantité de poissons.
verses.am: እርሱም። መረቡን በታንኳይቱ በስተ ቀኝ ጣሉት ታገኙማላችሁ አላቸው። ስለዚህ ጣሉት፤ በዚህም ጊዜ ከዓሣው ብዛት የተነሣ ሊጐትቱት አቃታቸው።

verses.en: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
verses.fr: Alors le disciple que Jésus aimait dit à Pierre: C''est le Seigneur! Et Simon Pierre, dès qu''il eut entendu que c''était le Seigneur, mit son vêtement et sa ceinture, car il était nu, et se jeta dans la mer.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ይወደው የነበረውም ደቀ መዝሙር ጴጥሮስን። ጌታ እኮ ነው አለው። ስለዚህ ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ ጌታ መሆኑን በሰማ ጊዜ ዕራቁቱን ነበረና ልብሱን ታጥቆ ወደ ባሕር ራሱን ጣለ።

verses.en: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
verses.fr: Les autres disciples vinrent avec la barque, tirant le filet plein de poissons, car ils n''étaient éloignés de terre que d''environ deux cents coudées.
verses.am: ሌሎቹ ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን ከምድር ሁለት መቶ ክንድ ያህል እንጂ እጅግ አልራቁም ነበርና ዓሣ የሞላውን መረብ እየሳቡ በጀልባ መጡ።

verses.en: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent descendus à terre, ils virent là des charbons allumés, du poisson dessus, et du pain.
verses.am: ወደ ምድርም በወጡ ጊዜ ፍምና ዓሣ በላዩ ተቀምጦ እንጀራም አዩ።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Apportez des poissons que vous venez de prendre.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። አሁን ካጠመዳችሁት ዓሣ አምጡ አላቸው።

verses.en: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
verses.fr: Simon Pierre monta dans la barque, et tira à terre le filet plein de cent cinquante-trois grands poissons; et quoiqu''il y en eût tant, le filet ne se rompit point.
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም ወደ ጀልባይቱ ገብቶ መቶ አምሳ ሦስት ታላላቅ ዓሦች ሞልቶ የነበረውን መረብ ወደ ምድር ጐተተ፤ ይህንም ያህል ብዙ ሲሆን መረቡ አልተቀደደም።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Venez, mangez. Et aucun des disciples n''osait lui demander: Qui es-tu? sachant que c''était le Seigneur.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ኑ፥ ምሳ ብሉ አላቸው። ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንድ ስንኳ። አንተ ማን ነህ? ብሎ ሊመረምረው የደፈረ አልነበረም፤ ጌታ መሆኑን አውቀው ነበርና።

verses.en: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
verses.fr: Jésus s''approcha, prit le pain, et leur en donna; il fit de même du poisson.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መጣና እንጀራ አንሥቶ ሰጣቸው፥ እንዲሁም ዓሣውን።

verses.en: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
verses.fr: C''était déjà la troisième fois que Jésus se montrait à ses disciples depuis qu''il était ressuscité des morts.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ከሙታን ከተነሣ በኋላ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሲገለጥላቸው ይህ ሦስተኛው ጊዜ ነበረ።

verses.en: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
verses.fr: Après qu''ils eurent mangé, Jésus dit à Simon Pierre: Simon, fils de Jonas, m''aimes-tu plus que ne m''aiment ceux-ci? Il lui répondit: Oui, Seigneur, tu sais que je t''aime. Jésus lui dit: Pais mes agneaux.
verses.am: ምሳ ከበሉ በኋላም ኢየሱስ ስምዖን ጴጥሮስን። የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ሆይ፥ ከእነዚህ ይልቅ ትወደኛለህን? አለው። አዎን ጌታ ሆይ፥ እንድወድህ አንተ ታውቃለህ አለው። ግልገሎቼን አሰማራ አለው።

verses.en: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.fr: Il lui dit une seconde fois: Simon, fils de Jonas, m''aimes-tu? Pierre lui répondit: Oui, Seigneur, tu sais que je t''aime. Jésus lui dit: Pais mes brebis.
verses.am: ደግሞ ሁለተኛ። የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ሆይ፥ ትወደኛለህን? አለው። አዎን ጌታ ሆይ፥ እንድወድህ አንተ ታውቃለህ አለው።

verses.en: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.fr: Il lui dit pour la troisième fois: Simon, fils de Jonas, m''aimes-tu? Pierre fut attristé de ce qu''il lui avait dit pour la troisième fois: M''aimes-tu? Et il lui répondit: Seigneur, tu sais toutes choses, tu sais que je t''aime. Jésus lui dit: Pais mes brebis.
verses.am: ጠቦቶቼን ጠብቅ አለው። ሦስተኛ ጊዜ። የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ሆይ፥ ትወደኛለህን? አለው። ሦስተኛ። ትወደኛለህን? ስላለው ጴጥሮስ አዘነና። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ሁሉን ታውቃለህ፤ እንድወድህ አንተ ታውቃለህ አለው። ኢየሱስም። በጎቼን አሰማራ።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdest thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
verses.fr: En vérité, en vérité, je te le dis, quand tu étais plus jeune, tu te ceignais toi-même, et tu allais où tu voulais; mais quand tu seras vieux, tu étendras tes mains, et un autre te ceindra, et te mènera où tu ne voudras pas.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ አንተ ጐልማሳ ሳለህ ወገብህን በገዛ ራስህ ታጥቀህ ወደምትወደው ትሄድ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን በሸመገልህ ጊዜ እጆችህን ትዘረጋለህ፥ ሌላውም ያስታጥቅሃል ወደማትወደውም ይወስድሃል አለው።

verses.en: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.fr: Il dit cela pour indiquer par quelle mort Pierre glorifierait Dieu. Et ayant ainsi parlé, il lui dit: Suis-moi.
verses.am: በምን ዓይነት ሞት እግዚአብሔርን ያከብር ዘንድ እንዳለው ሲያመለክት ይህን አለ። ይህንም ብሎ። ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.en: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
verses.fr: Pierre, s''étant retourné, vit venir après eux le disciple que Jésus aimait, celui qui, pendant le souper, s''était penché sur la poitrine de Jésus, et avait dit: Seigneur, qui est celui qui te livre?
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ዘወር ብሎ ኢየሱስ ይወደው የነበረውን ደቀ መዝሙር ሲከተለው አየ፤ እርሱም ደግሞ በእራት ጊዜ በደረቱ ተጠግቶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አሳልፎ የሚሰጥህ ማን ነው? ያለው ነበረ።

verses.en: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
verses.fr: En le voyant, Pierre dit à Jésus: Et celui-ci, Seigneur, que lui arrivera-t-il?
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ይህን አይቶ ኢየሱስን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ይህስ እንዴት ይሆናል? አለው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Si je veux qu''il demeure jusqu''à ce que je vienne, que t''importe? Toi, suis-moi.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እስክመጣ ድረስ ይኖር ዘንድ ብወድስ፥ ምን አግዶህ? አንተ ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.en: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
verses.fr: Là-dessus, le bruit courut parmi les frères que ce disciple ne mourrait point. Cependant Jésus n''avait pas dit à Pierre qu''il ne mourrait point; mais: Si je veux qu''il demeure jusqu''à ce que je vienne, que t''importe?
verses.am: ስለዚህ። ያ ደቀ መዝሙር አይሞትም የሚለው ይህ ነገር ወደ ወንድሞች ወጣ፤ ነገር ግን ኢየሱስ። እስክመጣ ድረስ ይኖር ዘንድ ብወድስ ምን አግዶህ? አለው እንጂ አይሞትም አላለውም።

verses.en: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
verses.fr: C''est ce disciple qui rend témoignage de ces choses, et qui les a écrites. Et nous savons que son témoignage est vrai.
verses.am: ስለ እነዚህም የመሰከረ ይህንንም ጽፎ ያለ ይህ ደቀ መዝሙር ነው፥ ምስክሩም እውነት እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን።

verses.en: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
verses.fr: Jésus a fait encore beaucoup d''autres choses; si on les écrivait en détail, je ne pense pas que le monde même pût contenir les livres qu''on écrirait.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ያደረገው ብዙ ሌላ ነገር ደግሞ አለ፤ ሁሉ በእያንዳንዱ ቢጻፍ ለተጻፉት መጻሕፍት ዓለም ራሱ ባልበቃቸውም ይመስለኛል።
